They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.

</details>


### [467] [Wavelet Phase Diffusion for Structurally and Semantically Consistent Sim-to-Real Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21628)
*Kaiwen Wang,Frank Bieder,Yinzhe Shen,Carlos Fernandez,Jan-Hendrik Pauls,Omer Sahin Tas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出小波相位扩散（ψ-PD），在双树复小波包变换域进行相位注入并用低频随机化（LFR）解耦合成光照先验，实现免训练外的高质量仿真到现实翻译，并支持实例级翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真到现实翻译需同时弥合外观差距并保持结构与语义一致性。现有三类方法各有缺陷：条件化方法需昂贵的控制模块；成对数据方法依赖复杂合成管线且常改变几何与语义；免训练编辑方法缺乏学习到的外观先验、感知质量受限。近期相位保持扩散虽有前景，但傅里叶域公式受全局谱耦合限制，导致振铃、边界泄漏等空间伪影，损害结构/语义一致性。

Method: 两点设计：(1) 在双树复小波包变换（DTCWPT）域操作，利用其局部化小波包实现空间自适应的相位注入，避免全局谱干扰；(2) 低频随机化（LFR）替换低频包，使模型与合成光照先验解耦，获得分布内的真实世界外观。两组件均以非配对开放域数据训练，推理开销可忽略。空间局部性还支持实例级翻译：单独翻译对象或区域而保持周围场景不变。

Result: 在 vKITTI→KITTI 图像翻译中，ψ-PD 在真实感与语义一致性上优于先前方法，同时保持有竞争力的结构对齐；在 CARLA 视频翻译中，真实感接近成对数据方法，并使 VLM 规划器的 ADE 与 FDE 分别降低 5.4% 和 5.1%。

Conclusion: 以小波包域的局部化相位注入替代傅里叶全局耦合，配合低频随机化，可在免成对数据、低推理开销下同时提升真实感、结构/语义一致性与下游规划性能，并拓展出实例级翻译能力。

Abstract: Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference. Second, Low-Frequency Randomization (LFR) replaces the low-frequency packet, decoupling the model from the synthetic illumination prior and enabling in-distribution real-world appearance. Both components train on unpaired open-domain data, and introduce negligible inference overhead. The spatial locality further enables instance-level translation, where individual objects or regions are translated to photorealistic appearance independently while the surrounding scene remains untranslated. On vKITTI $\to$ KITTI image translation, $ψ$-PD outperforms prior methods in realism and semantic consistency while maintaining competitive structural alignment. For CARLA video translation, $ψ$-PD approaches the realism of paired-data methods while reducing VLM planner ADE and FDE by $5.4\%$ and $5.1\%$, respectively.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [468] [Universal Short-Time Fourier Transform: Data-Adaptive Window-Length Selection for Time-Frequency Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37795)
*Manan Mittal,Kanad Sarkar,Ryan M. Corey,John R. Buck,Andrew C. Singer*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出通用短时傅里叶变换(U-STFT)，将窗长建模为数据自适应的状态变量，用三阶Rényi熵在候选窗长库中逐帧打分，并以线性复杂度的窗长网格(trellis)聚合，实现自适应时频分辨率与精确重合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STFT存在固有时频分辨率权衡：短窗时间分辨率高但频率分辨率差，长窗反之。固定窗长无法同时刻画快变瞬态与密集谐波，因此需要能随信号内容自适应调整分析窗长的方法。

Method: 将分析窗长作为数据自适应状态变量，其以当前观测区间包含的hop数为索引；每帧用归一化三阶Rényi熵对候选窗长库进行打分以量化联合时频聚集度；用窗长trellis以每帧线性复杂度聚合O(3^M)候选窗长调度，并获得相对任意k次分辨率切换后见调度O((k+1)log M)的累积mix-loss regret界；利用傅里叶变换线性性，对候选库取后验期望得到等效于自适应有效窗的单一谱；采用包络归一化合成流保证精确重叠相加重建。

Result: 在合成信号与海洋生物声学信号上验证：可实现自适应分辨率跟踪、谱聚集度提升，并具备精确的时域可逆性。

Conclusion: U-STFT以序贯方式化解STFT的分辨率权衡，在保持单谱输出与精确重建的同时获得有理论保证的自适应时频表示，适用于非平稳信号分析。

Abstract: The short-time Fourier transform (STFT) characterizes the local frequency content of time-varying signals by evaluating the discrete Fourier transform over a sliding analysis window. The STFT is governed by a fundamental resolution trade-off: a short window localizes rapid transients in time at the cost of frequency resolution, whereas a long window resolves closely spaced harmonics at the expense of temporal resolution. The Universal Short-Time Fourier Transform (U-STFT) resolves this trade-off sequentially by modeling the analysis window duration as a data-adaptive state variable that indexes the number of hops included in the current observation interval. At each frame, a bank of candidate window durations is scored using normalized order-three Rényi entropy to quantify joint time-frequency concentration. A window length trellis aggregates the resulting $\mathcal{O}(3^M)$ candidate window schedules with linear complexity per frame, guaranteeing a cumulative mix-loss regret bound of $\mathcal{O}((k+1)\log M)$ relative to any hindsight window schedule with $k$ resolution changes over $M$ frames. By linearity of the Fourier transform, posterior expectation across the candidate bank yields a single spectrum equivalent to an STFT evaluated with a data-adaptive effective window, while an envelope-normalized synthesis stream guarantees exact overlap-add reconstruction. Evaluations on synthetic and marine bioacoustic signals demonstrate adaptive resolution tracking, enhanced spectral concentration, and exact time-domain invertibility.

</details>


### [469] [Doppler-Shannon Association in Vehicular Networks: A Stochastic Geometry Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37928)
*Ashutosh Balakrishnan,Francois Baccelli,Sanjoy Kumar Jhawar,Philippe Martins*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文基于随机几何框架，将多普勒频移通过相干时间建模到物理层网络性能中，提出多普勒频移感知的效用函数与超越最近BS准则的关联策略，证明所提多普勒-香农关联性能优于经典香农关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车联网中高移动性导致多普勒频移，使衰落信道呈强时变性，而传统蜂窝网络的最近基站关联策略忽略了多普勒效应与方向性因素，需要新的理论框架与关联策略。

Method: 构建二维与三维PPP下多普勒频移的统计模型，分析其分布及几何影响因素；提出多普勒频移感知效用，刻画时变衰落链路中多普勒诱导的可达香农速率；基于视距条件下距离、基站运动方向与衰落增益联合设计最优关联策略，并解析推导中断与覆盖概率。

Result: 最近基站不再是最优关联，基站覆盖呈非凸图样；解析与仿真表明需引入多普勒校正以补充理想SNR香农性能，所提多普勒-香农关联的覆盖性能优于经典香农关联。

Conclusion: 将多普勒频移纳入关联决策可显著提升车联网性能，为时变衰落下的基站关联与覆盖分析提供了新的随机几何分析工具与策略依据。

Abstract: Historically, in cellular networks, the user equipment (UE) association with a base station (BS) has been largely confined to nearest BS association strategies. Unlike cellular networks wherein the BSs are static, vehicular networks are prone to high mobility, resulting in the UE experiencing a Doppler shift. The Doppler shift further results in the fading channel exhibiting high temporal variability. In this work, we present a novel stochastic geometry framework, modeling the effects of the Doppler shift on the physical layer network performance through the coherence time. First, the statistics of the Doppler shift are studied in a two- and three-dimensional Poisson point process (PPP) setting. The distribution and the geometric factors influencing the Doppler shift are analyzed. Next, we propose Doppler shift aware utilities, modeling the Doppler shift induced Shannon rate achievable in time-selective fading links. Through these utilities, we analytically study the outage and coverage probabilities for a UE to achieve a given quality of service. These probabilities are computed based on the optimal BS association in vehicular networks, which goes beyond the closest Euclidean distance. In the UE-BS line of sight, the novel BS association policies factor the BS direction of motion and the fading gain, in addition to the Euclidean distance. We show that the nearest BS is no longer the optimal BS association, resulting in non-convex coverage tessellations associated with the BSs. Our analytical and simulation results illustrate the need for a Doppler shift correction, complementing the ideal SNR based Shannon performance. The network performance achieved through the proposed Doppler-Shannon based association is proved, analytically as well as through simulations, to be superior to the classical Shannon based association.

</details>


### [470] [Neuroscience of Improvisation Across Music and Other Domains: A Survey and Outlook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37958)
*Levina Perzhilla,Muhammad Mahboob Ur Rahman,Tareq Y. Al-Naffouri*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该综述指出即兴神经科学证据严重偏向音乐领域，系统梳理音乐即兴的多模态神经影像证据，并拓展至舞蹈、戏剧、体育、教育、治疗与专业实践，结论是当前不存在即兴的普遍神经标记，并提出可穿戴EEG-fNIRS与闭环BCI用于音乐即兴的展望。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即兴行为广泛存在于音乐、舞蹈、戏剧、体育、教育、治疗与专业实践中，但其神经科学研究几乎只集中于音乐领域。作者通过PRISMA式检索量化了这一失衡：111项研究中70.3%涉及音乐即兴或一般心理测量学创造力，导致既有综述要么以音乐为中心，要么局限于单一构念，缺乏跨领域整合。

Method: 采用PRISMA式文献检索进行量化统计；在音乐领域，系统组织fMRI、EEG、fNIRS、超扫描、神经反馈与脑刺激等多模态证据，并透明区分证据一致之处（如额叶参与的经验依赖性变化、额区alpha与theta功率升高）与异质之处（如外侧前额叶活动方向、半球偏侧化、alpha功率解释）；随后将综述扩展至舞蹈、戏剧、体育、教育、治疗与专业实践等以行为学、质性及仿真研究为主的领域。

Result: 检索识别111项研究，其中70.3%聚焦音乐即兴或一般创造力；音乐领域部分结论可重复（经验依赖性额叶参与变化、额区alpha/theta功率升高），但外侧前额叶激活方向、半球偏侧化及alpha功率的解释存在明显异质性；其他领域证据以行为学与质性研究为主，缺乏定量神经影像支持。

Conclusion: 现有证据在音乐领域内部及其他领域均未指向即兴的普遍神经特征（universal neural signature）。作者展望将可穿戴EEG-fNIRS传感与闭环脑机接口应用于证据较充分的音乐即兴，将其表述为"专业技能门控的控制问题"（expertise-gated control problem），作为刻意练习的可能补充，并列出其他领域尚需补充的证据清单。

Abstract: Improvisation (or Improv), the real-time generation of novel, context-appropriate action, occurs in music, dance, theater, sport, education, therapy, and professional practice. Its neuroscience, however, has been studied almost exclusively for music, where most quantitative neuroimaging evidence lies. A PRISMA-style search done by authors quantifies this imbalance: of 111 identified studies, 70.3\% concern musical improvisation or general psychometric creativity. This explains why earlier surveys are either music-centered or confined to a single construct. This survey addresses that gap in two ways. First, for music, it organizes findings from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), electroencephalography (EEG), functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), hyperscanning, neurofeedback, and brain stimulation, and reports transparently where the evidence agrees (e.g., experience-dependent changes in frontal engagement, increased frontal alpha and theta power) and where it is heterogeneous (e.g., the direction of lateral prefrontal activity, hemispheric lateralization, the interpretation of alpha power). Second, it extends the review to dance, theater, sport, education, therapy, and professional practice, where behavioral, qualitative, and simulation-based studies predominate. Overall, the current evidence does not point to a universal neural signature of improvisation within music domain or other domains. We conclude with an outlook on wearable EEG--fNIRS sensing and closed-loop brain--computer interfaces for musical improvisation, the domain with sufficient evidence, formulated as an expertise-gated control problem and discussed as a possible complement to deliberate practice, and we list the evidence needed for other domains.

</details>


### [471] [A Subsample Time-Delay Estimator with a Farrow Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37980)
*Hugh L. Kennedy*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于Farrow结构可变分数延迟(VFD)滤波器组的宽带信号亚采样时延估计新方法,将MSE表示为滤波器延迟的多项式并取局部极小值定位时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典亚采样时延估计(GCC类)在中等及以上信噪比条件下精度受限,需要一种能实现亚采样精度且计算结构高效的替代方案。

Method: 定义基于均方误差(MSE)的失配度量,用FIR可变分数延迟(VFD)滤波器组对该度量进行评估;采用Farrow结构使MSE功率成为滤波器延迟的多项式函数,该函数在未知真实信号时延处存在局部极小,据此估计时延。

Result: 蒙特卡洛仿真显示,在信噪比不低(≥10 dB)时,所提估计器的性能优于广义互相关(GCC)方法。

Conclusion: 基于Farrow-VFD滤波器组的MSE极小化估计器为宽带信号亚采样时延估计提供了优于GCC的可行方案,其优势体现在中高信噪比区间。

Abstract: A novel solution to the classical problem of subsample time-delay estimation (TDE) for a wideband signal received by two adjacent sensors is described. A mean squared-error (MSE) measure of dissimilarity is defined and evaluated using a variable fractional-delay (VFD) filter bank with a finite impulse response (FIR). Using a filter bank with a Farrow structure allows the MSE power to be expressed as a polynomial function of the filter delay with a local minimum at the unknown signal delay. In Monte-Carlo simulations, the proposed estimator outperforms the generalized cross-correlation (GCC) technique when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is not low (less than 10 dB).

</details>


### [472] [Forward-Backward Map Matching for Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38047)
*Joseph O'Leary,Tapio Simula,Tom Kimpson,Corey Davey,Wenchao Li,Andrew D. Greentree,Allison Kealy*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 将磁异常地图匹配建模为链式因子图上的推断，用前向-后向算法逐段求解，得到离散后验分布及其香农熵，并以此熵作为无需真值的导航歧义性诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机载磁异常导航可提供被动、抗干扰的定位，但现有地图匹配算法各有缺陷：EKF假设高斯后验，粒子滤波需蒙特卡洛采样，Viterbi算法舍弃后验不确定性只保留单条最优路径。

Method: 把地图匹配表述为链式结构因子图上的推断问题，按段使用前向-后向算法求解，获得候选位置的离散后验及t时刻的香农熵H_t；在Renfrew_395地图上进行10^3次合成试验与10^3条航迹评估，并与EKF、粒子滤波对比；同时以段级熵阈值检测大误差段。

Result: 10^3次合成试验中中位位置误差32.7 m，比中位惯性漂移362 m低91%；在该批试验和10^3条航迹上，中位误差分别比EKF和粒子滤波低43%；熵阈值可检出误差超过两个地图网格的段中的47%、超过三个网格的段中的94%，误报率为10%。

Conclusion: H_t提供了无需真值的、由地图条件决定的后验不确定性诊断，可用于识别导航歧义性，结果表明基于因子图的前向-后向推断在精度与不确定性量化上均优于EKF、粒子滤波与Viterbi方法。

Abstract: Airborne magnetic anomaly navigation provides a passive, unjammable alternative to Global Navigation Satellite Systems positioning by matching magnetometer measurements against a lithospheric magnetic anomaly map. Existing map-matching algorithms either assume a Gaussian posterior (extended Kalman filter), require Monte Carlo sampling (particle filter), or discard posterior uncertainty in favour of a single optimal path (Viterbi algorithm). Here we formulate map matching as inference on a chain-structured factor graph and solve it segment by segment using the forward-backward algorithm, which yields a discrete posterior over candidate positions and its Shannon entropy $H_t$ at time $t$. Over the \texttt{Renfrew\_395} map, $10^3$ synthetic trials yield a median position error of $32.7$ m, $91\%$ below the median inertial drift of $362$ m. On these trials and $10^3$ flight paths, the median error is $43\%$ below the extended Kalman filter and particle filter. Across these paths, a threshold on segment-level entropy detects $47\%$ of segments with errors above two map cells and $94\%$ of those above three, at a $10\%$ false-alarm rate. The foregoing results indicate that $H_t$ provides a truth-free diagnostic of map-conditioned navigation ambiguity.

</details>


### [473] [Covariance Learning for Direction-of-Arrival Estimation with Sparse Linear Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38123)
*Majdoddin Esfandiari,Esa Ollila,Geert Leus,Daniel P. Palomar*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文提出基于协方差学习（CL）的网格化与无网格DOA估计器，适用于任意稀疏线阵几何，通过最小化Type-II负对数似然联合估计源功率与阵元噪声方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统协方差学习需在特定阵列结构下才能高效求解，缺乏对任意稀疏线阵（SLA）几何的通用DOA估计方案，且需同时处理未知的阵元噪声方差。

Method: 网格化估计器在角度网格上以逐次凸近似（SCA）最小化Type-II目标函数，并用标量二分搜索估计噪声方差；随后以牛顿法在连续域上对各网格DOA进行无网格精化。

Result: 在六阵元嵌套阵仿真中（含九个源的欠定场景），所提估计器在同时估计噪声方差的情况下仍优于现有先进方法。

Conclusion: 基于CL的网格化与无网格组合框架可推广至任意SLA几何，并实现高精度、可处理欠定情形的DOA估计。

Abstract: Covariance learning (CL) estimates source powers and sensor-noise variance by minimizing the Type-II (marginal) negative log-likelihood of the array measurements. We develop both grid-based and gridless CL direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimators applicable to arbitrary sparse linear array (SLA) geometries. The grid-based DOA estimator minimizes the Type-II objective on an angular grid via successive convex approximation (SCA) and estimates the noise variance by a scalar bisection search. The gridless DOA estimator then refines each grid-based DOA over the continuum using a Newton method. Simulations on a six-sensor nested array, including an underdetermined case with nine sources, show that the proposed DOA estimators outperform state-of-the-art methods, despite jointly estimating the sensor noise variance.

</details>


### [474] [Two-Layer Microwave Linear Analog Computer (MiLAC)-Aided Multi-User MIMO Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38213)
*Xiaohua Zhou,Tianyu Fang,Matteo Nerini,Yijie Mao,Bruno Clerckx*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出双层MiLAC辅助的发射波束成形架构，利用多端口微波网络理论建模，证明其配合无损互易MiLAC可等效实现任意全数字发射波束成形器，并在下行多用户MIMO中达到与全数字方案相同的和速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微波线性模拟计算机（MiLAC）直接在模拟域处理信号，是全数字与混合波束成形的潜在替代方案；但已有研究表明，发射端单个无损互易MiLAC在多用户场景下一般无法达到全数字波束成形的性能，需突破此限制。

Method: 1）提出双层MiLAC辅助发射波束成形架构；2）基于多端口微波网络理论建立符合物理的通用模型，并在单边、完美匹配放大器假设下导出简化模型；3）证明等效性：双层MiLAC发射端可实现任意全数字发射波束成形器，单层MiLAC接收端可达到全数字线性合并器的可达速率；4）推导全数字波束成形器/合并器到MiLAC模拟实现的闭式映射；5）构建和速率最大化问题，提出联合设计功率分配与散射矩阵的优化框架。

Result: 理论分析得到验证；所提双层MiLAC设计在多用户MIMO网络中取得与全数字对应方案相同的和速率性能。

Conclusion: 双层MiLAC结构通过发射端级联两层无损互易网络克服了单层MiLAC的容量瓶颈，实现了与全数字波束成形的严格等效，并给出可落地的闭式映射与联合优化设计方法，为模拟域波束成形提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Microwave linear analog computer (MiLAC)-aided beamforming, which performs signal processing directly in the analog domain, has recently emerged as a promising alternative to fully digital and hybrid beamforming for multi-antenna systems. However, existing studies have shown that a single lossless and reciprocal MiLAC at the transmitter cannot, in general, attain the performance of fully digital beamforming in multi-user scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we propose a two-layer MiLAC-aided transmit beamforming architecture for downlink multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) networks. Leveraging multiport microwave network theory, we first establish a general physics-compliant model of the proposed architecture, and then derive a simplified model under the assumptions of unilateral and perfectly matched amplifiers. We prove that, with lossless and reciprocal MiLACs, the two-layer MiLAC-aided transmitter can realize any fully digital transmit beamformer, while a single-layer MiLAC-aided receiver can attain the same achievable rate as a fully digital linear combiner. We then derive closed-form mappings from fully digital transmit beamformers and receive combiners to their corresponding MiLAC-aided analog implementations. Based on these equivalence results, we formulate a sum-rate maximization problem for the considered multi-user MIMO network and develop an optimization framework for jointly designing the power allocation and scattering matrices of the MiLAC-aided transceivers. Numerical results validate the theoretical analysis and show that the proposed two-layer MiLAC-aided design attains the same sum-rate performance as its fully digital counterpart.

</details>


### [475] [Adaptive Orbit-Aided Vector Tracking for Orbit Determination of LEO Satellites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38380)
*Zihong Zhou,Bing Xu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出自适应轨道辅助矢量跟踪（OAVT）算法，将GNSS矢量跟踪环与低精度轨道动力学模型松耦合，用于CubeSat在LEO-PNT场景下的可靠定轨。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CubeSat定轨受限于单频GNSS码基接收机、信号间歇接收和高动态轨道条件，传统标量跟踪与独立矢量跟踪在信号退化时易失锁或无法给出有效解，亟需提升解算鲁棒性与状态连续性。

Method: 以GNSS矢量跟踪环（VTL）作为主导航估计器，与低精度轨道动力学模型（ODM）松耦合，由ODM提供位置与速度伪量测；通过基于GNSS应力水平及ODM与GNSS解残差一致性的自适应协方差分配来调节ODM贡献权重。

Result: 标称条件下OAVT保持VTL精度优势：三维位置RMSE由STL的2.631 m降至1.081 m，三维速度RMSE由0.3985 m/s降至0.1023 m/s。退化条件下鲁棒性显著优于STL与独立VTL：完全信号中断时位置RMSE为8.27 m，渐进失锁与重捕为10.17 m，可见性变化为26.65 m，而STL无法给出有效解、独立VTL失锁。

Conclusion: OAVT在仅适度增加计算负担的前提下显著提升解的鲁棒性与状态连续性，适用于CubeSat定轨及未来LEO-PNT任务。

Abstract: Reliable orbit determination for CubeSats is essential for emerging low-Earth-orbit positioning, navigation, and timing (LEO-PNT) applications. However, onboard orbit determination remains constrained by single-frequency GNSS code-based receivers, intermittent signal reception, and highly dynamic orbital conditions. This paper proposes an adaptive orbit-aided vector tracking (OAVT) algorithm for LEO-PNT CubeSat orbit determination under these conditions. The method employs a GNSS vector tracking loop (VTL) as the primary navigation estimator and loosely couples it with a low-fidelity orbital dynamics model (ODM), which provides auxiliary position and velocity pseudo-measurements. The contribution of the ODM is regulated through adaptive covariance assignment based on GNSS stress and the residual consistency between the ODM and GNSS solutions. Under nominal conditions, OAVT preserves the accuracy advantage of VTL over the conventional scalar tracking loop. The 3D position root-mean-square error (RMSE) is reduced from 2.631\,m for STL to 1.081\,m, while the 3D velocity RMSE decreases from 0.3985\,m/s to 0.1023\,m/s. Under degraded conditions, OAVT provides substantially greater robustness than both STL and standalone VTL. The 3D position RMSE remains bounded at 8.27\,m during a complete signal outage, 10.17\,m during gradual signal loss and reacquisition, and 26.65\,m under variable visibility, whereas STL fails to produce valid solutions and standalone VTL loses lock. These results demonstrate that OAVT substantially improves solution robustness and state continuity with only a moderate increase in computational burden, making it suitable for CubeSat orbit determination and future LEO-PNT missions.

</details>


### [476] [Beyond Fresnel Approximation: Exact Airy Beamforming for Near-Field THz Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38395)
*Fangjie Shen,Weidong Mei,Aoran Liu,Peilan Wang,Zhi Chen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对太赫兹通信中视距遮挡问题，提出基于精确焦距离表达式与焦散几何的Airy波束成形设计方法，联合优化弯曲曲率、虚拟焦距与转向角以最大化接收功率，数值验证其优于传统Airy波束设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太赫兹通信中视距遮挡会严重降低传统聚焦波束性能；Airy弯曲波束可在近场沿曲线传播绕过障碍，但现有设计多采用Fresnel近似计算焦距离，在大转向角或短传播距离下不准确，限制了波束性能。

Method: 基于精确焦距离表达式及相应焦散几何构建Airy波束成形设计；在接收机对准与避障约束下联合优化弯曲曲率、虚拟焦距和转向角以最大化接收信号功率；先用几何预处理缩小弯曲曲率可行域，再采用两层优化框架（外层优化曲率，内层优化其余两参数）求解该非凸问题。

Result: 基于级联几何-波信道模型的数值结果表明，所提方法相比传统Airy波束设计获得更高接收信号功率，且在不同遮挡比例下相较传统聚焦波束具有互补优势。

Conclusion: 采用精确焦距离表达式可提升Airy波束设计精度与接收功率，弯曲波束与传统聚焦波束在不同遮挡条件下可形成互补，为太赫兹抗遮挡波束成形提供有效方案。

Abstract: Line-of-sight (LoS) blockage can severely degrade the performance of conventional focused beams in terahertz (THz) communications. Recently, bending beams (e.g., Airy beams) have attracted increasing attention due to their ability to bypass obstacles by propagating along curved trajectories under near-field propagation conditions. However, existing Airy-beam designs in wireless communications often rely on the Fresnel approximation for the focal distance, which becomes inaccurate at large steering angles or short propagation distances. To address this limitation, this letter proposes a more accurate Airy beamforming design method based on the exact focal-distance expression and the corresponding caustic geometry. Specifically, we jointly optimize the bending curvature, virtual focal distance, and steering angle to maximize the received signal power subject to receiver-alignment and obstacle-avoidance constraints. To tackle the resulting non-convex problem, we first use geometric preprocessing to narrow the feasible range of the bending curvature. Then, a two-layer optimization framework is developed with the outer and inner layers optimizing the bending curvature and the other two parameters, respectively. Numerical results based on the cascaded geometrical and wave channel model demonstrate that the proposed method achieves higher received signal power than conventional Airy-beam designs and offers complementary advantages over conventional focused beams under different blockage ratios.

</details>


### [477] [Movable Beyond-Diagonal RIS for ISAC: Optimal Placement and Pareto Boundary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38483)
*Chandan Kumar Sheemar,Sourabh Solanki,Symeon Chatzinotas*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究可移动超越对角（BD-RIS）辅助的通感一体化系统，推导了全连接BD-RIS在秩一视距信道下的精确通信—感知Pareto边界，并给出最优部署与消除照明权衡所需的最小轨迹孔径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可移动RIS为通感一体化提供新的空间自由度，但BD-RIS在通信与感知之间的照明权衡机理及其部署准则尚不清晰，需要量化Pareto边界并明确可移动性带来的增益条件。

Method: 在基站—RIS秩一视距信道假设下，以用户—目标信道相关性为变量推导全连接BD-RIS的精确通信—感知Pareto边界；针对视距RIS链路证明最大化信道相关性即为最优放置；刻画消除照明权衡所需的最小轨迹孔径，并证明超阈值时可移动对角RIS可达到同等最优；阈值以下采用动态规划给出有保证精度的放置算法。

Result: 得到全连接BD-RIS的闭式Pareto边界；给出最大化相关性的最优放置准则；确定消除照明权衡的最小轨迹孔径阈值，并证明超阈值时对角RIS与全连接BD-RIS性能等价；阈值以下动态规划提供可证明的放置精度。数值结果考察了硬件连接方式、角度失配与莱斯衰落的影响。

Conclusion: 可移动BD-RIS的通感性能由用户—目标信道相关性主导，合理设计轨迹孔径可使简单对角结构达到全连接BD-RIS的最优性能，硬件复杂度与移动范围之间存在明确折中。

Abstract: This letter investigates integrated sensing and communication using a movable beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surface (BD-RIS). Under a rank-one line-of-sight BS--RIS channel, we derive the exact communication--sensing Pareto boundary of a fully-connected BD-RIS in terms of user--target channel correlation. For line-of-sight RIS links, maximizing this correlation yields the optimal placement. We characterize the minimum track aperture that eliminates the illumination trade-off and show that a movable diagonal RIS then attains the same optimum. Below this threshold, a dynamic program offers certified placement accuracy. Numerical results examine hardware connectivity, angular mismatch, and Rician fading.

</details>


### [478] [A Parallel Two-Stage Prony Framework for Robust Delay-Doppler Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38484)
*Liangchen Sun,Yutaka Jitsumatsu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于OTFS单导频波形的并行双阶Prony估计框架，实现离格时延-多普勒参数估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双选择性信道下OTFS导频的时延-多普勒参数常处于离格位置，单阶Prony类估计器在近距离多径与分数时延-多普勒失配下易产生模糊，估计稳定性不足。

Method: 基于已知的频移sinc脉冲结构的单导频波形，构建并行双阶估计框架：多普勒优先（Doppler-first）与时延优先（delay-first）两条Prony流程并发执行，并对两路候选路径进行联合融合。

Result: 两种估计顺序具有互补的分辨特性，可缓解近距离多径分量及分数时延-多普勒失配造成的模糊；数值结果表明相较单阶Prony估计器，检测可靠性与估计稳定性提升，在离格场景及中低信噪比区间尤为明显。

Conclusion: 并行双阶Prony框架通过顺序互补与路径融合，有效改善OTFS离格时延-多普勒参数估计性能，适合中低信噪比与离格条件。

Abstract: This paper addresses off-grid physical delay-Doppler parameter estimation based on an orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) pilot waveform over doubly selective channels. Based on a known single-pilot waveform with a frequency-shifted sinc pulse structure, we propose a parallel dual-order estimation framework, in which Prony-based Doppler-first and delay-first procedures are executed concurrently and their candidate paths are jointly fused. The two estimation orders provide complementary resolution characteristics, thereby mitigating ambiguities caused by closely spaced multipath components and fractional delay--Doppler mismatch. Numerical results show that the proposed framework improves detection reliability and estimation stability compared with a single-order Prony estimator, especially in off-grid scenarios and low-to-moderate signal-to-noise ratio regimes.

</details>


### [479] [pCoRev: Physics-Informed Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Reverberation Artifact Suppression in Ultrafast Plane-Wave Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38523)
*Hyunwoo Cho,Yeeun Kwon,Yangmo Yoo,Jinbum Kang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出无监督物理信息对比学习框架pCoRev，利用组织回波与混响伪影的角度相干性差异，仅用单角度I/Q帧输入即可抑制超快平面波成像中的混响伪影，无需无伪影配对数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超快平面波（PW）成像中的混响伪影抑制困难：缺乏无伪影参考数据，且多径回波与组织信号相似。相干平面波复合（CPWC）只能部分抑制混响，并牺牲了PW成像赖以成立的高帧率优势。

Method: 提出pCoRev：无监督、物理信息驱动的对比学习框架，利用组织回波与混响伪影在角度相干性上的差异。网络输入为单角度I/Q帧；同一CPWC采集中其余角度提供角度一致的正样本对，由残差导出的负样本对，以及相干性引导的自监督，因此无需配对的無伪影数据。由于以单角度输入训练，网络也可直接用于单次PW发射。

Result: 在含31次验证采集的混响体模上，pCoRev取得最佳CR（38.76±5.40 dB）、CNR（11.75±1.81 dB）和gCNR（0.932±0.051），优于DAS、DMAS、监督式3D CNN和无监督深度相干学习。单角度下CR为32.10±7.79 dB、CNR为10.39±3.02 dB，超过75角度复合DAS（20.45±3.84 dB与8.38±2.00 dB），而发射次数少75倍。在其他扫描仪的四次临床采集上，无需微调即比DAS的CR提升9–21 dB。

Conclusion: 物理信息驱动的无监督对比学习能有效抑制混响，同时保留超快PW成像的帧率优势，并具备跨扫描仪泛化能力。

Abstract: Reverberation artifact suppression in ultrafast plane-wave (PW) imaging remains challenging because artifact-free reference data are generally unavailable and multipath echoes often resemble tissue signals. Coherent plane-wave compounding (CPWC) attenuates reverberation only partially and sacrifices the frame rate that motivates PW imaging. We propose pCoRev, an unsupervised physics-informed contrastive learning framework that leverages the distinct angular coherence characteristics of tissue echoes and reverberation artifacts. A single-angle I/Q frame is the network input, and the remaining angles of the same CPWC acquisition provide angle-consistent positive pairs, residual-derived negative pairs, and coherence-guided self-supervision, so no paired artifact-free data are required. On a fabricated reverberation phantom with 31 validation acquisitions, pCoRev achieved the best contrast ratio (CR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and generalized CNR (gCNR) of 38.76 +/- 5.40 dB, 11.75 +/- 1.81 dB, and 0.932 +/- 0.051 against delay-and-sum (DAS), delay-multiply-and-sum, a supervised 3D convolutional neural network, and unsupervised deep coherence learning. Because the network is trained on single-angle inputs, it also operates on a single PW transmission: with one angle, pCoRev reached a CR of 32.10 +/- 7.79 dB and a CNR of 10.39 +/- 3.02 dB, exceeding 75-angle compounded DAS (20.45 +/- 3.84 dB and 8.38 +/- 2.00 dB) with 75-fold fewer transmissions. On four clinical acquisitions from other scanners, pCoRev improved CR over DAS by 9 to 21 dB without fine-tuning. These results indicate that physics-informed unsupervised contrastive learning suppresses reverberation effectively while preserving the frame-rate advantage of ultrafast PW imaging.

</details>


### [480] [Finite-State Uncertainty-Aware Widely-Linear Equalization for Aeronautical GMSK Links](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38638)
*Ahmad Tanha,Ali Khalesi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种面向GMSK链路的有限状态、不确定性感知的广泛线性（WL）均衡算法：利用同步估计及其可靠性描述量从少量预计算滤波器中选取，避免在线重复合成系数，并用有限记忆Laurent模型从条件物理状态矩设计存储的仿射WL滤波器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空与无人机接收机需在同步不确定、机载算力与存储受限的条件下均衡双选择性信道；点估计式WL时变MMSE均衡忽略同步估计的不确定性，而在线自适应合成系数计算代价高。

Method: 以同步估计与可靠性描述量作为路由信息，在小规模预计算滤波器库中选择一个；基于有限记忆Laurent模型，由条件物理状态矩构造仿射WL滤波器；给出相对连续边信息自适应的超额MSE精确刻画、有限状态设计的Lloyd型条件、局部时频失配证书，以及设计损失与信息损失的正交分解。

Result: 参考信道Eb/N0=8 dB、高同步估计不确定性下，16状态库相较点估计WL时变MMSE均衡降低伪符号MSE 51.9%，相较后验均值（PM）替代降低6.6%；相同划分、路由与存储下，条件矩滤波器相较代表状态滤波器MSE降低10.1%、全波形ABER降低15.6%；18条合成三径信道上（各自拟合滤波器库）MSE与ABER分别较PM替代降低5.3%与12.9%；16状态接收机存储2048个实系数。

Conclusion: 有限状态、不确定性感知的WL均衡以极小滤波器库与固定存储实现显著精度提升；后验积分、鲁棒性扫描与软件计时测量刻画了均衡精度、在线计算开销与滤波器库刷新之间的权衡。

Abstract: Aeronautical and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) receivers must equalize doubly selective channels under synchronization uncertainty and limited onboard computation and memory. We propose a finite-state, uncertainty-aware widely-linear (WL) equalization algorithm for Gaussian minimum-shift keying (GMSK) links. The algorithm uses synchronization estimates and their reliability descriptors to select one of a small number of precomputed filters, avoiding repeated online coefficient synthesis. Using a finite-memory Laurent model, we design the stored affine WL filters from conditional physical-state moments. We derive an exact characterization of excess mean-square error (MSE) relative to adaptation to continuous side information, Lloyd-type conditions for finite-state design, local timing--frequency mismatch certificates, and an orthogonal decomposition of design and information losses. On a reference channel at $E_b/N_0=8$~dB under high synchronization-estimation uncertainty, a $16$-state bank reduces pseudo-symbol MSE by $51.9\%$ relative to point-estimate WL time-varying MMSE equalization and by $6.6\%$ relative to posterior-mean (PM) substitution. With identical partitioning, routing, and storage, conditional-moment filters reduce MSE by $10.1\%$ and full-waveform average bit error rate (ABER) by $15.6\%$ relative to representative-state filters. Across $18$ synthetic three-path channels with individually fitted banks, MSE and ABER decrease by $5.3\%$ and $12.9\%$, respectively, relative to PM substitution. The $16$-state receiver stores $2048$ real coefficients. Posterior integration, robustness sweeps, and software timing measurements quantify the tradeoff between equalization accuracy, online computational cost, and bank refresh.

</details>


### [481] [Channel State Information-Free Angle Spoofing for Differential Localization Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38756)
*Lei Lyu,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种无需CSI的角度欺骗策略，即使窃听者使用差分统计估计发射机位置仍然有效；通过预编码矩阵使Eve错误估计离开角差（ADoD），而合法用户Bob借助少量安全共享边信息仍可获知真实位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统角度欺骗依赖CSI且难以对抗使用差分统计进行定位的窃听者，需要在无CSI条件下仍能误导Eve定位、同时保证Bob可用。

Method: 设计预编码矩阵，使Eve对ADoD差值的估计产生偏差，从而在伪造几何下定位偏移；在预编码器关键参数上分析Eve的定位偏差并证明其可渐近趋于无穷；Bob利用少量安全共享边信息恢复真实位置。与已有无CSI欺骗策略联合可进一步恶化Eve性能。

Result: 理论分析表明Eve的定位偏差可随预编码器关键参数渐近趋于无穷；仿真显示Eve出现显著定位误差，与现有无CSI欺骗策略结合时Eve性能进一步下降。

Conclusion: 该无CSI角度欺骗方案对采用差分统计的窃听者稳健有效，可在不牺牲Bob定位能力的前提下显著破坏Eve定位精度。

Abstract: This paper proposes a channel state information (CSI)-free angle spoofing strategy that remains effective even when the eavesdropper (Eve) uses differential statistics to estimate the location of the transmitter (Alice). Specifically, by designing a precoding matrix, Eve incorrectly estimates the angle differences of departure (ADoDs), thereby spoofing Alice's location. Meanwhile, the trusted user (Bob) can still infer Alice's true location with a modest amount of securely shared side information. Given the channel parameters estimated by Eve from the spoofed channel, the resulting localization bias introduced to the eavesdroppers under the spoofed geometric is analyzed. Eve's bias can be driven to infinity asymptotically in a key parameter of the precoder. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method introduces significant localization errors for Eve. When combined with a prior CSI-free spoofing strategy, further degraded performance is achieved by Eve.

</details>


### [482] [A Sub-Aperture-Based Ray-Tracing Framework for Near-Field U-MIMO THz Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38772)
*Federico Ruggeri,Sotiris Droulias,Jiming Chen,Angeliki Alexiou,Jie Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文将射线追踪(RT)扩展到近场(NF)区，通过把发射阵列孔径分割为若干发射远场贡献的子孔径并借助几何光学(GO)传播，实现近场超大规模MIMO太赫兹通信的波束表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太赫兹通信采用大孔径天线、近场区域显著，亟需灵活的波束操控与高效信道建模手段；传统RT基于远场假设，全波方法计算代价高，缺少能在近场刻画发射阵列波束的射线级方法。

Method: 将发射阵列建模为天线孔径，把孔径划分为多个子孔径，每个子孔径产生远场贡献，再用几何光学(GO)进行传播；基于该框架开发射线发射(Ray-Launching)算法，并通过可调的孔径划分参数控制精度。

Result: 与全波传播结果对比评估波束重构精度，结果显示通过可调孔径划分，该方法能够以GO射线传播复现近场U-MIMO太赫兹通信中典型的波束操控效应。

Conclusion: RT可经孔径分割扩展至近场区，成为一种兼具精度与效率的射线级近场波束表征工具；孔径划分是可调控精度与代价的关键参数。

Abstract: Terahertz (THz) communications are characterized by antennas with large apertures and extended near-field (NF) region, offering the opportunity to develop adaptable beam manipulation strategies, particularly related to ultra-massive MIMO (U-MIMO). While Ray-Tracing (RT) offers an attractive alternative to full-wave methods, conventional ray-based approaches are generally formulated under far-field (FF) assumptions. We propose a technique that extends RT to the NF regime, enabling ray-based NF characterization of transmitting arrays. We model the transmitting array as an antenna aperture and develop a RT framework that partitions the transmitting aperture into sub-apertures emitting FF contributions which can be propagated via geometric optics (GO). We develop a Ray-Launching algorithm based on the proposed framework and assess its beam-reconstruction accuracy against full-wave propagation. The results demonstrate that, through tunable aperture partitioning, the proposed approach can reproduce beam manipulation effects characteristic of NF U-MIMO THz communications using GO ray propagation.

</details>


### [483] [Joint Antenna Position and Beamforming Optimization for Movable Antenna Enabled Near-Field ISAC Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38794)
*Luis Ebner,Alireza Navi,Mohamed-Amine Lahmeri,Sebastian Lotter,Lutz Lampe,Robert Schober*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究可移动天线（MA）赋能的近场ISAC系统，通过联合优化收发天线位置与发射波束成形，最小化二维PSF的积分旁瓣电平（ISL）与峰值旁瓣电平（PSL）加权和，在满足通信速率与功率等约束下显著抑制旁瓣并提升成像分辨能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近场ISAC需同时实现二维雷达成像与多用户下行通信，但固定位置天线阵列的PSF旁瓣高，导致成像质量下降并产生鬼影目标伪影。MA可在不增加阵元数的前提下提供额外空间自由度以抑制旁瓣，同时兼顾通信需求。

Method: 构建以ISL与PSL加权和为目标、受通信速率、照射功率、发射功率及天线布放约束的联合优化问题，同时优化收发天线位置与发射波束成形；针对非凸性，提出融合粒子群优化（PSO）与遗传算法（GA）的混合交替优化（AO）框架求解。

Result: 在所考虑阵列配置中取得最低ISL，相较基准方案PSL至少降低5 dB；优化阵列可分辨反射率相差6 dB的两个紧邻目标，优于随机阵列、Mills Cross阵列与矩形阵列，且满足最小用户吞吐量要求。

Conclusion: MA赋能的近场ISAC通过空间自由度与波束成形联合设计，可有效抑制二维PSF旁瓣、缓解鬼影伪影，并在保证通信性能的同时提升雷达成像分辨力，验证了MA在近场通感一体化中的潜力。

Abstract: Near-field (NF) integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems enable simultaneous two-dimensional (2D) radar imaging and multi-user downlink communication. However, fixed-position antenna arrays can exhibit high sidelobes in the point spread function (PSF), which degrade imaging performance and cause ghost-target artifacts. Movable antennas (MAs) offer additional spatial degrees of freedom to suppress these sidelobes while meeting communication requirements, without increasing the number of antenna elements. In this paper, we investigate MA-enabled NF ISAC by jointly optimizing the transmit and receive antenna positions and the transmit beamforming to minimize a weighted sum of the integrated sidelobe level (ISL) and peak sidelobe level (PSL) of the 2D PSF, subject to communication-rate, illumination-power, transmit-power, and antenna-placement constraints. To tackle the resulting non-convex problem, we propose a hybrid alternating optimization (AO) framework that combines particle swarm optimization with a genetic algorithm. Our numerical results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves the lowest ISL among the considered array configurations and reduces the PSL by at least 5 dB compared with the benchmarks. The optimized array is further shown to resolve two closely spaced targets whose reflectivities differ by 6dB, outperforming random, Mills Cross, and rectangular arrays while satisfying the imposed minimum user-throughput requirements.

</details>


### [484] [Semantic-Assisted Joint Channel Estimation and Symbol Detection for MU-MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38855)
*Hao Chang,Chentao Yue,Haiyao Yu,Yonghui Li,Branka Vucetic,Wibowo Hardjawana*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出面向MU-MIMO文本传输的语义辅助联合信道估计与符号检测（Sem-JCED）接收机，以ByT5语义校正器闭环反馈软统计量，显著降低所需SNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多用户MIMO文本传输中，传统联合信道估计与符号检测（JCED）未利用文本语义冗余，在低信噪比下性能受限，需要以语义先验提升估计与检测精度。

Method: Sem-JCED将LMMSE信道估计器、EP符号检测器与基于ByT5（字节级语言模型）的语义校正器耦合。外迭代中，LMMSE利用已知导频与数据符号反馈估计信道，EP检测数据符号；ByT5将数据符号概率映射为字节概率，输出软符号统计量与语义先验，分别反馈给下一轮的LMMSE与EP，形成闭环迭代。

Result: 四用户、四接收天线配置下，达到BER=1e-2时Sem-JCED比传统JCED所需SNR低约7 dB；在所仿真的SNR范围内，其性能优于具备完美信道知识的最大似然检测。

Conclusion: 将字节级语义模型嵌入JCED迭代环路可有效利用文本冗余，实现低于理想信道ML检测的性能，表明语义先验可作为MU-MIMO接收机的有效附加信息源。

Abstract: This paper presents a semantic-assisted joint channel estimation and symbol detection (Sem-JCED) receiver framework for text transmission in multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) systems. Sem-JCED integrates a linear minimum mean-square error (LMMSE) channel estimator, an expectation propagation (EP) symbol detector, and a semantic corrector based on ByT5, a byte-level language model. At each outer iteration, LMMSE estimates the channel from known pilots and data symbol feedback, and EP detects the data symbols. ByT5 then maps the data symbol probabilities to byte probabilities, which provide soft symbol statistics and semantic priors for feedback to LMMSE and EP, respectively, in the next iteration. Simulation results show that Sem-JCED requires about 7~dB lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) than conventional JCED to reach a bit error rate (BER) of $1\times10^{-2}$ with four users and four receive antennas, and outperforms maximum-likelihood detection with perfect channel knowledge over the simulated SNR range.

</details>


### [485] [xCHEM: SDR-Based Multi-Link Channel Emulator for Real-Time Hardware-in-the-Loop Digital-Twin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38868)
*Ali Saeizadeh,Gabriele Gemmi,Tamerlan Aghayev,Michele Polese,Pedram Johari,Tommaso Melodia*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: xCHEM：基于单块 NI USRP X4xx 的射频信道模拟器，可在物理电台间插入六路可编程定向信道，支持外部信道模型通过流式冲激响应在线更新，无需改动固件且不中断信号处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为在真实物理射频之间灵活、可编程地注入信道效应，需一种无需修改固件、可在信号处理不中断的情况下加载外部信道模型、并能解耦时延跨度与资源开销的低成本单SDR信道模拟方案。

Method: 采用单块 NI USRP X4xx SDR；外部信道模型将冲激响应流式写入 FPGA；流式数据通路在四个射频接口上实现六路独立可配置的定向信道；每信道采用稀疏 FIR 滤波器，以存储器实现的延迟线将时延跨度与乘法器资源解耦；提供实数（32 个非零抽头）与复数（16 个非零抽头）两种变体；通过系数缩放与算术右移控制衰减；由 FPGA 系数引擎产生多普勒频移。

Result: 最大时延 16666.62 ns，分辨率 4.069 ns；时延 RMS 误差 9.5 ps（全跨度），衰减误差 0.11 dB；多径时延恢复误差在一采样以内；多普勒频移覆盖 ±1 Hz 至 ±1 MHz，载波偏移校准后平均频率误差低于 0.032 Hz；200 Hz 时相较 1 kHz 主机更新，近载波杂散降低 53.3 dB。

Conclusion: xCHEM 以单块 SDR 实现了高精度、资源高效、可在线重构的多径与多普勒信道模拟，精度指标达到皮秒级时延与亚0.1 dB幅度误差，验证了存储器延迟线架构与FPGA系数引擎在无线信道模拟中的有效性。

Abstract: This paper presents xCHEM, a radio-frequency channel emulator that inserts programmable channels between physical radios using a single NI USRP X4xx software-defined radio. External channel models stream impulse responses to its field-programmable gate array without firmware changes or interruption of signal processing. A streaming datapath implements six independently configurable directional channels across four radio interfaces. Each channel uses a sparse finite impulse response filter whose memory-backed delays decouple delay span from multiplier resources. The real and complex variants support 32 and 16 nonzero taps, respectively, with a maximum delay of 16666.62 ns and 4.069 ns resolution. Coefficient scaling and arithmetic right shifts control attenuation. Hardware measurements show root-mean-square errors of 9.5 ps in delay over the full span and 0.11 dB in attenuation. Multipath delays are recovered within one sample. An FPGA coefficient engine produces tested Doppler shifts from +/-1 Hz to +/-1 MHz with mean frequency errors below 0.032 Hz relative to quantized commands after carrier-offset calibration; at 200 Hz, it reduces the measured near-carrier spur by 53.3 dB compared with 1 kHz host updates.

</details>


### [486] [Learning Latent Fields in Multiobject Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38898)
*Shaoxiu Wei,Bhaskar Rao,Florian Meyer*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种贝叶斯多目标跟踪框架，直接将目标状态与原始复值阵列信号通过基于物理的叠加模型关联，并用条件归一化流参数化共享的隐场（信号功率分布），运行时以ELBO无监督训练，实现学习与推断的序列耦合，在仿真及真实无线电、声学实验中优于基于检测的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在预处理阶段将原始复值信号压缩为检测结果或强度图，丢弃了关于目标与传播环境的潜在有用信息。

Method: 构建贝叶斯多目标跟踪框架，用基于物理的叠加模型关联目标状态与原始复值信号：将物理阵列流形（如雷达导向矢量或匹配场处理的副本矢量）与隐场结合；隐场为依赖上下文的信号功率分布族，刻画目标与传播环境效应，跨目标与时间共享，由条件归一化流参数化，运行时通过最大化贝叶斯模型导出的ELBO无标签训练，学习与推断在序列框架中耦合。

Result: 在仿真及真实无线电与声学实验中（空间尺度从数米到数公里）评估，性能优于基于检测的方法。

Conclusion: 直接在原始复值信号上进行物理引导的贝叶斯跟踪，可避免预处理信息损失，并通过无监督在线学习适应环境，是一种可跨尺度应用的通用多目标跟踪方案。

Abstract: Multiobject tracking using measurements from ar- rays of wireless sensors is a key task in applications ranging from autonomous navigation to public safety. Many existing methods compress raw complex-valued signals into detections or intensity maps during preprocessing, thereby discarding poten- tially relevant information about the objects and the propagation environment. We propose a Bayesian framework for multiobject tracking that relates object states to raw complex-valued signals via a physics-based superpositional model. The model combines a physics-based array manifold, such as radar steering vectors or the replica vectors of matched-field processing, with a latent field. This latent field is a family of context-dependent signal- power distributions that captures the effects of the objects and the propagation environment and is shared across objects and time. It is parameterized by a conditional normalizing flow, which is trained during runtime without labeled data by maximizing an evidence lower bound (ELBO) derived from the Bayesian model. Learning and inference are thus coupled in a sequential framework. We evaluate the method in simulation and in real-world radio and acoustic experiments, with spatial scales ranging from meters to kilometers, and show that it outperforms detection-based methods.

</details>


### [487] [Waveform Bandwidth and Frequency Diversity in FDA-MIMO Range-Angle Estimation: A CRLB Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39011)
*Guoqing Xia,Qu Luo,Yu Liu,Pei Xiao,Cicek Cavdar,Emil Björnson*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文为FDA-MIMO雷达建立了带宽感知的CRLB框架，刻画波形RMS带宽与FDA频率分集对距离-角度联合估计的相互作用，并给出闭式近似与三因子耦合分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FDA-MIMO雷达通过阵元相关的载频偏移引入距离相关相位分集，与发射波形携带的时延信息共同影响距离-角度估计；但两种机制如何共同作用缺乏定量刻画，需要统一的性能界分析框架。

Method: 从保留波形时延与FDA频偏的Nyquist采样观测模型出发，将未知准静态复散射系数作为冗余参数消去，推导等效Fisher信息矩阵（EFIM）；进而导出闭式CRLB近似，并对归一化互信息的平方做三因子分解以刻画距离-角度耦合。

Result: 波形RMS带宽与FDA频率分集单独增大均降低距离CRLB；在固定非零波形带宽下，FDA频率分集使角度CRLB升高，而波形RMS带宽使其降低；在固定总频谱预算下，距离CRLB存在内部极大值，角度CRLB随FDA频谱分配比例单调上升。数值结果验证了闭式近似与趋势预测。

Conclusion: 波形带宽与FDA频率分集对距离、角度估计的作用并不对称，二者存在权衡；所提CRLB框架与三因子分解可为FDA-MIMO雷达的带宽与频谱分配设计提供理论依据。

Abstract: Frequency-diverse array multiple-input multiple-output (FDA-MIMO) radar introduces range-dependent phase diversity through element-dependent carrier-frequency offsets, in addition to the delay information carried by transmitted waveforms. This paper develops a bandwidth-aware Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) framework to characterize how these two mechanisms jointly affect range-angle estimation. Starting from a Nyquist-rate sampled observation model that retains waveform delays and FDA frequency offsets, we derive an equivalent Fisher information matrix (EFIM) after eliminating an unknown quasi-static complex scattering coefficient as a nuisance parameter. We derive closed-form CRLB approximations that reveal the interplay between waveform root-mean-square (RMS) bandwidth and FDA frequency diversity. A three-factor decomposition of the squared normalized cross-information further characterizes range-angle coupling. Results show that when increased independently, both waveform RMS bandwidth and FDA frequency diversity reduce the range CRLB, but FDA frequency diversity increases the angle CRLB at fixed nonzero waveform bandwidth, whereas waveform RMS bandwidth reduces it. Additionally, under a fixed aggregate spectral budget, the range CRLB exhibits an interior maximum, whereas the angle CRLB increases monotonically with the FDA spectral-allocation fraction. Numerical results corroborate the closed-form approximations and the predicted trends.

</details>


### [488] [Stability-Performance Trade-off in Maritime Integrated Sensing, Communication, and Computation: A Lyapunov-Guided Dual-Timescale Hierarchical RL Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39082)
*Ruoguang Li,Yu Wang,Bingxin Tian,Benedetta Picano,Yingyang Chen,Xiaomin Chen,Li Wang,Guangjie Han,Zhu Han*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对海上无人机-无人艇协同的ISCC系统，在考虑海杂波与海浪致船体横摇的条件下，以长期平均能耗最小为目标联合优化多类变量，提出Lyapunov引导的双时间尺度分层SAC框架求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上智能服务需求增长使UAV-USV协同与无线通感算一体化（ISCC）成为关键；但海上环境难以直接套用陆基ISCC模型，且感知、通信、计算争夺同一时空资源，在资源受限海洋场景下性能折衷尤为严重。

Method: 建模多UAV海面目标探测并向USV部分卸载数据的ISCC系统；在感知模型引入海杂波、在通信模型引入海浪引起的USV横摇；在UAV与USV处建立数据排队模型以刻画感知数据生成、无线卸载与计算执行的动态耦合；以最小化长期平均系统能耗为目标，联合优化UAV-目标关联、轨迹、波束成形、时间分配、卸载比例与计算资源分配；提出Lyapunov引导的双时间尺度分层SAC（LTH-SAC）框架，将长期问题转化为队列感知的在线子问题序列并在两个时间尺度上协同优化。

Result: 仿真结果验证了所提框架的有效性，并表明其能够在感知、通信与计算之间平衡稳定性-性能折衷。

Conclusion: 考虑海上特有损伤与队列动态耦合的双时间尺度分层强化学习方法可有效求解UAV-USV协同ISCC的长期能耗优化问题。

Abstract: Driven by the ever-growing demand for intelligent maritime services, cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and unmanned surface vehicle (USV) operations, together with wireless integrated sensing, communication, and computation (ISCC), have become pivotal in maritime environments. However, the distinctive maritime environment precludes a direct application of terrestrial ISCC models, while sensing, communication, and computation compete for the same spatio-temporal resources, thus yielding inherent performance trade-offs that become particularly severe in resource-constrained ocean scenarios. To address these issues, we investigate an ISCC system in which multiple UAVs detect targets at the sea surface and partially offload the collected data to a USV for cooperative processing. Characterizing the maritime-specific environment impairments, we incorporate sea clutter and wave-induced USV roll motion into the sensing and communication models, respectively. Moreover, we introduce data queueing models at both the UAVs and the USV to capture the dynamic coupling among sensing-data generation, wireless offloading, and computation execution. The optimization objective is to minimize the long-term average system energy consumption by jointly optimizing UAV-target association, UAV trajectories, beamforming, time allocation, offloading ratios, and computation resource allocation. Given that these decisions differ in update frequency and time sensitivity, we propose a Lyapunov-guided dual-timescale hierarchical soft actor-critic (LTH-SAC) framework, which transforms the long-term problem into a sequence of queue-aware online subproblems and coordinates optimization across the two timescales. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework and demonstrate its capability to balance the stability-performance trade-off among sensing, communication, and computation.

</details>


### [489] [Sensing Fast and Distant Targets in Overspread Channels with Zak-OTFS and Modular Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39110)
*Andrea Novero,Mudasir Ahmad Sheikh,Danish Nisar,Saif Khan Mohammed,Michele Zorzi,Robert Calderbank*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种在同一带宽与帧尺寸下叠加多个不同延迟/多普勒周期DD基（两个叠加Zak-OTFS帧）的帧设计，并给出双帧接收机DS与DS-XC，用模算术与峰值配对解决超扩展信道的单帧模糊问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DD调制（如Zak-OTFS）将信道表示为稀疏的延迟-多普勒点，适合雷达感知；但单DD帧仅在扩展因子（延迟扩展×多普勒扩展）小于1时无模糊。无人机、飞机、LEO卫星、水声等长距离高机动场景违反该"结晶"条件，单帧会出现延迟、多普勒或两者的混叠，而现有在传统DD帧中加入时频导频的方法只能在一维上解模糊。

Method: 设计在同一带宽和帧尺寸下组合多个具有不同延迟周期和多普勒周期的DD基，使其共同覆盖超扩展信道；针对两帧情形，证明通过对缠绕峰值位置做模算术，并利用峰值的共同投影和增益进行配对，可唯一恢复各目标，并推导配对模糊的条件。实现上用两个叠加的Zak-OTFS帧，提出两种接收机：DS直接联合检测；DS-XC额外消除交叉导频干扰、通过联合最小二乘重估增益并去除鬼影目标。

Result: 随扩展因子增大，两种接收机的检测率均保持接近1；DS-XC获得最低虚警率和最低信道NMSE。在100 km无人机场景中，DS-XC检测到98%的目标，最优基线为81%；在目标数固定时，复杂度随时间-带宽积近似线性增长。

Conclusion: 多DD基叠加的双帧设计可在不增加带宽和帧长的前提下突破单帧结晶条件限制，实现超扩展信道下的二维无模糊感知；DS-XC在检测率、虚警率与信道估计精度上均优于基线，且复杂度可扩展，适用于长距离高机动感知场景。

Abstract: Delay-Doppler (DD) modulations, such as Zak-transform-based orthogonal time frequency space (Zak-OTFS) modulation, represent the channel as a sparse set of delay and Doppler shifts, which makes them well suited for radar sensing. Sensing with a single DD frame, however, is unambiguous only when the channel spread factor, i.e., the product of the delay and Doppler spreads, is below one. Long-range mobility scenarios, including drones, airplanes, low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites, and underwater acoustic links, typically violate this crystallization condition, so that a single frame aliases the target delays, Doppler shifts, or both. Existing methods add a time-frequency pilot to a conventional DD frame and resolve the aliasing in only one dimension. We propose a frame design that combines multiple DD bases with different delay and Doppler periods, which together cover an overspread channel, on the same bandwidth and frame size. For two frames, we show that modular arithmetic on the wrapped peak positions uniquely recovers each target by pairing the peaks through their common projection and their gains, and we derive the condition under which this pairing is ambiguous. We implement the design with two superimposed Zak-OTFS frames and propose two receivers: dual-frame sensing (DS), which performs the joint detection directly, and DS with cross-pilot cancellation (DS-XC), which additionally cancels the cross-pilot interference, re-estimates the gains by joint least squares, and removes ghost targets. Both receivers keep a detection rate close to one as the spread factor grows, and DS-XC also achieves the lowest false-alarm rate and channel normalized mean squared error (NMSE). In a 100 km drone scenario, DS-XC detects 98% of the targets, compared with 81% for the best baseline, with a complexity that grows near-linearly with the time-bandwidth product for a fixed number of targets.

</details>


### [490] [Turning Multipath into Positioning Information: Persistent Electromagnetic-Twin DoA Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39111)
*Tuo Wu,Zhentian Zhang,Ye Tian,Hing Cheung So*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于电磁孪生(ET)的DoA定位方法，用稀疏参考探针学习紧凑的方向修正场并持久化标定路径角度，结合位置估计与路径关联联合优化及RLS在线更新，在50% LoS遮挡下RMSE达0.39 m（名义几何为0.55 m）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoS链路被遮挡时反射路径可支撑定位，但其价值取决于存储模型对路径方向预测的准确性；名义楼宇平面图的几何误差会显著削弱反射路径可用性，需要一种可复用、物理标定的方向校正机制。

Method: 1) 以名义平面图提供虚拟路径几何，利用已知位置的稀疏参考探针学习紧凑的方向校正场，阶数与正则化仅由标定数据选择；2) 对用户的无序DoA进行联合位置估计与一对一路径关联，采用分配感知的多起点搜索与鲁棒Gauss-Newton精化；3) 新增可信探针通过递归最小二乘(RLS)增量更新存储的校正，无需重处理历史测量；4) 理论分析给出标定秩条件、目标函数下降性与反射路径的条件信息增益，并区分初始化偏差衰减与定位误差收敛。

Result: 合成实验中每个工况500次查询。50% LoS遮挡、DoA误差1.5°时，标定ET的RMSE为0.39 m，名义几何为0.55 m；墙体变更后最终误差0.43 m，冻结标定图为0.63 m。等证据对比显示若干标定方案具竞争力，且滑窗更新的突变恢复快于配置的RLS。

Conclusion: 结果支持"可复用的方向标定"这一结论，而非某种普适最优的地图或更新规则；验证仅限于合成的一阶反射与可信标定标签，实际部署外推需谨慎。

Abstract: Reflected paths can support localization when line-of-sight (LoS) links are blocked, but their usefulness depends on how accurately the stored model predicts their directions. This paper develops electromagnetic-twin (ET) direction-of-arrival (DoA) localization with a persistent, physically calibrated path-angle field. A nominal floor plan supplies virtual-path geometry, and sparse reference probes at known positions learn a compact directional correction. Field order and regularization are selected from calibration data alone. For each user, unordered DoAs are processed by joint position estimation and one-to-one path association, using assignment-aware multistart search and robust Gauss--Newton refinement. New trusted probes update the stored correction through recursive least squares (RLS), without reprocessing all previous measurements. The analysis establishes calibration rank conditions, objective descent, and conditional information gains from reflected paths, while also distinguishing the decay of initialization bias from the convergence of localization error. Synthetic experiments use 500 queries per operating point. At 50% LoS blockage and $1.5^\circ$ DoA error, the calibrated ET achieves 0.39 m root-mean-square error, versus 0.55 m for nominal geometry. After a wall change, its final error is 0.43 m, versus 0.63 m for a frozen calibrated map. Equal-evidence comparisons show competitive calibrated alternatives and faster abrupt-change recovery with sliding-window updates than with the configured RLS. The results support reusable directional calibration, not a universally superior map or update rule, and validation is limited to synthetic first-order reflections with trusted calibration labels.

</details>


### [491] [An Efficient SIM Beamforming Scheme Based on Physical-Empowered Projected Gradient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39219)
*Yuzhi Yang,Hao Liu,Tianhao Guo,Jiancheng An,Lu Gan,Chau Yuen,Mérouane Debbah*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于空中梯度回传的物理投影梯度下降(P2GD)波束赋形框架，在无需显式估计SIM–UE信道的前提下优化堆叠智能超表面(SIM)辅助MIMO系统的和速率，并给出UE-P2GD与BS-P2GD两种变体及收敛性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SIM辅助MIMO系统面临两大难题：SIM单元无信号处理能力，信道只能间接估计；且信道估计后的预编码优化为非凸问题，难以求解。作者希望借助TDD信道互易性规避显式信道估计，降低导频与信令开销。

Method: 利用TDD互易性在空中(over-the-air)完成梯度反向传播；据此构建梯度优化框架，直接优化波束赋形而不显式估计SIM–UE信道。提出P2GD方法，在优化可达和速率的同时嵌入零迫(ZF)约束，并依据ZF约束的引入方式设计UE-P2GD与BS-P2GD两种变体；配合投影梯度技术保证物理可行性，并给出理论收敛性分析。

Result: 仿真表明，所提方法在多用户系统中仅需少量空中迭代即可获得次优波束赋形，且每方向信令预算低于显式SIM–UE信道估计的导频开销。

Conclusion: 该工作为SIM系统提供了一种低开销、免显式SIM–UE信道估计的波束赋形方案，验证了空中梯度计算范式的可行性与效率。

Abstract: Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces (SIMs) have emerged as a promising technology for next-generation wireless systems. Especially in multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems, it has the potential to realize complicated wave-domain transformations with low hardware costs and energy consumption. However, SIM-assisted MIMO systems face two major challenges in channel estimation and beamforming. As the SIM elements do not have the signal processing capability, channel estimation can only be conducted in an indirect manner, which makes it challenging. Moreover, the precoding optimization after channel estimation is non-convex and also difficult. Targeting these issues, we exploit the time-division duplex (TDD) channel reciprocity to calculate the gradient backpropagation in an over-the-air manner. Based on this structure, we propose a gradient-based optimization framework that optimizes beamforming without explicitly estimating the SIM--UE channel. The proposed method, namely the physical projected gradient descent (P2GD) method, optimizes the achievable sum rate while incorporating zero-forcing (ZF) constraints. Based on the method of incorporating the ZF restriction, we propose two variations of P2GD, namely user equipment (UE)-P2GD and base station (BS)-P2GD. We also provide a theoretical convergence analysis and projected gradient techniques to ensure physical feasibility. Simulation results show that the proposed approach can achieve suboptimal beamforming in the multi-user system within a small number of over-the-air iterations, using a per-direction signaling budget below the pilot cost of explicit SIM--UE channel estimation. The proposed method provides a low-overhead beamforming scheme for SIM systems without explicit SIM--UE channel estimation.

</details>


### [492] [Anchor-Free Range-Free 3D IoT Localization in Buried Environments with Connectivity-Informed Power Selection and Temporal Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39294)
*Peyman Moeini,Mark Coates*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出3D-PT-PS与3D-PT-PST两种无锚点、无测距的矿用IoT标签定位方法，利用二值导频测量选功率并结合装载时间弱线索，在5000 t料仓125标签场景下实现6.12% NRMSE与2.20 m RMSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矿山（井下与露天）中随矿石/废石装载埋入的无线IoT标签可用于埋后物料与品位追踪，但传统测距与实测锚点定位基础设施在埋后往往不可用，需要一种不依赖RSSI、测距、锚点、料堆尺寸与物料参数的低成本定位方案。

Method: 在三维Protraction Technique（3D-PT）基础上提出3D-PT-PS：从二值导频测量中挑选信息量更高的发射功率等级；进一步提出3D-PT-PST：将记录的装载沉积时间作为弱非度量线索引入时间精化。两法均为无锚点、无测距方法。采用蒙特卡洛仿真，考察不同料堆尺寸与标签密度。

Result: 在5000 t破碎机料仓、125个标签场景下，3D-PT-PST取得6.12%平均NRMSE与2.20 m三维RMSE；相对3D-PT-PS将平均NRMSE降低13.5%，相对校准的MDS-MAP(P)与CATL分别降低43.6%与69.1%。

Conclusion: 连通性与时序信息具有互补性；功率选择与时间弱线索可显著提升无锚点、无测距的埋入式标签三维定位精度。

Abstract: In underground and surface mines, wireless Internet-of- Things (IoT) tags deployed with ore or muck loads can support material and grade tracking after burial, when conventional ranging and surveyed localization infrastructure may be unavailable. Building on the three-dimensional Pro- traction Technique (3D-PT), this paper introduces 3D-PT with Power Selection (3D-PT-PS), which selects informative transmit-power levels from binary pilot measurements, and 3D-PT-PS with Temporal Refinement (3D-PT-PST), which incorporates recorded load-deposition times as weak, non- metric cues. Both methods are anchor-free and range-free and require no RSSI, measured ranges, surveyed anchors, pile dimensions, or material parameters. Monte Carlo simulations evaluate different pile sizes and tag densities. In a 5000-t crusher-pocket scenario with 125 tags, 3D-PT-PST achieves 6.12% mean NRMSE and 2.20 m 3D RMSE, reducing mean NRMSE by 13.5% relative to 3D-PT-PS and by 43.6% and 69.1% relative to calibrated MDS-MAP(P) and CATL, respectively. These results show that connectivity and timing provide complementary information.

</details>


### [493] [Evaluating Generalization and Long-Term Stability of Smartwatch-Based Cuffless Blood Pressure Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39394)
*Hongda Huang,Xiao Peng,Xiaoyu Li,Shuailong Tang,Guangpu Zhu,Xiajiao Yang,Hongwei Li,Yelei Li,Yali Zheng*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出轻量级信号-上下文门控融合网络SCGBPNet，用PPG估计无袖带血压，并系统揭示数据集内、跨数据集与长期随访下的性能差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手表无袖带血压监测是长期心血管管理的低负担方案，但受模型复杂度高、跨数据集泛化不确定、长期跟踪稳定性证据不足三方面制约，需要同时兼顾效率与可靠性评估。

Method: 构建Signal-Context Gated Fusion Network（SCGBPNet）：以自注意力提取PPG信号级表征，再通过紧凑门控融合模块引入受试者特异性上下文信息；在Aurora-BP公开数据集与私有智能手表数据集上开展数据集内验证、跨数据集迁移及超过一个月的周/日粒度纵向评估。

Result: Aurora-BP上SBP/DBP的MAE为7.08/4.90 mmHg；私有手表数据集数据集内为6.44/4.89 mmHg，数据集内差异较小；Aurora-BP→手表数据集跨库迁移后MAE升至8.98/6.47 mmHg，退化显著；长期随访周间波动小、日衰减率低，稳定性良好；但血压显著偏离个体基线时精度下降。

Conclusion: 总体MAE良好不足以证明可部署性；需在数据集设置、血压区间与基线偏离水平上进行系统化、分层化评估，方能判断手表无袖带血压监测的实际可靠性。

Abstract: Smartwatch-based cuffless blood pressure (BP) monitoring is a promising low-burden solution for long-term cardiovascular management, but practical deployment remains constrained by model complexity, uncertain cross-dataset generalization, and insufficient evidence on long-term tracking stability. This study presents an efficient Signal-Context Gated Fusion Network (SCGBPNet) for cuffless BP estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. SCGBPNet integrates signal-level representations through self-attention and further incorporates subject-specific contextual information via a compact gated fusion module. On Aurora-BP, SCGBPNet achieved SBP/DBP mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 7.08/4.90 mmHg, compared with 6.44/4.89 mmHg under within-dataset validation on the private smartwatch dataset, indicating a modest within-dataset discrepancy. Cross-dataset transfer from Aurora-BP to the smartwatch dataset increased the MAEs to 8.98/6.47 mmHg, demonstrating substantial cross-dataset degradation. For long-term stability, the proposed method showed low week-to-week performance variation and a low daily decay rate, indicating good stability over a follow-up period of more than one month. Nevertheless, estimation accuracy deteriorated when BP deviated substantially from an individual's baseline. These findings indicate that favorable aggregate MAE alone should not be interpreted as evidence of deployment-ready performance. More systematic and stratified evaluation across dataset settings, BP ranges, and baseline-deviation levels is needed to assess the practical reliability of smartwatch-based cuffless BP monitoring.

</details>


### [494] [On the Performance of AoA-Based Physical-Layer Authentication Under Multi-Source Impersonation Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39397)
*Jeongbin Kim,Moonsik Min,Yo-Seb Jeon*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究数字均匀线阵接收机下，多源协同冒充攻击对基于AoA的无线认证系统的威胁，通过推导最优预编码向量并利用Vandermonde矩阵的秩性质，给出冒充源能复现合法空间签名的充要条件，并分析对抗角分集与收发源数比对认证鲁棒性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于到达角(AoA)的物理层认证被广泛用于无线通信身份验证，但当攻击者具备多天线、多空间分布的多源协同能力时，其安全性边界尚不清晰。作者希望刻画协同冒充攻击下的系统脆弱性与鲁棒性，明确对抗角分集以及对抗源数量与接收天线数量的相对关系如何决定认证成败。

Method: 1) 构建协同冒充模型：多个空间分布对抗源对配备数字均匀线阵的接收机发动攻击；2) 以合法接收信号与对抗接收信号之间的均方误差最小化为目标，推导多源最优预编码向量；3) 借助Vandermonde矩阵的秩性质，推导对抗源复现合法发射机空间签名的充要条件；4) 分情形讨论冒充源数少于接收天线数，以及不小于接收天线数两种情形；5) 通过数值仿真验证理论分析并评估安全性能。

Result: 当对抗源数量少于接收天线数时，若没有任何一个对抗源满足特定AoA条件，则无法完美复现合法空间签名；而当对抗源数量不少于接收天线数时，在无对抗源满足该AoA条件的情况下，增加接收天线数量可降低冒充成功概率。数值结果验证了上述理论结论，并量化了基于AoA认证的安全性能。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了AoA认证在协同冒充攻击下的脆弱性边界：安全性与对抗角分集、以及对抗源与接收天线数量比密切相关。增加接收天线数在特定条件下可有效提升鲁棒性，为基于AoA的物理层认证系统的安全设计提供了理论依据。

Abstract: This paper investigates cooperative impersonation attacks against angle-of-arrival (AoA)-based authentication for a wireless communication receiver equipped with a digital uniform linear array. Specifically, we characterize the vulnerability and robustness of this authentication system in relation to adversarial angular diversity and the relative numbers of adversarial sources and receive antennas. To this end, we first derive the optimal precoding vector for multiple spatially distributed adversarial sources by minimizing the mean squared error between legitimate and adversarial received signals. By means of the rank property of Vandermonde matrices, we then establish necessary and sufficient conditions under which the adversarial sources can reproduce the legitimate transmitter's spatial signature. With fewer adversarial sources than receive antennas, perfect reproduction is not possible without at least one adversarial source satisfying a specific AoA condition. In the other case, increasing the number of receive antennas can reduce impersonation success probabilities when none of the adversarial sources has an AoA satisfying this condition. Numerical results validate the theoretical analysis and evaluate the security performance of AoA-based authentication.

</details>


### [495] [Beyond Diagonal RIS for Physical-Layer Security: Low-Complexity Solution in the Low-SNR Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39533)
*Rawan Derbas,Hamad Yahya*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究相关窃听信道下超越对角可重构智能表面（BD-RIS）辅助的物理层安全，提出低SNR下的两阶段方案联合优化发射天线选择（TAS）与BD-RIS散射矩阵以最大化保密速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在相关窃听信道中，合法信道与窃听信道强相关时传统设计（以合法用户为中心或强制窃听零陷）性能受限；同时仅单射频链场景需要利用发射侧分集，因此需在低SNR区探索BD-RIS对保密性能的提升。

Method: 基于一阶保密速率近似构建两阶段方案：第一阶段基于有效信道上界设计两种TAS方案；第二阶段为单连接、群连接、全连接三类BD-RIS架构设计基于特征向量的散射矩阵，在合法信号增强与信息泄漏抑制之间折中而非强制零泄漏。

Result: 仿真显示保密性能得到提升，尤其在合法信道与窃听信道强相关条件下优势更为明显。

Conclusion: BD-RIS结合两阶段TAS与特征向量散射矩阵设计可在相关窃听信道、单RF链条件下有效提升物理层保密性，且优于强制零泄漏的以合法用户为中心方案。

Abstract: This letter investigates beyond diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RIS) for physical-layer security (PLS) in correlated wiretap channels. A multi-antenna transmitter is considered, and transmit antenna selection (TAS) is used to exploit transmit-side diversity with a single active radio-frequency (RF) chain. Using the first-order secrecy rate approximation, we develop a two-stage scheme to maximize the secrecy rate in the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regime. In the first stage, two TAS schemes are developed based on the effective channel upper-bound. In the second stage, an eigenvector-based BD-RIS scattering matrix is designed for single-connected, group-connected, and fully-connected architectures. Unlike legitimate-user-centric or eavesdropping-nulling designs, the proposed approach balances legitimate-user signal enhancement and information-leakage suppression without forcing zero leakage. Simulation results show improved secrecy performance, particularly under a strong correlation between legitimate and eavesdropping channels.

</details>


### [496] [Human Activity Recognition using Ceiling-Mounted Multi-Radar Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39628)
*Ananya Prabhu,Aditi Site,Tarmo Lipping*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种无摄像头、无穿戴设备的多雷达融合室内活动监测系统：三台吊顶雷达点云经密度聚类融合，提取运动与姿态特征进行活动分类，并在实时看板上展示；连续场景下随机森林帧级准确率为74%（随机80/20划分）与68%（留一被试），去除位置特征后降至46%/44%，而采用窗口级特征可达67%/65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辅助生活场景中的持续活动监测应在不使用摄像头和可穿戴设备的前提下工作。雷达可满足这一要求，但现有雷达研究多为单传感器、活动孤立录制，且少有实时结果输出，缺乏连续场景与跨被试泛化的评估。

Method: 构建室内监测系统：融合三台吊顶安装雷达传感器的点云，采用基于密度的聚类进行多传感器点云融合；从融合结果中提取运动特征与姿态特征用于活动分类；分类结果在实时看板上呈现。评估采用八名被试按连续场景执行的日常活动数据，以随机森林分类器在帧级进行评测，分别使用随机80/20划分与留一被试（leave-one-participant-out）协议，并进行去除位置特征的消融对比。

Result: 帧级准确率在随机80/20划分下为74%，留一被试评估下为68%。去除位置特征后准确率分别下降至46%和44%，表明对房间布局存在部分依赖；改用不含位置信息的窗口级特征后，准确率回升至67%（随机划分）和65%（留一被试）。

Conclusion: 多雷达点云融合结合密度聚类与运动/姿态特征，可在无摄像、无穿戴条件下实现实时室内活动监测，并在连续场景中获得可用的分类性能。但帧级特征对房间布局存在部分依赖，泛化能力受限；窗口级特征可有效缓解该依赖，是提升跨被试与跨环境鲁棒性的可行方向。

Abstract: Continuous activity monitoring in assisted living should work without cameras or wearable devices. Radar meets this requirement, but most radar studies use a single sensor and activities recorded in isolation, and few deliver results in real time. We present an indoor monitoring system in which point clouds from three ceiling-mounted radar sensors are fused using density-based clustering, movement and posture features are derived for activity classification, and results are shown on a real-time dashboard. In a preliminary study with eight participants performing everyday activities as one continuous scenario, a random forest reached 74% frame-level accuracy with a random 80/20 split and 68% with leave-one-participant-out evaluation. Without position features, accuracy fell to 46% and 44%, indicating partial dependence on room layout, while window-level features without position reached 67% and 65%.

</details>


### [497] [Implementation and Validation of Mismatch-Tolerant High-Gain OTA with a Calibrated Negative Conductance Load](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39699)
*Mayank Aggarwal,Naveen Kadayinti*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 在65nm CMOS中实现一种基于自动负电导校准的、对失配容忍的高增益OTA电路级方案，通过片上校准环路补偿有限输出电导以提升增益，无需replica电路或外部调谐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OTA的有限输出电导限制了其增益，传统增益提升方法（如replica电路或外部调谐）增加复杂度与失配敏感性，需要一种片上自动校准、对失配鲁棒的增益增强实现。

Method: 采用交叉耦合晶体管对补偿OTA输出电导以提高增益；设计片上校准环路，将单位增益反馈下OTA的稳态误差驱动趋零；针对比较器失调采用6-bit电容DAC（CDAC）校准方案，可检测亚毫伏级稳态误差，并处理比较器失调、DAC设计及减法器增益与失调等实际挑战。

Result: 后布局蒙特卡洛仿真显示比较器失调标准差由4.11 mV降至132 μV，校准后最大失调为625 μV；完整校准电路经后布局仿真验证有效。

Conclusion: 所提负电导自动校准方案可在无replica电路条件下有效提升OTA增益，CDAC比较器失调校准保证高增益所需的高精度误差检测，电路级实现可行且对失配具有容忍性。

Abstract: This paper presents the circuit-level implementation of a mismatch-tolerant high-gain operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) using automatic negative-conductance calibration in 65-nm CMOS. The technique enhances OTA gain by compensating for its finite output conductance using a cross-coupled transistor pair, with an on-chip calibration loop that eliminates the need for a replica circuit or external tuning. The calibration routine increases the gain by driving the steady state error of the OTA in a unity gain feedback loop toward zero. The implementation addresses practical challenges involving comparator offset, DAC design, and subtractor gain and offset. A 6-bit capacitive DAC (CDAC)-based comparator offset calibration scheme enables reliable detection of the sub-millivolt steady state error required for high OTA gain. Post-layout Monte Carlo simulations show that the comparator offset standard deviation is reduced from 4.11 mV to 132 $μ$V, with a maximum observed post-calibration offset of 625 $μ$V. The complete calibration circuitry is implemented and evaluated through post-layout simulations.

</details>


### [498] [Integrated Sensing and Communication via Channel Knowledge Maps Built from Beam Feedback Coefficients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39917)
*Chongda Huang,Yue Xiao,Gang Wu,Vladimir Poulkov,Xianfu Lei,Wei Xiang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于信道知识地图（CKM）的无线定位框架，直接利用通信中波束管理阶段采集的波束反馈系数作为紧凑位置指纹，无需完整信道反馈或额外感知测量；基站借助粗位置先验检索邻近CKM条目并做局部插值细化定位，并分析了空间指纹变化与定位精度的关系及反馈量化影响，仿真显示在存储-精度权衡上优于密集与稀疏化频谱指纹方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 详细信道指纹存储开销大，而现有定位依赖完整信道反馈或额外感知测量，成本高；希望复用通信过程已有的信息实现低开销定位。

Method: 以波束管理过程中采集的波束反馈系数作为紧凑位置指纹构建CKM；利用粗位置先验在CKM中搜索邻近条目，并通过局部插值细化位置估计；理论分析空间指纹变化与定位精度的关系，并评估反馈量化对性能的影响。

Result: 在测试的多径环境下，相较于密集频谱指纹与稀疏化频谱指纹方法，所提方案在存储开销与定位精度之间取得更优的权衡。

Conclusion: 波束反馈系数可作为一种免额外开销的紧凑定位指纹，配合粗先验加局部插值的CKM检索策略，可在显著降低存储需求的同时保持良好定位精度。

Abstract: Channel knowledge maps (CKMs) support wireless localization by linking channel features to user locations. Detailed channel fingerprints, however, can require substantial storage. This paper proposes a CKM-based localization framework that uses beam feedback coefficients collected during communication. These coefficients serve as compact location fingerprints within the beam management process, without requiring full channel feedback or additional sensing measurements. Using a coarse position prior, the base station searches nearby CKM entries and refines the location estimate through local interpolation. We analyze the relationship between spatial fingerprint variation and localization accuracy, and evaluate the effect of feedback quantization. Simulations show favorable storage--accuracy trade-offs relative to dense and sparsified spectral fingerprinting in the tested multipath environments.

</details>


### [499] [Measuring the Value of Communication in Multi-Agent Tracking Under Finite-Rate Belief Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40010)
*Danial Dehghani,Maximilian Lübke,Zahra Seifaei,Norman Franchi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究速率受限下协作多智能体跟踪中通信价值：存在中等速率"拐点"，超过后增益递减，剩余损失主要来自CI融合架构的保守性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作分别研究分布式跟踪、量化通信与鲁棒融合，但"在什么通信速率下可获得大部分可实现跟踪增益、超过该速率后资源仅带来边际收益"这一问题尚不明确。

Method: 静止智能体通过异构距离与方位量测观测运动目标，各自执行局部EKF，对后验状态均值量化后交换信息，并用协方差交叉(CI)融合；以无通信基线、集中式oracle与CI完美参考为对照，评估性能随通信速率的变化。

Result: 通信并非一致有益：极低速率因粗量化反而使性能退化；每智能体从4 bit/s升至12 bit/s，RMSE由13.93 m降至6.35 m，再升至32 bit/s仅微降至5.93 m，呈现明显的拐点区域。

Conclusion: 该框架刻画了低速率退化、通信高效工作区间与收益递减三阶段，并指出通信收益由速率与感知几何共同决定，拐点后的残余损失主要源于融合架构保守性。

Abstract: This paper investigates the value of communica- tion (VoC) in cooperative multi-agent tracking under rate- constrained information exchange. Although prior work has studied distributed tracking, quantized communication, and robust fusion, it remains unclear at what communication rate most of the achievable tracking gain is obtained, beyond which additional communication resources yield only marginal benefit. We consider stationary agents that observe a moving target through heterogeneous range and bearing measurements, perform local extended Kalman filtering (EKF), quantize their posterior state means, and fuse exchanged information via covariance intersection (CI). Performance is evaluated versus communication rate relative to no-communication baselines, a centralized oracle, and a CI-perfect reference. The results show that communication is not uniformly beneficial: very low rates can degrade performance due to coarse quantization, whereas moderate rates recover most of the achievable gain. In the considered scenario, increasing the rate from 4 to 12 bit/s per agent reduces the root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 13.93 m to 6.35 m, while a further increase to 32 bit/s per agent improves it only marginally to 5.93 m. This reveals a clear knee region at moderate rates, beyond which the remaining loss is mainly due to the conservatism of the fusion architecture. Overall, the proposed framework characterizes low-rate degradation, communication-efficient operation, and diminishing returns, while highlighting the joint role of rate and sensing geometry in determining communication benefit.

</details>


### [500] [AFDM-ISAC Design Amalgamating FMCW Radar and Carrier Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40107)
*Qu Luo,Qihao Peng,Zihuai Lin,Maged Elkashlan,Pei Xiao,Rahim Tafazolli,Lajos Hanzo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文提出载波聚合(CA)辅助的仿射频分复用(AFDM)方案用于通感一体化(ISAC)，并设计FMCW式去啁啾接收机与两类CA方案，分别提升感知精度与距离分辨率；同时推导分数时延-多普勒(FDFD)信道下的AFDM广义输入输出关系并提出跨域感知辅助信道估计(CDS-CE)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向ISAC系统，希望利用AFDM啁啾子载波的脉冲压缩特性实现高精度时延-多普勒估计，并在FDFD信道下同时改善感知精度、分辨率与信道估计性能。

Method: 1) 提出CA辅助AFDM波形，设计受FMCW启发的去啁啾接收机以利用啁啾子载波固有脉冲压缩特性；2) Type-I CA在雷达处理前聚合多个CA频段回波以降低估计误差、硬件开销低；3) Type-II CA通过将不同CA频段啁啾设计为连续啁啾集来扩展感知带宽，并据此提出可变子载波感知与异步感知方案；4) 推导分数时延与分数多普勒信道下AFDM的广义输入输出关系，提出CDS-CE实现时域时延-多普勒参数估计与仿射域信道系数恢复。

Result: 仿真结果表明，与现有先进方法相比，该框架在感知精度、距离分辨率及信道估计性能上均取得显著提升。

Conclusion: CA辅助AFDM结合去啁啾接收与两类CA方案，可有效兼顾ISAC系统的感知精度、分辨率与通信信道估计，验证了AFDM啁啾结构在通感一体化中的潜力。

Abstract: Carrier-aggregation (CA)-assisted affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) is conceived for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems. A frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW)-inspired dechirping receiver is developed to exploit the inherent pulse-compression property of AFDM chirp subcarriers for accurate delay-Doppler estimation. To further enhance sensing performance, a pair of CA schemes is proposed. The Type-I CA scheme improves sensing accuracy by aggregating echo signals across multiple CA bands prior to radar processing, thereby reducing estimation error with low hardware overhead. The Type-II CA scheme enhances range resolution by effectively enlarging the sensing bandwidth, where chirps from different CA bands are designed to form a continuous set of chirp signals. Based on this principle, variable subcarrier sensing and asynchronous sensing schemes are developed. For the communication receiver, the generalized input-output relationship of AFDM is derived under both fractional delay and fractional Doppler (FDFD) channels. To address the challenge of FDFD estimation, a cross-domain sensing-assisted channel estimation (CDS-CE) scheme is proposed to facilitate time-domain delay-Doppler parameter estimation and affine-domain channel coefficient recovery. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves significant improvements in sensing accuracy and resolution, as well as in channel estimation performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [501] [Adversarial Pilot Injection Against AI-Based CSI Feedback in FDD Massive MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40229)
*Jinli Zhai,Yusen Wang,Qimei Cui,Zengbao Zhu,Shengyuan Liang,Xiaofeng Tao*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文识别并评估了针对AI CSI反馈的导频注入对抗攻击路径，并提出交替对抗训练(AAT)作为防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI CSI反馈虽降低FDD大规模MIMO开销，但重建CSI依赖导频获取的完整性；现有研究关注量化比特传输安全，忽视了编码前的用户侧估计环节，该环节可被发送扰动污染。

Method: 建模攻击链路：攻击者传播→LMMSE估计→压缩→量化→解码，并在总发送能量约束下进行；提出对抗扰动生成器(APG)，仅依赖信道统计量，无需当前合法CSI或攻击者信道的瞬时观测；提出交替对抗训练(AAT)使反馈编解码器适应受污染导频。

Result: 在Rician攻击信道因子10 dB、扰动信号功率比-4 dB下，APG使基站CSI重建NMSE达0.84 dB，而高斯干扰为-10.31 dB；估计器靶向与重建靶向攻击产生不同误差排序，重建损伤还会降低波束成形性能；在条件匹配训练且针对最终接收机重优化APG时，AAT在六种代表性信道-功率条件下将NMSE降低2.40–3.79 dB。

Conclusion: 保护导频获取与保障量化反馈传输同样重要，AAT是有效的防御手段；AI CSI反馈的安全性需覆盖端到端链路的导频阶段。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based channel state information (CSI) feedback reduces overhead in frequency division duplexing (FDD) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, yet its reconstructed CSI depends on the integrity of pilot acquisition. This paper identifies and evaluates the attack path of adversarial pilot injection against this feedback. A transmitted disturbance can damage the user-side estimation before encoding; correctly delivered quantized bits can still represent a contaminated channel estimate. We model this path through attacker propagation, linear minimum mean square error estimation, compression, quantization, and decoding under a total transmit-energy constraint. An adversarial perturbation generator (APG) implements the attack using channel statistics without current legitimate CSI or instantaneous attacker-channel observations at deployment. At a Rician attacker-channel factor of 10~dB and a transmit perturbation-to-signal ratio of $-4$~dB, APG produces a normalized mean-square error (NMSE) of 0.84~dB in base-station CSI reconstruction, compared with $-10.31$~dB for Gaussian interference. Estimator-targeted and reconstruction-targeted attacks yield different error orderings, and reconstruction damage also degrades beamforming. As a countermeasure, alternating adversarial training (AAT) adapts the feedback encoder and decoder to contaminated pilots. With condition-matched training and APGs reoptimized for the final receiver, AAT reduces NMSE by 2.40--3.79~dB across six representative channel--power conditions. The results demonstrate the importance of protecting pilot acquisition alongside quantized feedback delivery.

</details>


### [502] [Confidence-Aware Speed-over-Ground Estimation from Doppler Spectra via Reconstruction-Based Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40253)
*Malte Stelzer,Marvin Sach,Timo Bartels,Dinu Mihailescu-Stoica,Sören Kohnert,Florian Poprawa,Marc Zeller,Tim Fingscheidt*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种置信度感知的对地速度估计方法，以自编码器潜在特征回归速度并输出帧级置信度，在铁路Doppler RaDAR数据上优于经典基线且鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地面朝向Doppler谱的对地速度估计对轨道交通等移动平台至关重要；经典信号处理方法在有利条件下准确，但在恶劣条件下显著退化。

Method: 在铁路域数据上训练；沿用自编码器重建任务用于性能估计的思路并迁移至Doppler RaDAR；在自编码器潜在空间特征上附加速度回归头；推理阶段舍弃重建解码器，改用低成本专用置信度头做逐帧误差界估计；采用噪声增强训练提升鲁棒性。

Result: 实验表明该方法相对经典基线提升了速度估计精度，并能给出有信息量的置信度，反映单帧预测在不利信号条件下的可靠性。

Conclusion: 潜在空间重建+专用置信度头的轻量设计可在不增加推理负担的情况下同时实现准确速度估计与可靠的帧级置信度评估。

Abstract: Reliable speed-over-ground estimation from ground-facing Doppler spectra is essential for mobile platforms such as railway systems.
