By contrast, DP-FedAvg substantially degrades utility at moderate privacy budgets with a small client cohort (K=5). Ablation study indicates that this degradation is driven mainly by the injected noise rather than by uniform averaging or update clipping. Macro-F1 exhibits sensitivity to performance degradation than accuracy under non-IID heterogeneity and class imbalance.

</details>


### [604] [Assessing feature scorer results on high-dimensional datasets with t-SNE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39009)
*Bruno Iochins Grisci,Mario Inostroza-Ponta,Márcio Dorn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 "weighted t-SNE"，将特征评分器给出的各维重要性嵌入二维降维关系中以可视化特征评分结果，并用轮廓系数作数值评估，在合成与真实表格数据集上结合九种特征评分器验证其可用于比较选择评分方法、增强模型可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维数据可视化文献丰富，但针对特征评分器（feature scorer）及其结果的可视化工作稀少。特征评分器为各特征赋予数值重要性，广泛用于特征选择、知识发现与模型可解释性；然而评分器众多且缺乏单一指标或真值来保证结果质量，因此需要可视化来辅助选择方法与评估效果。

Method: 对 t-SNE 进行加权改造：依据特征评分器给出的各维重要性，修改嵌入二维空间中数据点之间的关系（加权距离），使降维布局反映原始特征的重要性；同时提出以轮廓系数（silhouette coefficient）作为结果的数值评估指标，并给出实现方式与多个实践用例。

Result: 在合成与真实表格数据集上，结合九种特征评分器（从互信息到神经网络）实验：每种评分器产生独特可视化，weighted t-SNE 可用于比较并选出最契合特定数据集与任务的方法；还能可视化机器学习模型所学特征的重要性，展示其组织数据的方式。

Conclusion: weighted t-SNE 是一种有效的特征评分结果可视化手段，兼具定性比较与轮廓系数定量评估能力，可支持评分方法选择并提升机器学习模型的可解释性。

Abstract: While vast literature on high-dimensional data visualization is available, there are not many works regarding the visualization of feature scorers and their results. Feature scorers are algorithms that assign numerical importance to each feature of multi-dimensional datasets. These importance scores can be used in several applications, such as feature selection, knowledge discovery, and machine learning interpretability. There are several feature scorers to choose from, and often no single metric or ground truth is available to guarantee the quality of their results. In this scenario, visualization can become valuable to support the decision of which method to choose and how good its results are. For this goal, this work presents "weighted t-SNE." It modifies the relationship between data points in the embedded 2D space to reflect the importance of each dimension of the original datasets as assessed by a feature scorer. This research discusses how to implement weighted t-SNE, proposes the silhouette coefficient as a numerical evaluation of the results, and shows several examples of its use in practice. Synthetic and real-world tabular datasets are used in the experiments together with nine feature scorers, ranging from Mutual Information to neural networks. Each feature scorer produces unique visualizations, and weighted t-SNE can be used to compare and choose the one that better suits a given dataset and task. Weighted t-SNE can also visually show the importance of features learned by machine learning models and help us see how they are organizing the data, increasing their interpretability.

</details>


### [605] [Representation Complexity Along Learning Trajectories: Trading Width for Precision and Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39027)
*Ryan Singh,Miguel De Llanza,Christopher L. Buckley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文通过oracle学习模型与Kolmogorov n-宽，量化目标"可见性"所需的表示复杂度，证明发现预测器所需的表示宽度可显著超过表示其本身所需的宽度；对D维k-稀疏parity给出临界尺度 Θ̃_k(D^{k-1}τ²)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过参数化网络在训练中会经历比最终预测器所需更复杂的瞬态表示，其计算作用不明。作者追问：这种瞬态复杂度中，哪一部分是"使未知目标通过梯度反馈变得统计可见"所必需的，而非预测本身所需。

Method: 引入神经网络学习的oracle模型，用Kolmogorov n-宽度量有效表示复杂度；核心是把前向表示的复杂度界迁移到对应的梯度查询特征上，结合统计查询下界，得到与任务无关的、使目标相关梯度信息可被检测所需初始有效宽度的下界。对k-稀疏parity利用坐标符号反射不变性，去掉信息通道不可见的符号区分，导出更紧的无符号有效宽度。

Result: 一般界即给出表示与发现之间的多项式分离；parity的具体临界尺度为Θ̃_k(D^{k-1}τ²)（至对数因子）。将精度解释为对新鲜样本的累积，得到相应的宽度-时间前沿；实验支持预测的维度依赖，并揭示优化与泛化偏离该理想前沿的方式。

Conclusion: 发现一个预测器所需的表示资源可远多于学会后表示它所需的资源；过参数化中的瞬态复杂度部分承担了"使梯度信号可检测"的计算功能，宽度-时间前沿刻画了理想情形下的资源约束。

Abstract: What computational role does overparameterisation play during learning? Information-plane analyses suggest that neural networks can traverse representations substantially more complex than those required by their final predictors. We explore when this transient complexity serves a computational purpose by comparing the representation complexity needed for prediction with that needed to make an unknown target statistically visible through gradient feedback. We introduce an oracle model of neural network learning and use Kolmogorov \(n\)-widths to quantify effective representation complexity. Our main technical result transfers complexity bounds from the forward representation to the corresponding gradient-query features. Combined with statistical-query lower bounds, this gives a task-agnostic lower bound on the initial effective width required for target-dependent gradient information to become detectable. For \(k\)-sparse parity in \(D\) dimensions, a known target admits an \(O(k)\)-width representation, while the general bound already implies a polynomial separation between representation and discovery. We then exploit parity's invariance under coordinatewise sign reflections to identify a sharper unsigned effective width, which removes sign distinctions invisible to the parity information channel. At a transfer-compatible measurement resolution, its critical scale is \(\widetildeΘ_k\left( D^{k-1}τ^2 \right)\), up to logarithmic factors. Thus, the representation resources required to discover a predictor can substantially exceed those required to represent it once learned. Interpreting precision through accumulation over fresh samples yields a corresponding width-time frontier. Experiments support the predicted dimension dependence and examine how optimisation and generalisation depart from this idealised frontier.

</details>


### [606] [FairSplit: Decomposing the Embedding Space for Fair Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39031)
*Andrii Shkabrii,Anna Beer,Ylli Sadikaj,Claudia Plant*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FairSplit通过将嵌入空间分解为用于预测的Fair Space与隔离敏感信息的Sensitive Space，利用可学习掩码与HSIC约束实现公平分类，并给出人口平价差距的理论上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平分类需同时保持高准确率并降低对敏感信息的依赖；现有方法在处理多类任务与非二值敏感属性时存在局限。

Method: 学习嵌入空间的分解：Fair Space用于预测，Sensitive Space隔离敏感信息。训练中同时学习分类任务与公平/敏感信息分离，敏感属性在Sensitive Space中获得"归宿"，使Fair Space可在不依赖敏感信息的情况下预测。分解由可学习掩码引导，并以HSIC度量统计依赖性作为约束。

Result: 理论上证明人口平价差距同时被(i)Fair Space的学习维度与(ii)Fair Space与敏感属性间的HSIC上界约束；在标准公平性基准上取得具有竞争力的准确率-公平性权衡，且能有效处理多类任务与非二值敏感属性。

Conclusion: FairSplit以空间分解+HSIC约束的方式兼顾准确率与公平性，克服现有方法在多类与非二值敏感属性上的关键局限，并提供可解释的理论保证。

Abstract: Fair classification faces a twofold challenge: maintaining high classification accuracy while limiting reliance on sensitive information. Our method FairSplit achieves this by learning a decomposition of the embedding space into a Fair Space used for prediction and a Sensitive Space that isolates sensitive information. During training, the model must simultaneously learn the classification task and separate fair from sensitive information. The Sensitive Space gives sensitive attributes a destination, so the Fair Space can be used for prediction without relying on them. This decomposition is guided via a learnable mask and the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) as a measure of statistical dependence. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that the demographic parity gap is upper-bounded by both (i) the learned dimensionality of the Fair Space and (ii) the HSIC between the Fair Space and sensitive attributes. FairSplit effectively handles multiclass tasks and non-binary sensitive attributes, overcoming key limitations of existing fair classification methods. Experiments on established fairness benchmarks show that FairSplit achieves competitive accuracy-fairness trade-offs. Code is available at https://github.com/shkabrii/fairsplit.

</details>


### [607] [Exponential-Nemytskii Neural Operators: Learning Field Evolution Across Step Sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39041)
*Jingye Li,Jinglai Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种步长依赖由半线性动力学一阶Duhamel近似规定的算子，将精确线性传播与场及其导数的局部非线性函数结合，可在低于观测间隔的步长下评估而无需跨步长稠密监督；理论上证明两个步长上的一致性可控制指定范围内预测差异，并给出两分量局部可辨识性条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变步长算子学习中，在观测步长上的一致性并不能决定其他时间分辨率下的预测，因此需要一种显式规定步长依赖结构、可外推到更细时间步的算子学习框架。

Method: 基于半线性动力学的Duhamel公式做一阶近似来构造算子：线性部分精确传播，非线性部分为关于场及其导数的局部函数；固定空间分辨率下给出理论分析（两尺度一致性控制区间内预测误差、两分量从两个步长的局部可辨识性条件），并以潜空间扩展将同一构造作用于学习到的场。基模型在两个合成问题、扩展模型在两个真实数据集上与多种基线对比。

Result: 在适当条件与固定空间分辨率下，证明两个步长上模型间的一致性可控制其在给定范围内全程的预测差异；给出线性与非线性分量由两个步长局部可辨识的条件，从而支持所学结构的解释；潜空间扩展与基模型分别在合成与真实任务上进行了对比评估（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 将步长依赖结构由物理近似显式规定，可使算子学习在观测间隔以下进行合理外推，并获得可解释的分量分解，为跨时间分辨率预测提供有理论保证的途径。

Abstract: In variable-step operator learning, agreement at observed step sizes does not by itself determine predictions at other temporal resolutions. We propose an operator whose step-size dependence is prescribed by a first-order Duhamel approximation of semilinear dynamics. It combines exact linear propagation with a local nonlinear function of the field and its derivatives, allowing evaluation below the observation interval without supervision densely sampled across step sizes. Under suitable conditions and at fixed spatial resolution, we prove that agreement between models at two step sizes controls their prediction differences throughout a prescribed range. We also give conditions for local identifiability of both components from two step sizes, supporting interpretation of the learned structure. A latent extension applies the same construction to learned fields. We evaluate the base model on two synthetic problems and the extension on two real datasets against several baselines.

</details>


### [608] [Reinforcement Learning for the Game of Balatro: A Fast Simulator and Two-Policy Training Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39049)
*Ajay Vikram Periasami,Anjaneya Gupta,Ethan Cheng,Ivan Rosales*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了端到端流水线（Rust模拟器+BalatroBot状态校验、压缩观测-动作接口与动态合法动作掩码、战术盲注策略与战略商店策略共享状态的多智能体PPO），在Balatro上首次实现稳定通关首个盲注，并将剩余差距定位于长程战略规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Balatro具备三大RL难点：约3000维状态依赖动作空间、数百步决策的长时程与稀疏奖励、抽牌与商店生成的强随机性，导致已发表的RL成果稀少，缺乏可复现的强基线。

Method: (i) 高通量Rust模拟器，通过BalatroBot与真实游戏客户端自动做状态差异校验；(ii) 压缩的观测-动作接口，按步动态掩蔽非法动作；(iii) 多智能体PPO，将游戏分解为战术性盲注策略与战略性商店策略，两策略共享完整游戏状态但在不相交阶段行动；并以逐智能体奖励路由与显式跨智能体信用分配部分缓解长时程信用分配问题。

Result: 主联合训练出现明显相变：首盲注通关率收敛至99%以上，平均回合回报提升约一个数量级，并在平均最高ante为3（共8）处进入平台期；相同奖励下的单智能体基线在贪心与囤积两种失败模式间振荡，无法稳定通关首盲注。

Conclusion: 双策略分解可作为Balatro的有效反应式强基线，剩余性能差距主要源于长时程战略规划而非战术性盲注操作。

Abstract: Balatro, a 2024 roguelike deckbuilder, presents three difficulties that have historically derailed reinforcement learning methods: a 3,000-action state-dependent action space, horizons of several hundred decisions with sparse rewards, and pervasive stochasticity in both card draws and shop generation. Published RL results on the game remain scarce. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline comprising (i) a high-throughput Rust simulator that is automatically state-diffed against the live game client via BalatroBot, (ii) a condensed observation-action interface with dynamic per-step masking of legal moves, and (iii) a multi-agent PPO architecture that decomposes play into a tactical blind policy and a strategic shop policy that share the full game state but act in disjoint phases. Long-horizon credit assignment is partially addressed by per-agent reward routing with explicit cross-agent credit. On the main joint run, training metrics show a sharp phase transition in which the first-blind clear rate converges above 99% and mean episode return increases by roughly an order of magnitude, plateauing at a mean maximum ante of 3 out of 8; single-agent baselines under identical rewards oscillated between greedy and hoarding failure modes and did not stably clear the first blind. These results establish the two-policy decomposition as a strong reactive baseline for Balatro and localise the remaining gap to long-horizon strategic planning rather than tactical blind play.

</details>


### [609] [BASILISC: Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39050)
*Sepideh Saran,Mahsa Ghanbari,Uwe Ohler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BASILISC，一个贝叶斯孪生网络框架，为跨模态单细胞表征匹配提供对应关系层面的不确定性度量；首次用已知真值配对评估学习到的跨模态对应不确定性，并在细胞类型级与细胞级两个层面验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数单细胞数据为单模态，整合依赖在多模态数据上训练的匹配模型；这些模型只给出匹配结果，很少给出置信度，无法判断匹配是否可靠，也难以筛选高质量配对或识别分布外细胞类型。

Method: BASILISC 对两种模态构建概率化孪生网络，输出跨模态细胞对的对应关系预测分布。两个实例层级：细胞类型级判断两细胞是否同类；细胞级判断具体配对细胞。跨模态相似度学习反映细胞谱系；另设确定性匹配器的深度集成作为对照。

Result: 细胞类型级：未见类型平衡准确率0.86（已见0.93），分布外细胞预测不确定性升高；丢弃最不确定的1/5配对，准确率由0.93升至0.98。细胞级：深度集成在基准测试集达0.062匹配准确率，超过竞赛冠军；贝叶斯匹配器后验在标记跨细胞类型边界的错误匹配上AUROC 0.68，优于确定性读数的0.64。

Conclusion: 对应关系上的不确定性可有效用于质量筛选、分布外检测与错误匹配识别，并优于确定性基线；该框架为跨模态单细胞匹配提供了首个可对照真值评估的不确定性评分。

Abstract: Single-cell assays study the genome one cell at a time. Unimodal assays measure one molecular layer, the newer multimodal assays measure several. Most data are single-modality, so integrating them relies on models trained on multimodal assays, where the cell correspondence across modalities is known. These models return a matching, but rarely a confidence measure. We present BASILISC (Bayesian Alignment of Siamese-Integrated Latents for Inferring Single-cell Correspondence), a framework for matching single-cell representations with uncertainty on the correspondence itself. A BASILISC model is a probabilistic siamese network over the two modalities with a predictive distribution over the correspondence for a cross-modal pair of cells. We instantiate it at two levels: at the cell-type level the question is whether two cells share a cell type, at the cell level which cell is the partner in the other modality. To our knowledge, this is the first uncertainty score on a learned cross-modal correspondence evaluated against a known ground-truth pairing. BASILISC learns a similarity across modalities that reflects cell lineage: an unseen cell type is matched to its lineage relative, matching still works on such held-out types (balanced accuracy 0.86 on unseen against 0.93 on seen types), and the predictive uncertainty rises on these out-of-distribution cells. The uncertainty score also selects high-quality matches for downstream analysis: discarding the least certain fifth of the pairs raises accuracy from 0.93 to 0.98. At the cell level, a deep ensemble of the deterministic matcher reaches 0.062 matching accuracy on the benchmark test set, above the competition winner; on the Bayesian matcher's assignment, the posterior flags the wrong matches that cross a cell-type boundary better than a deterministic read of the same scores (AUROC 0.68 against 0.64).

</details>


### [610] [When Does Closed-Loop Curriculum Adaptation Help GRPO? An Analysis on Countdown](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39056)
*Yuv Raj Pant,Moshiur Rahman Tonmoy,Kaiqun Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN，一种轻量级自适应课程方法，在保持 Easy-to-Hard 高斯采样器结构的同时，用周期性探针估计的逐难度准确率动态调节课程节奏与分布宽度，从而提升 GRPO 强化微调的样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化微调（RFT）在提升大模型推理能力上有效，但当训练分布与模型当前能力不匹配时样本效率低：GRPO 等组相对目标下，过难问题产生全失败 rollout（无优势信号），过易问题优势信号微弱。固定 easy-to-hard 课程无法自适应模型实际进展。

Method: 保留 Easy-to-Hard 高斯采样器结构，引入闭环控制器：周期性探针评估各难度上的准确率，据此动态调整课程的推进速度与采样分布宽度——领先参考课程时加速，落后时减速，早期难度出现回退时扩大采样范围。不修改奖励函数、模型架构与 GRPO 优化器。

Result: 在符号算术推理任务上，精确匹配准确率优于 vanilla GRPO 与固定开环课程；增益在中等难度区间最显著，即组相对学习信号最具信息量的区域。

Conclusion: 基于探针反馈的难度调度闭环机制可低成本地维持训练处于"有挑战但可学习"的区间，是提升 RFT 样本效率的即插即用方案；实验仅限符号算术任务，泛化性有待验证。

Abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, but it remains sample-inefficient when the training distribution is mismatched to the model's current capability. In group-relative objectives such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), problems that are too hard often produce uniformly failed rollouts, while problems that are too easy provide little useful advantage signal. In this work, we introduce CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN, a lightweight adaptive curriculum method for efficient reinforcement fine-tuning on ordered reasoning tasks. Instead of following a fixed easy-to-hard schedule, CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN preserves the structure of an Easy-to-Hard Gaussian sampler while dynamically adjusting its pace and spread using periodic probe estimates of per-difficulty accuracy. The controller accelerates training when the model is ahead of a reference curriculum, slows down when the model falls behind, and broadens sampling when earlier difficulties regress. This feedback mechanism keeps training focused on tasks that are challenging but still learnable, without changing the reward function, model architecture, or underlying GRPO optimizer. Experiments on symbolic arithmetic reasoning task show that CLOSEDLOOPGAUSSIAN improves exact-match accuracy over vanilla GRPO and fixed open-loop curricula, with the strongest gains in intermediate-difficulty regimes where group-relative learning signals are most informative. Codes are available at https://github.com/yuvrajpant56/Closed_Loop_Curriculum.

</details>


### [611] [Closed Gates Leak: Decomposing Adjacent-Layer Cancellation in Gated Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39068)
*Harvey Dam,Ganesh Gopalakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新解释门控MLP相邻层在残差流中的“相互抵消”现象：这种抵消并非下一层有选择地拒绝上一层提出的特征，而是门控MLP对输入方向施加的一种普遍收缩（damping）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作将相邻层写入残差流的相互抵消解读为“层提出特征、下一层选择性拒绝不合适特征”，并把相关特征值签名当作选择性的证据。作者质疑这一解释，希望从机制层面分解抵消的来源。

Method: 将前一层写入从下一MLP的输入中移除，把下一层沿该写入方向上写出的部分分解为“本来就会写出的量”与“因该写入存在而减少的量”（称为damping），并将damping归因到具体神经元；在门控MLP中考察gate关闭神经元的贡献，并进行跨token对比、训练过程跟踪，以及在继续预训练中退火gate激活负半侧。

Result: damping由gate关闭的神经元承担：SiLU/GELU在零点以下略为负值，关闭的gate仍传递输入的少量负倍数，输出权重沿输入权重方向的神经元便减去所读方向的一部分。求和后，关闭gate收缩门控MLP读取的平均方向，且前一层写入并不特殊——同一层在另一token上的写入受到同等或更强的damping，此前据以推断“选择性修正”的特征值签名在另一token的写入上同样出现。训练中damping逐渐增大而“本来会写出的量”保持平稳，抵消出现在damping超过它之时；退火掉gate激活的负半侧可消除damping与抵消。

Conclusion: 相邻层抵消是关于“模型拒绝哪些特征”的弱证据：它源自门控MLP对任意读取方向施加的平均收缩，而非针对上一层写入的选择性拒绝。

Abstract: In transformer language models with gated multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), adjacent layers write partly against each other into the residual stream. Previous work interpreted this cancellation as layers proposing features and the next layer selectively rejecting the inappropriate ones. We decompose the cancellation by removing the previous layer's write from the input of the next MLP: what the next layer writes along that write splits into what it writes anyway and how much less its MLP writes because the write is present, which we call the damping, and we trace the damping to the neurons that carry it. In gated MLPs the damping is carried by neurons whose gates are closed. SiLU and GELU are slightly negative below zero, so a closed gate still passes a small negative multiple of what the neuron reads, and a neuron whose output weight points along its input weight then subtracts a fraction of the direction it read. Summed over such neurons, closed gates contract the average direction a gated MLP reads, and the previous layer's write is not singled out: the same layer's write at another token is damped as much or more, and the eigenvalue signature from which that work concluded that the correction is selective appears for another token's write as well. Over training the damping grows while what the next layer writes anyway stays flat, and cancellation begins when the damping overtakes it; annealing the negative side of the gate activation away in continued pretraining removes the damping and the cancellation. Adjacent-layer cancellation is therefore weak evidence about which features a model rejects: it is produced by a contraction that gated MLPs apply, on average over directions, to whatever they read.

</details>


### [612] [Generating Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience in Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39100)
*Jorge de Freitas,Christos Ziakas,Alessandra Russo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CGSE：将世界模型用作局部转移生成器，通过 critic 引导在信任域内精炼动作并合成经验，在三个 OGBench 操作任务上将离线策略平均成功率相对提升 7.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线数据难以扩展（真实环境采样昂贵或不安全）；世界模型虽可生成新经验，但在隐空间直接学策略会因想象 rollout 中的复合误差而受限。

Method: 把世界模型当作局部转移生成器：由离线策略采样候选动作，在信任域内沿 Q 函数的一阶近似对每个动作做精炼；用冻结的隐空间世界模型预测更新后动作对应的未来状态，再由 critic 挑选最优动作，将合成转移写入回放缓冲区（生成过程完全离线，无需额外真实交互或测试时规划器）。

Result: 在三个 OGBench 操作任务上，使离线策略平均成功率取得 7.1% 的相对提升。

Conclusion: 以 critic 引导的动作精炼 + 冻结世界模型的短程想象可有效规避复合误差，为离线数据扩充提供无需真实交互的实用途径。

Abstract: Learning from offline datasets is limited in scalability, as collecting new experience is often costly or unsafe in the real world. World models offer an alternative way to generate new experience through a learned dynamics model, yet learning policies in latent space is limited due to compounding errors in imagined rollouts. To this end, we propose using the world model as a local transition generator, leveraging critic guidance to choose actions inside that model to generate synthetic experiences. We study action refinement methodologies, introducing Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience (CGSE) generation in world models. Specifically, CGSE augments an existing offline dataset by sampling candidate actions using an offline policy and refining each to maximize a first-order approximation of the $Q$-function within a trust region. We then use a frozen latent world model to imagine the future state given each updated action, and use the critic to choose the best one, appending this synthetic transition to the replay buffer. Our method requires no additional real-environment interaction or test-time planner, as it generates synthetic experience offline using the world model. On three OGBench manipulation tasks, CGSE improves an offline policy by a relative improvement of $7.1\%$ on the average success rate.

</details>


### [613] [From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39114)
*Jiaqi Wang,Yisen Gao,Huayang Shi,Junhao Hou,Wengen Li,Jihong Guan,Yichao Zhang,Shuigeng Zhou,Yangqiu Song,Hong Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LatentDiff将三元组集合预测(TSP)重构为潜空间图生成：用关系感知残差量化自编码器把整图编码为紧凑潜在表示，再用观测锚定的潜在图扩散模型逐步去噪补全缺失三元组，在三个基准上F_tsp平均超过SOTA 5.4个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSP方法主要依赖基于子图的补全范式：先将原图切分为局部子图再独立补全。该范式存在结构推理碎片化、跨子图依赖建模受限、以及跨子图缺失预测的问题。

Method: 1) 关系感知残差量化知识图谱自编码器：将整图编码为关系感知潜在嵌入，用分块残差码本进行量化，并通过因子化解码器重建三元组，得到紧凑潜空间；2) 观测锚定的潜在图扩散模型：将目标潜在图表示向观测潜在扰动，反向过程通过渐进式潜空间去噪恢复缺失三元组。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，F_tsp指标平均超越SOTA 5.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 以统一的全局潜空间图生成替代子图独立补全，可有效缓解结构推理碎片化与跨子图依赖缺失问题，验证了潜空间扩散用于三元组集合预测的有效性。

Abstract: Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. On top of this latent space, we introduce an observation-anchored latent graph diffusion model, where the target latent graph representation is perturbed toward the observed latent. The reverse process recovers missing triples through progressive latent denoising. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that LatentDiff outperforms the SOTA in terms of F_{tsp} by 5.4 percentage points on average. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LKGDiff-44A5.

</details>


### [614] [Uncertainty-Guided Cross-Modal Alignment for Diffusion-Based IoT Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39117)
*Mahdi Arab Loodaricheh,Anita Raja,Mohammad Hossein Manshaei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于归一化VAE后验方差的可靠性引导跨模态对齐规则，用于多模态扩散模型生成少数类攻击样本以缓解IoT入侵检测类别不平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型采样行为依赖去噪表示的几何结构，而多模态数据的独立编码器会将同步视图映射到不兼容潜空间区域，均匀对齐又可能让不确定视图扭曲共享几何，因此需要在扩散训练前引入可靠性引导的对齐。

Method: 在TON-IoT上，用模态特定的VAE分别编码表格流属性、DeepInsight图像与包序列；以各模态归一化后验方差作为有界、样本特定的权重信号，在非对称stop-gradient对齐目标中控制跨模态方向性影响；对齐微调后对完整潜均值标准化，由类条件EDM联合建模，再用二阶采样器生成配对攻击条件潜块供三个解码器生成样本。

Result: 三种扩散变体中不确定性感知对齐取得最高平均精度、召回、密度与覆盖；仅增强训练集后，在未触碰的真实测试集上ROC-AUC 0.9515、PR-AUC 0.8954、平衡准确率0.8395、攻击类F1 0.7940；在对齐微调匹配的两变体中，基于后验方差的加权相对均匀加权同时提升表格生成保真度与下游检测性能。

Conclusion: VAE后验方差（作为启发式可靠性代理，非校准概率不确定性）可有效约束多模态潜空间对齐的跨模态影响，改善少数类攻击生成质量与不平衡入侵检测效果。

Abstract: Diffusion models evolve noisy states toward a learned data distribution, so their sampling behavior depends on the geometry of the representation in which denoising occurs. This dependence is especially important for multimodal data: independently trained encoders can map synchronized views to incompatible latent regions, while uniform alignment can let an uncertain view distort the shared geometry. To address this gap, we introduce a novel reliability-guided alignment rule that uses normalized VAE posterior variance to control directional cross-modal influence before diffusion training. We study this issue in minority-attack generation for imbalanced Internet-of-Things intrusion detection. Tabular flow attributes, a DeepInsight image, and a packet sequence are encoded by modality-specific variational autoencoders. Per-modality normalized VAE posterior variances provide bounded, sample-specific weighting signals in an asymmetric stop-gradient alignment objective. We use these quantities as heuristic encoder-derived reliability proxies rather than calibrated probabilistic uncertainties. The full modality-specific latent means obtained after alignment fine-tuning are standardized and modeled jointly by a class-conditional EDM; a second-order sampler then generates paired attack-conditioned latent blocks for the three decoders. In controlled experiments on TON-IoT, uncertainty-aware alignment obtains the highest mean precision, recall, density, and coverage among three diffusion variants. Augmenting only the training split yields ROC-AUC 0.9515, PR-AUC 0.8954, balanced accuracy 0.8395, and attack-class F1 0.7940 on an untouched real test set. Among the two variants with matched alignment fine-tuning, posterior-variance-based weighting improves both tabular generative fidelity and downstream detection relative to uniform weighting.

</details>


### [615] [Clean Sheets and Checkpoints: Evidence Complexity for Certifying Sequential Agent Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39124)
*Rohith Yanambaka Venkata,Don McBride,Tiago Sequeira,Md. Al Amin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究"零成功审计"的认证能力：在将任务建模为k个里程碑组成的链、划分为检查点段的框架下，确定需要多少个零审查询问才能以水平α认证完成概率不超过ε；并给出稀有风险相位内部下最小期望零响应的渐近常数及最优评估器的分配方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 危险能力评估常从有序里程碑的预备状态测试AI智能体，而"完美记录"(无成功)究竟能认证什么，取决于失败尝试所"擦除"的信息。作者希望形式化这一认证问题：给定审计预算B与统计水平α，量化零审计结果对完成概率上界ε的认证强度，并刻画达到最优认证所需的最少询问量。

Method: 将任务建模为k个里程碑组成的链，划分为检查点段；先在段为审计前选定的情形下，通过计数可能的完成窗口(candidate completion windows)构造对任意指定预算成立的证书。随后将该界推广到沿链转移的自适应部署过程，条件是每条完整历史后的成功概率被对应的审计成功概率所上界约束（该"传输假设"审计本身不检验）。进入稀有风险相位内部后，将各段分为"活跃"(预算内很少完成)与"自由"(几乎总完成)，刻画活跃段（含K_A个里程碑、长度不小于与预算相关的阈值）并推导最小期望零响应数的渐近形式；进而分析活跃段与自由段交替处（单段由活跃转为自由）的极限分配份额，构造考虑交叉(crossover)的证书；并讨论已知或未查询前缀步骤时通过计数失败周期来锐化证书。

Result: 对审计前选定的段，计数完成窗口可给出任意指定预算下的认证；该界在满足逐历史成功概率上界条件的自适应部署过程中仍成立。在稀有风险相位内部，最小期望零响应数渐近为 log(1/α)·(B^a/(a!·ε))^{1/K_A}，其中活跃段数量为a、共含K_A个里程碑；所给证书达到该常数，且任何渐近最优评估器在极限下必须把期望响应数平均分配给各活跃里程碑，其余位置份额趋于零。当单个段由活跃转为自由时，该段每个里程碑获得的极限份额小于活跃里程碑，交叉感知(crossover-aware)证书可达到最优常数。对含已知或未查询前缀步骤的选定段，计数失败周期可进一步锐化证书。

Conclusion: 零成功审计的认证能力由失败尝试"擦除"什么以及完成窗口的计数方式共同决定：存在达到渐近最优常数的证书，且最优评估器必须把询问预算近乎均衡地集中到活跃里程碑上；活跃/自由段交界处的份额差异需要交叉感知证书才能保持最优常数，而利用前缀步骤的失败周期信息可进一步收紧证书。

Abstract: Dangerous-capability evaluations often test an AI agent from prepared states at ordered milestones. A clean sheet records no successes. What it certifies about a campaign of $B$ attempts depends on what a failed attempt erases. We model the task as a chain of $k$ milestones divided into checkpoint segments and ask how many zero audit responses certify, at level $α$, a completion probability of at most $ε$. For segments chosen before the audit, counting possible completion windows gives a certificate for any specified budget. The bound also covers adaptive deployment processes that follow the chain's transitions, provided their success probabilities after every complete history are capped by the corresponding audit success probabilities. The audit does not test this transport assumption. In rare-risk phase interiors, each segment is either rarely completed within the budget (active) or nearly always completed (free). The minimum expected number of zero responses is asymptotic to $\log(1/α)\,(B^a/(a!\,ε))^{1/K_A}$, where the $a$ active segments contain $K_A$ milestones and are those at least as long as a budget-dependent threshold. The certificate attains this constant. Every asymptotically optimal evaluator must divide its expected response count equally among active milestones in the limit, with a vanishing share elsewhere. Where a single segment passes from active to free, each of its milestones receives a smaller limiting share than an active milestone; a crossover-aware certificate attains the optimal constant. For selected segments with known or unqueried prefix steps, counting failed cycles can sharpen the certificate.

</details>


### [616] [A Novel Approach to Evaluating Evaluation Metrics for Multi-Output Structured Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39162)
*Akshay Vyas,Angelo Pimienta,Nicholas Ruozzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出“近似任务特定不变量”作为诊断工具，通过增强损失强制模型输出满足领域相关不变量，系统检验视觉与语言多输出结构化预测任务中各指标的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多输出结构化预测任务中训练数据往往只给出单一标签，但存在多个同等有效的输出，导致评估困难。作者假设人类评估者隐式依赖任务特定不变量（如上色图像的物体边界、翻译中的命名实体）判断输出是否可接受。

Method: 引入近似任务特定不变量的概念，用其诊断性地评估现有视觉与语言指标；构建一个框架，通过增强损失函数鼓励模型输出中体现领域相关不变量，从而系统测试指标可靠性。

Result: 实验表明，用增强损失强制不变量后，流行的分布型指标显著提升，而传统指标仅轻微变化；该不变量驱动的评估揭示了标准指标无法检测有意义差异的情形。

Conclusion: 不变量驱动的评估可暴露标准指标的失效之处，并明确了分布型指标成功或仍不足的条件，为多输出结构化预测任务的可靠评估提供了新视角。

Abstract: In multi-output structured prediction tasks, while only one ground truth label may be provided in the training data, multiple equally valid outputs may be possible, making reliable evaluation a persistent challenge. We postulate that human evaluators implicitly use task-specific invariants, e.g., object boundaries in colorized images or named entities in translations, to judge if an output is acceptable. Under this assumption, we introduce a notion of approximate task-specific invariants and use them as diagnostic tools to evaluate a variety of existing metrics for vision and language tasks. We use these task invariants as part of a framework to systematically test metric reliability by encouraging domain-relevant invariants in model outputs via an augmented loss function. In our experiments, we observe that enforcing invariants with an augmented loss yields substantial improvements in popular distributional metrics while more traditional metrics change only marginally. Through this invariants-driven evaluation, we expose where standard metrics fail to detect meaningful differences, and we highlight the conditions under which distributional metrics succeed or still fall short.

</details>


### [617] [ACAM-J-MARS: Multi-Atlas Riemannian Spectral Representations for Decoding Advanced Meditation States from fMRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39171)
*Jian Wang,Winson F. Z. Yang,Wugeng Zheng,Matthew D. Sacchet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ACAM-J-MARS，一种多图谱、黎曼流形与频谱表征方法，用于从 fMRI 解码高级专注吸收冥想（ACAM-J）状态，在三类分类上较最强基线绝对提升 10.8 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从 fMRI 推断 ACAM-J 状态困难：冥想相关效应空间分布广、个体间差异可超过个体内状态差异、样本量有限；而传统机器学习采用单模态、欧氏、图谱化分类，忽略功能连接矩阵的非欧几何结构并低估时间信息，导致性能次优。

Method: ACAM-J-MARS（Multi-Atlas Riemannian Spectral representation）：(1) 使用多个图谱计算功能连接；(2) 将对称正定（SPD）连接矩阵表征于黎曼流形；(3) 通过 log-Euclidean 切空间投影将其线性化；(4) 在连接特征之外融合低频 BOLD 频谱能量，以在异质变异下分辨细微状态差异。

Result: 在 22 名练习者的 204 个片段上评估，多种骨干模型性能均提升：早期 vs 晚期 ACAM-J 二分类平衡准确率 0.757；三分类 0.545，较最强基线绝对提升 10.8 个百分点。

Conclusion: 所提表征可改善高级冥想脑状态的解码，并有望支持闭环神经反馈与实时心理生理脑机接口等下游应用。

Abstract: Inferring jhana-type advanced concentration absorption meditation (ACAM-J) states from fMRI data is challenging due to the spatially distributed nature of meditation-related effects, substantial inter-individual variability that can exceed within-subject state differences, and limited sample sizes. Conventional machine-learning approaches often formulate this problem as unimodal, Euclidean, atlas-based classification, thereby neglecting the non-Euclidean geometry of functional connectivity matrices and underrepresenting temporal information in functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI); these limitations can lead to suboptimal classification performance. We propose ACAM-J-MARS (\textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}tlas \textbf{R}iemannian \textbf{S}pectral representation), which computes functional connectivity using multiple atlases, represents symmetric positive definite (SPD) connectivity matrices on a Riemannian manifold, projects them into a log-Euclidean tangent space, and augments connectivity-derived features with low-frequency BOLD spectral energy to better resolve subtle state differences under heterogeneous variability. Evaluated on 204 segments from 22 practitioners, ACAM-J-MARS improves performance across multiple backbone models, achieving a balanced accuracy of 0.757 for early versus late ACAM-J classification and 0.545 for three-class classification, corresponding to a 10.8-point absolute improvement over the strongest baseline. These findings suggest that the proposed representation improves the decoding of advanced meditative brain states and may enable downstream applications such as closed-loop neurofeedback and real-time psychophysiological brain-computer interfaces.

</details>


### [618] [Analyzing Condensation on Patterned Surfaces via Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39195)
*Tae E. Cooper,Michael Gee,Sheila Whitman,Jemma Dengel,Anthony Katselas,Duygu Dengiz,Frank Keutsch,Joanna Aizenberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于SAM3的分层切片液滴分割工具TileSAM3，解决非均匀冷凝表面液滴检测难题，在缺陷/图案化表面上平均精度较阈值法提升六倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 滴状冷凝的成核、生长、合并、脱落各阶段速率受非均匀表面特征（图案化或随机缺陷）支配，精确表征需检测数千个液滴；但现有分割方法无法在非均匀表面（尤其光照不良、视频质量差）上有效检测液滴。

Method: 在Segment Anything Model 3（SAM3）基础上构建通用液滴分割工具TileSAM3：采用分层切片（hierarchical tiling）+逐块推理+后处理，扩展检测容量上限并提升小液滴的有效分辨率；构建两个数据集——均质表面高质量液滴数据集HQDD（N=365,826）与图案化、含缺陷、光照恶劣的低质量液滴数据集LQDD（N=63,577）；并结合KD-tree跟踪进行液滴轨迹分析。

Result: 在HQDD上高度复现阈值分割标注结果；在LQDD上平均精度0.57，较阈值法（0.088）提升逾六倍；在所有评估指标上优于其他深度学习模型。结合KD-tree跟踪，在刚度图案化表面上识别出狭窄活性带内的局域化成核与合并现象。

Conclusion: TileSAM3使光照与成像条件较差、此前研究不足的非均匀基底得以分析，可加速冷凝材料的低成本研究。

Abstract: Dropwise condensation is key to power and water systems. State-of-the-art condensation surfaces are often inhomogeneous, either patterned by design or random defects. Inhomogeneous surface features dictate the rates of each stage of dropwise condensation-nucleation, growth, coalescence, and shedding. Characterizing these rates requires the precise detection of thousands of droplets. Yet, existing segmentation methods are unable to detect droplets on inhomogeneous surfaces. We developed TileSAM3, a universal droplet segmentation tool built on the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). Hierarchical tiling with per-tile inference followed by post-processing extended SAM3's detection cap and raised the effective resolution of small droplets. We created two datasets: High Quality Droplet Dataset (N=365,826; HQDD) with homogeneous surfaces and Low Quality Droplet Dataset (N=63,577; LQDD) with patterned, defect-laden surfaces under adverse lighting. TileSAM3 closely reproduced thresholding annotations on HQDD, surpassed it over sixfold on LQDD (Average Precision 0.57 versus 0.088), and outperformed other deep learning models on all metrics evaluated. Combined with KD-tree tracking, TileSAM3 identified localized nucleation and coalescence in narrow active bands on a stiffness-patterned surface. TileSAM3 enables analysis of understudied inhomogeneous substrates with poor lighting and videography which facilitates faster, lower cost research of condensation materials.

</details>


### [619] [Sparse Autoencoders as Implicit Diversification Regularisers for Cross-Sectional Cryptocurrency Returns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39205)
*Weijia Han,Lisha Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）能在加密货币与股票收益上用少量活跃特征表示资产收益，其组合波动率更低、所选资产相关性更低，但风险调整收益不及简单反转策略，且因子身份在多次训练间不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经因子在资产定价与组合构建中应用广泛，但可解释性差，且其对组合风险的作用不明确。作者试图检验稀疏编码能否同时缓解这两点：既给出稳定的金融因子，又能改善组合分散化。

Method: 采用稀疏自编码器对大量资产的日度收益进行低维稀疏表示，以加密货币收益为主实验、股票为次样本；在时间序列有序的评估框架下，将SAE与常见基准（含简单反转策略）比较，并考察组合波动率、所选资产间相关性及因子身份在多次训练中的稳定性。

Result: SAE组合波动率一致低于基准，该效应可归因于所选资产间相关性更低；但SAE在风险调整收益上未超过简单反转策略，且其因子身份在重复训练中不稳定。

Conclusion: 稀疏编码可支持组合分散化，但应将这一风险效应与alpha生成及稳定因子身份的论断明确区分。

Abstract: Factor models are central to asset pricing and portfolio construction, but neural factors are often difficult to interpret, and their effect on portfolio risk is unclear. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) may address both concerns by describing daily returns across many assets with only a few active features. We ask whether this sparse representation produces stable financial factors and better-diversified portfolios. We study cryptocurrency returns, use equities as a secondary test, and compare the SAE with common benchmarks in a time-ordered evaluation. We find consistently lower volatility in SAE portfolios and link this result to lower correlations among the selected assets. However, the SAE does not outperform a simple contrarian strategy on risk-adjusted return, and its factor identities are not stable across training runs. Our contribution is to show that sparse coding can support portfolio diversification, while clearly separating this risk effect from claims about alpha or stable factor identities.

</details>


### [620] [Where Position Matters: Profiling-Guided Layer-Wise RoPE Allocation in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39223)
*Zhiwei Liu,Boao Kong,Bing Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出基于剖析（profiling）的分层 RoPE 分配框架：在固定预算下，依据早期“覆盖收益”轮廓为不同层分配高/低旋转覆盖，并支持固定宽度查询/键表示与 MLA 中的物理旋转维度分配；通过归一化深度映射在同族模型间迁移配置，使小模型测量可指导大模型预训练前的分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RoPE 通常在所有 Transformer 层采用统一覆盖，但各层的位置需求实际上是异质的：相位干预显示旋转相位依赖是非均匀且模型特有的，而覆盖干预则揭示其与“覆盖升级收益”相关。这提示统一分配存在冗余与不足，值得按层定制。

Method: 1) 以相位（phase-off）与覆盖两类干预刻画各层旋转相位/覆盖依赖，构建“覆盖收益”轮廓；2) 据此在固定预算约束下做分层高低覆盖分配（profiling-guided layer-wise RoPE allocation）；3) 框架兼容固定宽度 query/key 表示，并支持 MLA 中的物理旋转维度分配；4) 用归一化深度映射在同族模型间迁移轮廓，实现小模型测量指导大模型分配；5) 分析将选择与迁移联系到分数校准与层间交互；6) 从零训练实验，与预算匹配基线对比，并进行资源核算。

Result: 从零训练实验显示，相较可得的预算匹配基线，验证损失有所改善；解析式资源核算表明物理 MLA 方案在质量—存储—计算权衡上更有利。

Conclusion: 结果将位置需求与可迁移、高效的架构设计联系起来：分层 RoPE 覆盖可按预算自适应分配，且小模型剖面向大模型的迁移可降低搜索成本，为位置编码的结构化设计提供依据。

Abstract: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) typically uses uniform coverage across Transformer layers despite heterogeneous positional requirements. Phase-off interventions reveal non-uniform, model-specific rotary-phase dependence, while coverage interventions relate it to coverage-upgrade benefits. We propose profiling-guided layer-wise RoPE allocation, assigning high/low coverage under a fixed budget using early coverage-benefit profiles. The framework supports fixed-width query/key representations and physical rotary-dimension allocation in Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). Normalized-depth mapping transfers profiles within model families, enabling small-model measurements to guide larger-model allocations before pretraining. A brief analysis relates selection and transfer to score calibration and inter-layer interactions. From-scratch experiments demonstrate validation-loss improvements over available budget-matched baselines, while analytical resource accounting identifies favorable quality--storage--compute trade-offs for physical MLA. These results connect positional demand to transferable, efficient architecture design.

</details>


### [621] [IMRouter: Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39246)
*Xin Yang,Cai Xu,Haishun Chen,Ying Liu,Jie Zhao,Wei Zhao,Ziyu Guan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出IMRouter框架，通过模式自适应时间表示学习(PATR)与路由引导语义对齐(RGSA)缓解时间模式不平衡(TPI)，提升低频模式预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的时间序列预测方法只优化整体预测目标，忽视了时间模式不平衡(TPI)——不同时间模式出现频率极不均衡；实证分析表明该现象在主流TSF基准上普遍存在，且低频模式误差显著更高。

Method: IMRouter包含两部分：(1) PATR利用梯度冲突与局部梯度密度引导专家专业化，以密度感知加权惩罚不兼容的专家分配，削弱频繁优化信号在路由器训练中的主导地位；(2) RGSA通过互信息最大化，将路由器学到的模式特定知识迁移到跨模态对齐中，保留不同模式下的判别性时间信息。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了IMRouter的有效性，尤其在提升低频时间模式的预测性能方面表现突出。

Conclusion: 显式建模并缓解时间模式不平衡，可有效纠偏基于LLM的TSF中的表示学习与跨模态对齐偏差，为不平衡场景下的预测提供可行范式。

Abstract: Accurate time series forecasting (TSF) is essential for Web applications, such as traffic monitoring and online resource management. Recent advances in leveraging pre-trained large language models (LLMs) have shown promising performance in TSF. However, existing LLM-based TSF methods largely optimize the overall forecasting objective while overlooking temporal pattern imbalance (TPI), where different temporal patterns occur at highly unequal frequencies. Our empirical analysis reveals that TPI is prevalent across widely used TSF benchmarks, with substantially higher forecasting errors on less frequent patterns. To address this issue, we propose IMRouter (Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing), a novel framework that mitigates TPI-induced biases in both temporal representation learning and cross-modal alignment. Specifically, IMRouter introduces Pattern-Adaptive Temporal Representation Learning (PATR), which leverages gradient conflict and local gradient density to guide expert specialization. By penalizing incompatible expert assignments with density-aware weighting, PATR reduces the dominance of frequent optimization signals in router training. Furthermore, Routing-Guided Semantic Alignment (RGSA) transfers the pattern-specific knowledge learned by the router to cross-modal alignment through mutual information maximization, preserving distinctive temporal information across different patterns. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of IMRouter, particularly in improving forecasting performance on less frequent temporal patterns.

</details>


### [622] [Strongly Adaptive Online Learning Achieves Uniform Discounted Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39292)
*Sifan Yang,Wenhao Yang,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明强自适应遗憾界可直接推出对凸、强凸与指数凹损失函数的统一折扣遗憾保证，核心是折扣遗憾可精确分解为区间遗憾的凸组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往工作借助专门元算法在连续折扣因子范围内获得统一折扣遗憾界，但结果仅适用于凸函数，无法覆盖强凸与指数凹情形，需更通用的推导途径。

Method: 关键观察：对固定比较器的折扣遗憾可精确分解为各区间遗憾的凸组合；据此将强自适应遗憾界直接转化为统一折扣遗憾界。

Result: 凸函数下对所有λ∈(0,1)得到O(√(log T/(1-λ)))界，在更广折扣范围内匹配已有速率；强凸与指数凹函数下得到O(log T(1+log(1/(1-λ))))界。

Conclusion: 强自适应遗憾是获得统一折扣遗憾保证的有效工具，可将结果从凸函数推广到强凸与指数凹函数。

Abstract: Discounted regret measures the performance of an online learner by assigning exponentially decaying weights to past losses, reflecting the greater importance of recent losses in non-stationary online learning. While previous work obtains uniform discounted regret bounds over a continuous range of discount factors using a specialized meta-algorithm, its results are limited to convex functions. In this paper, we demonstrate that strongly adaptive regret bounds can directly imply uniform discounted regret guarantees for convex, strongly convex, and exp-concave loss functions. Our key observation is that discounted regret against a fixed comparator admits an exact decomposition into a convex combination of interval regrets. For convex functions, this reduction yields an $O(\sqrt{\log T/(1-λ)})$ discounted regret bound for all discount factors $λ\in(0,1)$, matching the previous rate over a broader range of discount factors. For strongly convex and exp-concave functions, we provide regret bounds of $O\left(\log T\left(1+\log\frac{1}{1-λ}\right)\right)$.

</details>


### [623] [There Is No Free Lunch in RLVR: Every pass@1 Gain Has a pass@k Price](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39295)
*Yinuo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文证明RLVR中pass@1上升而pass@k被基座模型反超的现象是"精确可计算的价格"而非训练瞬态：在策略空间的指数倾斜模型下，任何提升pass@1的更新必然压低某些prompt的成功率（Stiemke对偶给出正价格条件），并给出交叉次数≤逐prompt成功偏移的正负号变化数（全正性界），据此提出可从任意评测日志读取的诊断工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR存在反直觉悖论：pass@1提升但大采样预算k下基座模型反超。现有文献未判定这是"RL未真正增强推理"还是"训练不足的瞬态"，缺乏理论刻画与可度量的界限。

Method: 将RLVR建模为基座策略在跨prompt共享策略上的指数倾斜（exponential tilt）；在"排他性专化"假设下用Stiemke对偶证明提升pass@1的更新必然存在对某些prompt的严格正价格；以逐prompt成功偏移的正负号变化（全正性/order-preserving）界定pass@k交叉次数上界；用约束更新刻画pass@1–pass@k前沿；同一倾斜恒等式推出熵坍缩与熵-性能幂律定律。

Result: 定理证明交叉是必然代价：正价格存在是充要条件，仅在某prompt上为最优策略不足以避免；交叉次数≤符号变化数，界紧且可退化为已知的单次交叉结论；去除交叉需付出全部pass@1收益；熵坍缩与可识别指数的熵-性能律被统一解释。

Conclusion: RLVR不能拓宽推理前沿，只能沿前沿移动并付出可测代价；不存在免费午餐，只有价格。论文提供由评测日志读取界、保序检验与价格的诊断方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes a language model solve more problems on the first try and fewer when given many tries: it raises pass@1 while the base model overtakes it at large sampling budget k. Is this a failure of RL to add reasoning, or a transient that more training removes? We settle the question with a theorem. The reversal is a price, and we compute its exact rate. Modeling RLVR as an exponential tilt of a base policy over strategies shared across prompts, we prove that under exclusive specialization every update that raises pass@1 strictly lowers the success of some prompt; a strictly positive price on prompts (Stiemke duality) is the exact condition, and being merely the best strategy on a prompt is provably not enough. When the loss reaches the hardest prompts, it forces a pass@k crossover, and the number of crossings is at most the sign variation of the shift in per-prompt success, a totally positive bound that is tight and that recovers the known single-crossover result as its order-preserving case. The crossover is not a bug to patch: a constrained update traces the exact pass@1 versus pass@k frontier, and removing the crossover entirely costs the entire pass@1 gain. The same tilt identity yields entropy collapse and the entropy-performance law with an identifiable exponent, unifying two literatures under one mechanism. Reinforcement cannot widen the reasoning frontier; it can only move along it, at a price we make measurable by a diagnostic that reads the bound, the order-preserving test, and the price from any evaluation log. There is no free lunch, only a price.

</details>


### [624] [Multi-Solution Inverse Design of Pixelated Patch Antennas Using an Autoregressive Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39300)
*Young-Mok Yun,Seung-Won Shin,Jaeyong Chung,Kyung-Sik Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自回归Transformer用于10×10像素化贴片天线的逆向设计，通过序列化离散生成实现多解合成，并以阶梯状目标响应微调实现双频设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有像素化贴片天线逆向设计方法存在局限：BPSO等元启发式方法对初始化与超参数敏感且耗时；串联逆网络难以刻画逆向设计的“一对多”特性；扩散模型对中等规模二值布局合成复杂度和数据需求过高。

Method: 采用自回归（AR）Transformer对10×10像素化贴片天线进行逆向设计，利用离散序列生成过程为给定目标响应合成多种可行结构；预训练模型进一步以具有尖锐频谱过渡的阶梯状目标响应微调，实现双频设计，无需手工构造详细S11曲线。

Result: 与BPSO相比，所提方法更高效地生成有效且多样的天线候选方案；加工与实测样件表明，不同像素化布局均可实现期望的天线响应。

Conclusion: 该框架验证了逆向设计的多解能力，为像素化贴片天线提供了一种高效、直观的合成途径。

Abstract: Deep-learning-based inverse design has emerged as a promising framework for pixelated patch antenna synthesis by enabling broader exploration of discrete geometry spaces and reducing design time compared with conventional template-based methods. Existing methods, including surrogate-assisted metaheuristic optimization, tandem inverse networks, and diffusion models, have advanced the field but still face practical limitations. Metaheuristic methods such as binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) are sensitive to initialization and search hyperparameters and are often time-consuming, tandem networks have difficulty capturing the one-to-many nature of inverse antenna design, and diffusion models may require excessive complexity and data for moderate-scale binary layout synthesis. In this paper, an autoregressive (AR) transformer is presented for the inverse design of 10 x 10 pixelated patch antennas. Its sequential discrete generation process enables the synthesis of multiple feasible structures for a given target response. The pretrained model is further fine-tuned for dual-band design using step-shaped target responses with sharp spectral transitions, allowing intuitive band specification without manually constructing detailed S11 curves. Compared with BPSO, our proposed method generates valid and diverse antenna candidates more efficiently. Fabricated and measured examples confirm that distinct pixelated layouts can realize the desired antenna responses, thereby demonstrating the multi-solution capability of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [625] [Learning to Bound: Monotonic, Calibrated Neural Upper Bounds for MPE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39305)
*Akshay Vyas,Hailiang Dong,Shivvrat Arya,Brij Malhotra,Tahrima Rahman,Vibhav Gogate,Nicholas Ruozzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Learning to Bound (L2B)，用神经网络学习并摊销 PGM 中最可能解释（MPE）搜索所需的上界计算：通过统计校准保证可采纳性（admissibility），通过结构约束保证界随证据累积单调收紧；在多个 PGM 家族上以低数个量级的代价得到更紧、单调的界，并在高树宽实例上提升分支定界（B&B）效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPE 在大规模、稠密结构概率图模型中计算不可行；分支定界等 anytime 系统搜索的效率依赖紧的可采纳上界，而 Mini-Bucket Elimination（MBE）等经典方法计算这些界代价高昂，形成“界质量 vs 计算成本”的瓶颈。论文希望把界的计算成本通过数据驱动方式摊销。

Method: 提出 L2B 框架，训练神经预测器直接预测搜索所需上界。两点关键设计：(1) 可采纳性——采用统计校准技术使预测界以概率意义下不低估真实最优值；(2) 渐进收紧——通过结构性架构约束在设计上保证界随证据累积单调不增（monotonicity by construction）。

Result: 在多个困难基准与所有 PGM 家族上，L2B 在计算代价低数个量级的情况下给出更紧且单调的界；将其嵌入分支定界后，在高树宽实例上取得可测量的性能提升。

Conclusion: 用学习式预测器摊销上界计算是可行的：可采纳性与单调性可由校准与架构约束显式保证，从而在保持搜索正确性前提下显著降低界计算成本并改善 MPE 求解效率；表明学习方法可作为传统界计算（如 MBE）的高效替代组件嵌入精确推理搜索。

Abstract: Probabilistic graphical models (PGMs) compactly encode structured joint distributions, but Most Probable Explanation (MPE), which finds the highest-probability assignment to unobserved variables, remains computationally intractable in large, densely structured models. Anytime systematic search, such as branch-and-bound (B&B), is a popular approach, but its efficiency depends on tight admissible upper bounds that are often prohibitively expensive to compute using classical methods like Mini-Bucket Elimination (MBE). We introduce Learning to Bound (L2B), a data-driven framework that amortizes bound computation cost by training a neural predictor. L2B targets two key properties required for effective search bounds: admissibility, which is achieved via statistical calibration techniques, and progressive tightening as evidence accumulates, which is enforced through structural architectural constraints that ensure monotonicity by construction. Across challenging benchmarks, L2B delivers tighter, monotonic bounds at orders-of-magnitude lower cost on every PGM family, and yields measurable improvements when integrated with branch-and-bound on high-treewidth instances.

</details>


### [626] [TaxoMFM: A Taxonomy-Aware Foundation Model for the Human Gut Microbiome](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39316)
*Haochen Xue,Anastasia Godneva,Yulong Li,Qi Cao,Zhaodong Wu,Kaiyu Liang,Jionglong Su,Eran Segal,Imran Razzak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TaxoMFM 是一个将分类学层级结构融入自监督学习的肠道微生物组基础模型，通过分类学感知编码与层级组成重建联合学习各分类层级丰度模式及组内相对比例，并在自建大规模基准 TaxoGut-HPP 上取得有竞争力的性能与稳健的跨队列零样本迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有肠道微生物组基础模型多采用扁平的分类单元（taxon）表示，无法利用已知的分类学层级信息，限制了模型对微生物群落结构的刻画能力。

Method: 提出 TaxoMFM：引入分类学感知编码（taxonomy-aware encoding）与层级组成重建（hierarchical compositional reconstruction）自监督目标，同时学习跨分类层级的丰度模式与组内相对比例；并构建 TaxoGut-HPP 数据集，含 231 个来源队列、100,806 份肠道微生物组样本，覆盖 40 项分类任务与 8 项回归任务。

Result: 在疾病、肠道健康、宿主性状与肝脏超声表型预测上表现有竞争力；在目标队列被排除于预训练与下游适配之外的跨队列零样本迁移中，结直肠癌、2 型糖尿病与炎症性肠病的 AUROC 分别为 0.838、0.736、0.722；分析表明模型可在多个分类尺度上还原群落变化，保留群落信息，并在数据库更新与物种词表偏移下产生一致表示。

Conclusion: 将分类学层级结构纳入自监督预训练可有效提升微生物组基础模型的表示质量、下游预测性能与跨队列泛化稳健性，为微生物组基础模型提供了结构先验驱动的建模范式与大规模评测基准。

Abstract: Existing gut microbiome foundation models typically use flat taxon representations, limiting their ability to exploit known taxonomic hierarchies. We introduce TaxoMFM, a microbiome foundation model that integrates taxonomic structure into self-supervised learning. TaxoMFM jointly learns abundance patterns across taxonomic ranks and relative proportions within groups through taxonomy-aware encoding and hierarchical compositional reconstruction. We further construct TaxoGut-HPP, comprising 100,806 gut microbiome profiles from 231 source cohorts and covering 40 classification and 8 regression tasks. TaxoMFM achieves competitive performance across disease, gut health, host trait, and liver ultrasound phenotype prediction. In cross-cohort zero-shot transfer, where target cohorts are excluded from both pretraining and downstream adaptation, TaxoMFM achieves AUROCs of 0.838, 0.736, and 0.722 for colorectal cancer, type 2 diabetes, and inflammatory bowel disease, respectively. Further analyses show that TaxoMFM recovers community changes across taxonomic scales, while preserving community information and producing consistent representations under database updates and species-vocabulary shifts. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TaxoMFM-F16D/.

</details>


### [627] [Class-aware Latent Attention Replay (CLAR): Class Incremental Hazard Diagnosis for Resilient AI in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39323)
*Avranshu Mahanty,Ran Jin,Yingyan Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CLAR结合双缓冲（少量原始样本+紧凑潜表示）、注意力杠杆分数ALS与EMA教师，解决MII隐患诊断中少数样本新类、多标签共现与内存受限下的类增量学习问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 制造工业互联网（MII）中AI系统的韧性依赖对数据层、AI流水线与信息物理层隐患的及时诊断；运行中新隐患类型不断涌现且每类样本极少、隐患共现，模型需部署在内存受限节点上。现有基于回放的类增量学习方法假设单标签、均衡数据流，存储高维原始样本且样本选择与分类器解耦，难以适用。

Method: 提出Class-aware Latent Attention Replay（CLAR）：(1) 双缓冲，主要存储紧凑潜表示并辅以少量原始样本；(2) 注意力杠杆分数（ALS），上界分类器logit并引导类均衡的蓄水池采样；(3) 指数滑动平均教师，减缓潜空间漂移。

Result: 在理想化缓冲模型下证明：缓冲具备类均衡性并服从ALS加权的类分布；当每类容量低于临界值时，ALS引导回放的梯度误差小于类均衡均匀回放。在MII测试台隐患诊断数据的案例研究中，相同缓冲规模下CLAR取得评估回放方法中最高的mean average weighted F1。

Conclusion: CLAR通过潜空间紧凑回放与分类器感知的采样策略，在内存受限、样本稀缺且多标签共现的增量隐患诊断场景中优于现有回放式CIL方法，并具理论保证。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems provide critical computation services in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet (MII), and their resilience depends on timely diagnosis of hazards across the data, AI pipeline, and cyber-physical layers. During operation, new hazard types keep emerging with only a few samples each, hazards co-occur, and the diagnosis model runs on memory-constrained computation nodes. Replay-based class-incremental learning (CIL) can learn new hazard classes while revisiting a small memory of past samples, but existing methods assume single-label, balanced streams, store high-dimensional raw samples, and select them independently of the classifier. We propose Class-aware Latent Attention Replay (CLAR), which combines a dual buffer that stores mostly compact latent representations with a few raw samples, an Attention Leverage Score (ALS) that upper-bounds the classifier logit and guides class-balanced reservoir sampling, and an exponential-moving-average teacher that slows latent-space drift. For an idealized buffer model, we prove that the buffer is class-balanced and follows an ALS-weighted class distribution, and that below a critical per-class capacity, ALS-guided replay has a lower replay-gradient error than class-balanced uniform replay. In the case study, On hazard diagnosis data from an MII testbed, CLAR achieves the highest mean average weighted F1 score among the evaluated replay methods with the same buffer size

</details>


### [628] [RetroChessBench: A Benchmark for Reconstructing and Proving Chess Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39341)
*Tidor-Vlad Pricope*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 RetroChessBench（12项逆向国际象棋任务基准），发现前沿模型 GPT 6 Astra 在无工具与有代码执行条件下均高频失败（22/24、18/24 未给出要求的最终答案），并归因于网络训练数据中缺乏详细推导过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿语言模型已能参与数学研究，但在规则明确的纯推理任务中仍会出现严重推理失败；作者希望用一个规则封闭、可自动判定的"纯推理试验场"来检验推理能力的真实泛化程度，并质疑其是否只是在复现熟悉的解题模式。

Method: 构建逆向国际象棋基准 RetroChessBench：12 项任务，涵盖精确步数构造、唯一终局、穷举答案集三类题型；每题配备参考答案、评分细则（rubrics）与终端奖励（terminal-reward）环境。在两个试验×两种条件（无工具 / 有代码执行）下评测 GPT 6 Astra High，并分析错误响应的推理缺陷类型。

Result: 无工具时 22/24 次试验未产出要求的最终答案，有代码执行时 18/24 次失败；平均终端强化学习奖励分别为 14.75% 与 27.19%。错误案例表现为：错误地否定合法历史、将暂时性阻塞误判为永久性阻塞等演绎失误。网络上的逆向对局档案通常只给题目与最终着法序列，缺少详细推导。

Conclusion: 作者假设训练数据中缺少这类详细推导解释是失败的重要成因；结论指出前沿数学推理的可泛化性存疑——宣称通用智能需要证据表明模型能把学到的原理迁移到缺乏范例的领域。

Abstract: Frontier language models such as GPT 6 Astra have contributed to research mathematics, demonstrating substantial reasoning capabilities. Yet serious reasoning failures persist even in tasks governed by explicit rules. We demonstrate this in retrograde chess which is a playground for pure reasoning, where solvers reconstruct legal histories and distinguish possible events from forced ones. We introduce RetroChessBench, a 12-task benchmark covering exact-length constructions, unique endings, and exhaustive answer sets, with references, rubrics, and a terminal-reward environment. In two trials per task and condition, GPT 6 Astra High fails to produce the required final answer in 22/24 attempts without tools and 18/24 with code execution; mean terminal RL rewards are 14.75% and 27.19%, respectively. The examples identify faulty deductions: failed responses reject legal histories and treat temporary obstructions as permanent. Online retrograde archives often provide puzzles and final move sequences without detailed derivations. We hypothesize that limited exposure to these missing explanations in web-derived training data contributes to the observed reasoning failures. This questions how far frontier mathematical reasoning really generalizes beyond familiar solution patterns. Claims of general intelligence require evidence that models can transfer learnt principles to areas with few worked examples.

</details>


### [629] [MulClip: A table-free activation function with monotonic and folding regimes for reservoir computing on microcontrollers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39343)
*Guren Matsumura,Masato Takemoto,Shinzo Koyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轻量激活函数MulClip，仅用比较、取绝对值、乘法和减法构造弯曲响应，将阈值设在极值后回零处，使单函数兼具单调与非单调折叠两种工作区，在MCU水库计算中状态更新耗时仅为tanh的0.34倍且精度更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在环形水库（代表性稀疏RC拓扑）中乘加运算很少，而在Cortex-M4上评估tanh占状态更新时间的75%，因此激活函数成为MCU上RC的主要瓶颈，需要极轻量的替代方案。

Method: MulClip仅使用比较、绝对值、乘法与减法引入曲率；其裁剪阈值不设在极值处而设在响应越过极值后回零的位置，从而单一函数同时具备单调区与非单调折叠区，提升单单元的表示能力。使用哪一区间由常规超参数搜索（如输入尺度）决定，无需按任务调阈值。

Result: 硬件实测状态更新时间为tanh的0.34倍，且短于所评估的11种tanh近似。PC端评估：三阶MulClip在NARMA-20上NMSE比tanh低22%（此时预激活处于单调区）；8位奇偶校验任务上，不含折叠的单调裁剪变体准确率为0.76–0.78，而完整MulClip提升至0.97–0.98。两个任务上端侧推理结果与PC端几乎一致。

Conclusion: MulClip以极低计算成本同时实现高效与高表达力，适合MCU上的水库计算部署，且精度在硬件与PC端保持一致。

Abstract: This letter proposes MulClip, a lightweight activation function for reservoir computing (RC) on microcontrollers (MCUs). In a ring reservoir, a representative sparse RC topology, multiply-accumulate operations are few, and evaluating tanh accounted for 75% of the state-update time on a Cortex-M4. MulClip introduces curvature into the response using only comparison, absolute value, multiplication, and subtraction, and places its clipping threshold not at the extremum but at the point where the response returns to zero after passing the extremum. As a result, a single function has both a monotonic regime and a nonmonotonic folding regime that increases the expressiveness of a single unit. Which regime is used is determined by the usual hyperparameter search, e.g., over the input scale, so no task-specific threshold tuning is required. The state-update time measured on hardware was 0.34 times that of tanh and shorter than that of any of the 11 evaluated tanh approximations. In PC-based evaluation, third-order MulClip achieved a 22% lower NMSE than tanh on NARMA-20, where the pre-activations remained in the monotonic regime, and on 8-bit parity it raised the accuracy from 0.76-0.78 for the monotonic-clip variant without folding to 0.97-0.98. For these two tasks, on-device inference yielded nearly the same values as on the PC.

</details>


### [630] [More Is Better? Exploring Latent Correspondence in Federated Hypergraph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39362)
*Bo Yan,Siming Zhang,Siqi Li,Hang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对联邦超图学习中潜在跨客户端超边对应关系导致的可识别性与计算难题，论文刻画了恢复该潜在对应关系的可处理性（成对指派可处理，多客户端超边匹配一般不可处理），提出交叉熵分解揭示局部预测何时优于引入额外跨客户端信息的预测器，并据此设计仅通信模型参数、学习对应不变扩散表示的FedASTRA，证明其渐近最优性与全局总体风险收敛，在八个数据集上取得优于无标识符联邦图/超图方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦场景下每个客户端的局部超图发布可能对应多种全局超图结构，潜在跨客户端超边对应关系带来根本性的可识别性与计算挑战；同时需要厘清在何种条件下引入跨客户端信息才真正有益，从而为设计既保护隐私（仅传参数）又有效的联邦超图学习方法提供理论依据。

Method: 首先对潜在对应关系恢复的可处理性进行理论刻画；基于该刻画推导交叉熵分解，界定局部预测优于使用额外跨客户端信息预测器的条件；进而提出FedASTRA，通过自适应热扩散与掩码潜在预测学习对应不变的扩散表示，客户端仅通信模型参数。

Result: 建立FedASTRA相对许可局部信息的渐近最优性，并在恢复、表示与更新对齐的显式条件下证明全局总体风险收敛；在八个真实数据集上相较无标识符联邦图与超图方法取得更优效果，于ogbn-papers100M上达到性能—通信Pareto前沿，每轮仅通信59.60 MiB即取得50.07 Accuracy与29.73 Macro-F1。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，多客户端超边匹配一般不可处理、而成对指派可处理，对应关系不变表示加参数级通信是联邦超图学习的可行路径，FedASTRA兼具理论保证与低通信开销的实证优势。

Abstract: Federated hypergraph learning with latent cross-client hyperedge correspondence poses fundamental identifiability and computational challenges, as the same local release can correspond to multiple global hypergraph structures. We characterize the tractability of recovering these latent correspondences, showing tractable pairwise assignment but generally intractable multi-client hyperedge matching. Building on this characterization, we derive a cross-entropy decomposition that reveals when local prediction can outperform predictors fitted with additional cross-client information. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Federated Adaptive Spectral Training with Representation Alignment (FedASTRA), which learns correspondence-invariant diffusion representations through adaptive heat diffusion and masked latent prediction while communicating model parameters only. We establish its asymptotic optimality with respect to the permitted local information and prove global population-risk convergence under explicit conditions on recovery, representation, and update alignment. Experiments on eight real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedASTRA against identifier-free federated graph and hypergraph methods. On ogbn-papers100M, FedASTRA reaches the performance-communication Pareto frontier, achieving 50.07 Accuracy and 29.73 Macro-F1 while communicating only 59.60 MiB per round.

</details>


### [631] [Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39409)
*Chenxi Li,Yao Shu,Siyang Gao,Shuang Qiu,Guangxin Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带安全约束的多目标强化学习（Safe MORL），提出在学习全程（第0约束违反）下学习安全帕累托最优策略的算法，涵盖累积约束与逐步约束，并给出偏好相关与偏好无关两种算法及其样本复杂度保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MORL 应用需要在满足安全约束的同时平衡多个冲突目标，而现有方法难以在未知动力学与未知约束代价下既充分探索又保证安全（尤其每一条执行策略都不违反约束）。核心难点在于：探索充分性与零违反约束之间的张力。

Method: 1）针对给定偏好，结合乐观奖励估计与悲观代价界（optimistic reward + pessimistic cost），构造安全探索算法；2）采用平滑 Tchebycheff 标量化，并将由平均占据测度诱导的确定性马尔可夫策略作为输出以保证安全性；3）进一步提出偏好无关算法：先无偏好安全探索，再离线规划，对任意偏好直接输出安全策略而无需额外交互；4）随后放松对"已知严格可行策略及其代价"的假设，允许常数级累积违反。

Result: 偏好相关算法以高概率保证 T 个回合内每条执行策略零约束违反，次优间隙为 Õ(1/√T)；偏好无关算法在 T 回合探索与 K 次规划迭代下保持相同安全性，间隙为 Õ(1/√T + 1/√K)。放松可行性假设后，累积违反至多为常数。

Conclusion: 本文给出了首批在每一步执行策略上都保证安全的样本高效 MORL 算法，统一处理累积与逐步约束，并实现零违反（或常数级违反）的安全学习与 Õ(1/√T) 级收敛速率，为 Safe MORL 提供了理论可行的范式。

Abstract: Many applications of multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) require policies that balance conflicting objectives while satisfying safety constraints. We study safe MORL with zero constraint violation throughout learning, covering both cumulative and stepwise constraints. A key challenge is to explore sufficiently under unknown dynamics and constraint costs without violating the constraints. For a given preference over objectives, we develop an algorithm to learn a safe Pareto optimal policy by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds. With high probability, every policy executed over $T$ episodes incurs zero constraint violation. The algorithm returns a safe Markov policy induced by the averaged occupancy measure and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ suboptimality gap under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization. We further develop a preference-free algorithm that first explores safely without a prespecified preference and then computes a safe policy for any given preference without further interaction. Over $T$ exploration episodes and $K$ planning iterations, it retains the same safety guarantee and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T}+1/\sqrt{K})$ suboptimality gap. Both algorithms require knowledge of a policy that strictly satisfies the constraints and its costs. We then relax these requirements, incurring at most constant cumulative violation. To our knowledge, we provide the first sample-efficient MORL algorithms that guarantee safety for every executed policy.

</details>


### [632] [Dobb: Shard-Local Preconditioning in Block-Diagonal Eigenbases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39412)
*Shi-Yuk Fong,Shuhua Yu,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出分块对角特征基矩阵感知优化器 Dobb，在参数分片内本地完成矩阵更新，无需跨卡通信即可获得优于 Dion 的收敛效果与显著更低的优化器调用开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在TP/FSDP下参数与优化器状态需跨设备切分，Muon类矩阵感知优化器的全局矩阵运算（如正交化）会引入额外通信开销，Dion虽已降低通信但仍存在成本。

Method: 用对角块近似输入激活二阶矩，在每个块内维护完整特征基；将动量投影到该基上，对系数做符号归一化，再重构更新。当每个块落在单一分片内时，矩阵更新完全在各分片本地执行，仅需对激活二阶矩做数据并行同步。

Result: GPT-2 XL（1.56B）上，Dobb（16块）验证损失2.476，优于Dion在秩比例1/16时的2.511；32张H100、FSDP下，摊销优化器调用时间由Dion的124.1 ms降至9.2 ms。

Conclusion: 通过块对角特征基的局部化设计，Dobb在保持（近似）正交化更新收益的同时消除跨分片矩阵通信，实现了通信效率与收敛质量的双重改进。

Abstract: Training language models whose parameters and optimizer state exceed a single node's memory requires sharding these tensors across devices. Under tensor parallelism (TP) or fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP), matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon introduce communication to perform global matrix operations across shards. We propose Dobb (Distributed Optimizer with Block-diagonal Eigenbases), a matrix-aware optimizer designed to compute updates locally within parameter shards. Dobb approximates the input-activation second moment with diagonal blocks and tracks a complete basis within each block. It projects momentum into these bases, applies sign normalization to the coefficients, and reconstructs the update. When each block lies within one shard under TP or FSDP, Dobb applies its matrix update locally, requiring no communication beyond data-parallel synchronization of the activation second moments. We benchmark Dobb against Dion, a distributed matrix-aware optimizer designed to retain the benefits of orthonormalized updates while reducing communication. On GPT-2 XL (1.56B parameters), Dobb with 16 blocks reaches a validation loss of 2.476, compared with 2.511 for Dion at rank fraction 1/16. Under FSDP on 32 H100 GPUs, Dobb reduces the amortized optimizer-call time from 124.1 ms for Dion to 9.2 ms.

</details>


### [633] [Accuracy is not compatibility: two Evo 2 checkpoints hinge on one FP8 matrix multiplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39415)
*Xun Ding,Ziyuan Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FP8格式只规定数值存储方式而不规定乘积求和方式，这一缺口会导致检查点跨硬件失效。Evo 2（DNA语言模型）的1B/40B检查点依赖Hopper FP8，在Blackwell上前向测试失败、40B在RTX 5070 Ti上next-base准确率仅25.7%。作者用位精确的H100 FP8 GEMM模拟器mmaemu定位问题到1B首个投影（共21个）；仅模拟该投影即可使40B BRCA1变异分类AUROC从0.434升至0.869（H100为0.868）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FP8标准仅规定数值存储格式，未规定累加/求和的具体算术实现，导致同一权重在不同GPU上数值行为不一致，已发布的检查点出现跨代（Hopper→Blackwell）不可复现问题。论文希望通过精确定位依赖点，说明发布方应指定参考算术。

Method: 在两张Blackwell（sm_120）GPU与RTX 5070 Ti上复现Evo 2 1B/40B/7B检查点；开发H100 FP8 GEMM位精确模拟器mmaemu（在捕获的1B投影上验证bit-exact），逐层定位对Hopper算术敏感的投影；对比精确求和与按H100实测1.4%缩放后的结果；并只对首个投影做原生/模拟替换，测量下游BRCA1变异分类AUROC。

Result: 1B与40B在两张Blackwell上均未通过开发者前向测试（7B通过）；RTX 5070 Ti上40B的next-base准确率25.7%（接近随机猜测）。Hopper上原生运行时有99.996%的单一投影输出正确舍入（H100约30%），而同一操作数的fp32累加反而失败。mmaemu将依赖定位到1B的第1个投影（共21个），其中精确求和失败，但按H100实测1.4%（而非2.1%）缩放后通过；40B仅需首个投影保持原生。仅模拟该投影、权重不变，RTX 5070 Ti上40B BRCA1 AUROC由0.434升至0.869（H100：0.868），RTX PRO 6000上由0.481升至0.867，尽管仍存在轻微前向测试未通过。

Conclusion: FP8检查点的可复现性取决于求和算术而非存储格式，少数投影对累加实现高度敏感并主导下游性能。仅校正单个投影即可恢复接近Hopper水平的AUROC。作者仅测试了一个模型家族、未覆盖训练来源差异，呼吁模型发布应明确指定参考算术。

Abstract: FP8 formats specify how values are stored, not how products are summed; this gap can break checkpoints. Evo 2, a DNA language model, documents a Hopper FP8 requirement for its 1B and 40B checkpoints. On two Blackwell (sm_120) GPUs both fail the developers' forward test (the 7B passes); on an RTX 5070 Ti the 40B's next-base accuracy is 25.7%, near guessing. Greater accuracy breaks them, as BioNeMo saw for the 40B on Hopper: natively, 99.996% of one projection's outputs are correctly rounded (H100: about 30%), and fp32 accumulation of the same operands fails. Our H100 FP8 GEMM emulator, mmaemu (bit-exact on captured 1B projections), localises the dependence to the 1B's first projection (of 21), where exact sums fail but pass when shrunk by the H100's 1.4% (measured in-sample), not 2.1%. The 40B fails with only its first projection native. Emulating only that projection, weights unchanged, raises 40B BRCA1 variant-classification AUROC from 0.434 to 0.869 (H100: 0.868) on the RTX 5070 Ti, despite a narrow forward-test miss, and 0.481 to 0.867 on an RTX PRO 6000. We tested one model family but not training origin; releases should specify reference arithmetic.

</details>


### [634] [LinQuant: Functional Invariances for Low-Precision Linear Recurrences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39418)
*Neehal Tumma,Philipp Nazari,Rohan Cherukuri,Daniela Rus,T. Konstantin Rusch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LinQuant 提出利用七种保持全精度计算结果的"函数不变性"（旋转、对角缩放、循环衰减/写入因子的重排等），使线性循环模型的分块并行 prefill 在低精度下更易量化，并集成到 SSDi8 管线中提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性循环（linear recurrence）正成为 softmax 注意力在 LLM 中的实用替代方案（单用或混合架构），但其低精度推理研究远落后于 softmax 注意力。prefill 阶段的分块并行算法大量以稠密矩阵乘法实现，本适合低精度执行，然而直接对原生形式量化较为脆弱。

Method: 识别在保持全精度计算结果不变的前提下、使操作数更利于量化的函数不变性，共七种：旋转、对角重缩放、循环衰减与写入因子的替代位置等；推导这些变换在线性、门控（gated）与 delta-rule 更新等常见循环族中保持有效的条件；说明它们为提升低精度精度提供互补自由度；并将框架落地，把适用不变性加入 Mamba-2 现有低精度 prefill 管线 SSDi8。

Result: 在等延迟条件下，LinQuant 在 Mamba-2 1.3B、2.7B、8B 与 Nemotron-H 8B 上均改善了困惑度（perplexity）。

Conclusion: 基于不变性的量化对循环模型具有实际价值，可在不增加延迟的情况下提升低精度 prefill 精度，为循环架构的低精度推理提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Linear recurrences are emerging as practical alternatives to softmax attention in large language models, appearing in both standalone and hybrid architectures. However, despite their rapid emergence, low-precision inference remains much less developed for these models than for softmax attention. During prefill, chunkwise-parallel algorithms cast much of the recurrence as dense matrix multiplications, suggesting a natural path to low-precision execution. Simply quantizing these operations in their native form, however, can be fragile. In this work, we identify functional invariances that preserve the full-precision computation while making the operands more amenable to quantization. Building on this observation, we introduce LinQuant, a framework for low-precision recurrent prefill based on seven such invariances, including rotations, diagonal rescalings, and alternative placements of recurrent decay and write factors. We derive when these transformations remain valid across common recurrence families spanning linear, gated, and delta-rule updates, and show that they provide complementary degrees of freedom for improving low-precision accuracy. Finally, we translate this framework to production by augmenting SSDi8, an existing low-precision prefill pipeline for Mamba-2, with the applicable invariances. LinQuant improves perplexity at matched latency on Mamba-2 1.3B, 2.7B, and 8B and Nemotron-H 8B, demonstrating the practical utility of invariance-based quantization for recurrent models.

</details>


### [635] [Softmax Routing Dynamics in Mixture-of-Experts Models: Collapse and Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39442)
*Shengze Xu,Maolin Deng,Tieyong Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究MoE中softmax路由概率集中（专家抑制）的形成、持续与恢复机制：固定专家时由平稳损失障碍刻画支撑最优路由输出的面；可训练输出时慢适应在有限时域跟随固定专家动力学，任意正适应率给出内部路由极限；法向速度分解分离互补专家协方差与相对梯度优势，并给出对数或幂律恢复时间；Transformer-MoE配对训练中去掉类条件路由梯度对比会延迟恢复并降低固定token上的累积对数几率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Softmax路由易将概率集中于少数专家，压制其余专家，导致专家利用率低、能力浪费；现有工作缺乏对集中如何形成、为何持续、被压制概率如何恢复的机理刻画。

Method: 1) 固定专家：用平稳损失障碍识别支撑最优路由输出的面；2) 共同目标平方损失、专家输出可训练模型：分析慢适应在有限时域上对固定专家动力学的追踪，证明任意固定正适应率产生内部路由极限；3) 提出精确法向速度分解，将互补专家协方差与相对梯度优势分离；4) 在恢复路径上给定双侧正幂界、对初始质量取一致界，由系数消失阶导出对数或幂律恢复时间；5) 构造场积分验证阶的关系；6) 给出精确离散对数几率恒等式，联系神经更新与阈值穿越；7) 在配对Transformer-MoE训练中做路由梯度对比消融实验。

Result: 理论上得到：恢复时间的对数/幂律阶由法向速度系数消失阶决定，且构造场的积分再现该阶；离散对数几率恒等式将更新与阈值穿越精确对应。实验中，移除类条件路由梯度对比会延迟确认恢复，并降低固定token上的累积对数几率，且在有无容量约束下均成立。

Conclusion: Softmax路由的专家抑制可由损失几何（平稳障碍）、适应率与梯度对比共同解释；恢复速度受法向速度系数阶控制，路由梯度对比是加速恢复的关键因素，为缓解专家塌缩提供理论与实证依据。

Abstract: Softmax routing in mixture-of-experts models can concentrate probability on a subset of experts, suppressing access to the others. We study how this concentration forms, why it persists, and how suppressed probabilities recover. For fixed experts, a stationary-loss barrier identifies the face supporting the optimal routed output. In a common-target square-loss model with freely trainable expert outputs, slow adaptation tracks fixed-expert dynamics on finite horizons, while every fixed positive adaptation rate yields an interior routing limit. An exact normal-velocity decomposition separates complementary-expert covariance from relative gradient advantage. Under positive two-sided power bounds along recovery paths, uniform over initial masses, the resulting coefficient's order of vanishing gives logarithmic or power-law recovery times. Integrations of constructed fields reproduce these orders. An exact discrete log-odds identity relates neural updates to threshold crossing. In paired Transformer-MoE training, removing a class-conditional router-gradient contrast delays confirmed recovery and reduces accumulated log-odds on fixed tokens, both with and without capacity constraints.

</details>


### [636] [End-to-End Guarantees for Masked Diffusion Models under Conditional Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39444)
*Fareed Sheriff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为掩码扩散模型（MDM）在学习型去噪器下给出端到端采样保证：在条件混合（CM）源上，证明任意掩码分布训练的经验风险最小化器具有与序列长度无关的样本复杂度，并据此把端到端KL误差界定为 ε+Nε'，且该指数率在常数意义下极小极大最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MDM采样界假设去噪器精确或未控制其误差，而训练界只覆盖训练时所用的掩码分布，缺乏"学习型去噪器—任意解码调度"的端到端保证。

Method: 提出条件混合（CM）源类（如带底序r马尔可夫源、双侧Doeblin隐马尔可夫源），其掩码令牌后验随可见令牌距离平均以相关长度 τ_c 指数衰减；分析任意掩码分布下经验风险最小化器的逐令牌超额风险与样本量关系，并证明指数阶 Θ(τ_c log|V|) 的极小极大最优性；结合膨胀（dilated）去噪调度推导端到端KL界，并考察块自回归采样与 Λ 循环消息传递类的表现。

Result: 逐令牌超额 ε' 需 ε'^{−O(τ_c log|V|)} 条训练序列（与 N 无关，一份样本预算可服务各调度）；端到端 KL ≤ ε+Nε'，膨胀调度仅需 T=O(τ_c log(N|V|/ε)) 步，而显式CM源上固定随机序需 Ω(N) 步；块自回归采样跨块无额外误差；Λ 循环序r消息传递类在序r源上具多项式样本复杂度，近似误差随循环改善并在 Λr≈τ_c log(1/ε') 处饱和。实验（已发布与重训模型）支持定性预测。

Conclusion: 在条件混合源下，MDM可用与序列长度无关的样本量训练去噪器，并以对数级去噪步数实现可控端到端KL误差，同时该样本率在常数意义下最优；块自回归与循环消息传递结构可进一步提升效率。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models train a denoiser on masked cross-entropy and generate by unmasking many positions in parallel. Existing MDM sampling bounds assume an exact denoiser or leave its error uncontrolled while training bounds cover only the masking distribution on which the model was trained. We present an end-to-end guarantee for a learned denoiser under conditional mixing (CM): stationary sources (e.g. floored order-$r$ Markov and two-sided-Doeblin hidden-Markov sources) for which revealing distant visible tokens moves a masked token's posterior on average exponentially little in the distance with correlation length $τ_c$. We show the empirical risk minimizer trained under any masking distribution attains per-token excess $\varepsilon'$ on that distribution from $\varepsilon'^{-\mathcal{O}(τ_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)}$ training sequences, independent of sequence length $N$ -- one sample budget serves every decoding schedule when each schedule's denoiser is trained under its own weighting. We further show that the exponent's order $Θ(τ_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)$ is minimax-optimal up to constants; more efficient rates require added structure. With this, we bound the end-to-end KL as $\mathrm{KL}(π\Vert p_{\mathrm{alg}})\leq \varepsilon+N\varepsilon'$ under a dilated schedule of $T=\mathcal{O}(τ_c\log(N|\mathcal{V}|/\varepsilon))$ denoising steps versus $Ω(N)$ steps for a fixed random order on an explicit CM source. Finally, we show that block-autoregressive samplers chain across blocks with no added error and that a $Λ$-looped order-$r$ message-passing class on order-$r$ sources achieves polynomial sample complexity, with approximation error improving per loop until saturation at $Λr\approx τ_c\log(1/\varepsilon')$. Experiments on released and retrained models support our results' qualitative predictions.

</details>


### [637] [Smooth Action Chunking Via Movement-Primitive Representations for Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39451)
*Shota Nomura,Takayuki Osa,Yasuhiro Kato,Kazuki Ota,Naoki Shitanda,Tatsuya Harada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将基于运动基元的轨迹表示引入动作分块，使轨迹按构造平滑，并用闭式条件化修正块间不连续，在ACT与DiT骨干及真实双臂ALOHA平台上大幅降低抖动且任务成功率不劣化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作分块已成为扩散策略到大规模VLA模型的通用接口，但块内与块间的时间结构仅为隐式学习，导致指令轨迹抖动：真实硬件上表现为可见振动与从动端速度限幅反复饱和。

Method: 用平滑基函数的线性组合表示轨迹段（运动基元），按构造得到平滑轨迹，且不改变策略架构、训练目标与推理流程；同时对预测系数做条件化，使新块经过上一块最后一条指令动作处的via-point，得到闭式、推理时的块间不连续修正，无需重训，且适用于一次性（one-shot）查询策略。

Result: 在一次性骨干ACT与迭代骨干DiT上实例化，并在仿真和真实双臂ALOHA平台评估：块内抖动在ACT上降低一个数量级、在DiT上降低2.4倍，任务成功率统计上非劣；条件化消除73–84%的边界不连续，每步开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 运动基元轨迹表示与闭式via-point条件化可即插即用地解决动作分块的块内与块间抖动，兼容一次性与迭代式策略，代价极低且不影响任务性能。

Abstract: Imitation learning has become a widely adopted approach for vision-based robot policies, owing to its conceptual simplicity, scalability, and ability to leverage large-scale datasets. As these policies have grown more capable, action chunking has become their standard interface. At each decision step the policy outputs several future actions at once. Backbones from diffusion policies to large vision-language-action models all share it. Whatever backbone produces the chunk, its temporal structure is learned only implicitly. The commanded trajectory is therefore jerky both within a chunk and between successive chunks. On real hardware this appears as visible vibration and as repeated saturation of the follower's velocity limit. We address this issue by incorporating a movement-primitive-based trajectory representation into action chunking. Specifically, a trajectory segment is represented as a linear combination of smooth basis functions, yielding smooth trajectories by construction while leaving the policy architecture, training objective, and inference procedure unchanged. The same representation also yields a closed-form, inference-time correction for the second source of jerk. We condition the predicted coefficients so that the new chunk passes through a via-point at the previous chunk's last commanded action. This correction needs no retraining and, unlike asynchronous Real-Time Chunking, applies to policies queried in one shot. We instantiate it on a one-shot (ACT) and an iterative (DiT) backbone and evaluate in simulation and on a real bimanual ALOHA platform. The representation lowers within-chunk jerk by an order of magnitude on the one-shot backbone and by 2.4 times on the iterative one, with task success statistically non-inferior.
