The conditioning then removes 73-84% of the boundary discontinuity, at negligible per-step cost.

</details>


### [638] [Event-SAMA: Language-Grounded Video Object Segmentation on Neuromorphic Event Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39676)
*Sergei Fedorchenko,Max Zehnder,Nikola Zubić,Rong Zou,Davide Scaramuzza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将SAMA-239K视频对话语料及全部SAMA训练数据通过光流/FILM/扫视上采样加线性事件生成器转换为合成事件流数据集Event-SAMA-239K（30,650视频片段、392,162图像，保留掩码、指代表达与对话标注），并提出Event-SAMA——在SAMA-4B基础上引入双通道极性patch嵌入（RGB预训练权重初始化）与零初始化事件适配器，首次建立事件原生RVOS基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围和无运动模糊的优势，但指代视频目标分割（RVOS）领域长期缺乏事件流数据集与模型，事件模态在该任务上尚属空白。

Method: 1) 数据侧：采用光流、FILM或扫视上采样后进行线性事件生成，将SAMA-239K grounded video-chat语料及额外SAMA训练数据转换为合成事件流，完整保留掩码、指代表达式和对话标注；2) 模型侧：以SAMA-4B为基座，设计从预训练RGB权重初始化的双通道极性patch嵌入与零初始化事件适配器，端到端训练；3) 对比实验：冻结RGB SAMA-4B并输入伪RGB渲染或E2VID重建作为对照；4) 种子控制消融（实测噪声底0.47 J&F），考察训练来源多样性、事件stem初始化、可训练SAM2掩码解码器、事件适配器、ViT部分解冻及事件极性的贡献；5) 比较早期部分转换语料快照在相同配方下的表现。

Result: Event-SAMA在MeViS valid_u上取得24.37 J&F，在转换后的ReVOS valid子集上取得22.33 J&F（RGB SAMA-4B在MeViS为55.4）；冻结RGB SAMA-4B配合伪RGB渲染或E2VID重建分别仅得13.23与15.94 J&F。不重新训练时，当累积窗口匹配真实事件密度，模型可直接用于真实事件相机录制。消融显示：多样化训练来源较仅用MeViS提升+4.99，RGB均值事件stem初始化提升+4.33，可训练SAM2掩码解码器提升+2.76；事件适配器、ViT部分解冻与事件极性在该预算下处于噪声范围内。早期部分转换语料快照在同一配方下MeViS高1.38、ReVOS高1.12。

Conclusion: 论文构建了首个事件原生RVOS数据集与基线模型，验证了事件流在该任务上的可行性，但绝对性能与RGB模型仍有显著差距；关键增益来自多样化训练数据、合理的事件stem初始化与可训练掩码解码器。由于两次语料对比均为单次运行且训练调度长度不同，作者不对语料规模的影响下结论。

Abstract: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range and no motion blur, but referring video object segmentation (RVOS) lacks event-stream datasets and models. We introduce Event-SAMA-239K, a synthetic-event conversion of the SAMA-239K grounded video-chat corpus and all additional SAMA training data: 30,650 video clips and 392,162 images. Optical-flow, FILM or saccade upsampling followed by a linear event generator preserves all mask, referring-expression and dialogue annotations. We also introduce Event-SAMA, adapting SAMA-4B with a two-channel polarity patch embedding initialised from pretrained RGB weights and a zero-initialised event adapter. End-to-end training yields 24.37 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on MeViS valid_u and 22.33 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on the converted ReVOS valid subset, establishing the first event-native RVOS baseline (RGB SAMA-4B: 55.4 on MeViS). Frozen RGB SAMA-4B with pseudo-RGB renderings or E2VID reconstructions of the same events scores 13.23 and 15.94 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$. Without retraining, Event-SAMA works on real event-camera recordings when the accumulation window matches their event density. A seed-controlled ablation with a measured noise floor of 0.47 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ finds gains from diverse training sources over MeViS alone (+4.99), RGB-mean event-stem initialisation (+4.33), and a trainable SAM2 mask decoder (+2.76); the event adapter, partial ViT unfreezing and event polarity are within noise at this budget. An earlier, partially converted corpus snapshot trained with the identical recipe scores 1.38 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ higher on MeViS and 1.12 higher on ReVOS. Both are single runs that also differ in schedule length, so we draw no conclusion about corpus scale.

</details>


### [639] [Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39455)
*Zhaoxin Wang,Zihang Ding,Handing Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAFT：基于对抗梯度显著性识别"鲁棒性关键参数"(RCPs)，仅更新约5%参数即可逼近甚至超越全参数对抗训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗训练(AT)内存开销大且存在干净-鲁棒精度权衡；LoRA等参数高效微调引入AT后，相对全参数AT存在明显鲁棒性差距。作者希望从参数空间视角重新审视参数高效对抗微调。

Method: 通过梯度分析发现对抗优化高度集中于少量参数（RCPs），表明鲁棒性编码于稀疏子空间。据此提出稀疏对抗微调(SAFT)：用对抗梯度显著性识别RCPs，仅更新这些参数、冻结其余参数进行AT。

Result: 在多种架构与数据集上，SAFT以更少可训练参数在干净与鲁棒精度上均优于LoRA类方法；仅更新约5%参数即在鲁棒性上接近或超过全参数AT。

Conclusion: 鲁棒性可由稀疏参数子空间承载，参数高效对抗微调的关键在于参数选择而非低秩约束，SAFT为高效鲁棒训练提供了新路径。

Abstract: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Adversarial training (AT) is one of the most effective defenses, yet it suffers from high memory cost on large models and the persistent clean-robust accuracy trade-off. Recent work introduces parameter-efficient fine-tuning, such as LoRA, into AT, but this constraint induces a notable robustness gap relative to full-parameter AT. In this work, we revisit parameter-efficient adversarial fine-tuning from a parameter space perspective. Through gradient analysis, we find that adversarial optimization is highly concentrated on a small subset of parameters, which we call Robustness-Critical Parameters (RCPs), suggesting that robustness is encoded in a sparse subspace. Building on this observation, we propose Sparse Adversarial Fine-Tuning (SAFT), which identifies RCPs via adversarial gradient saliency and performs AT by updating only these parameters while freezing the rest. Across architectures and datasets, SAFT outperforms LoRA-based methods in both clean and robust accuracy with fewer trainable parameters, and approaches or surpasses full parameter AT in robustness while updating only about 5\% of parameters.

</details>


### [640] [Achieving Minimax-Optimal First-Order and Best-of-Both-Worlds Regret Simultaneously in Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39457)
*Mengxiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究多臂老虎机中的一阶（first-order）与"两全其美"（best-of-both-worlds）悔界，提出一种高效、免参数算法，消除了Pogodin与Lattimore（2019）算法中损失相关项的额外对数因子，达到最优一阶悔界 O(√(K L*))，同时保持随机损失下的对数式实例相关悔界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作（Pogodin & Lattimore, 2019）将极小极大最优最坏情况悔界与一阶保证结合，但其损失相关项为 O(√(K L*) log T)，与最优一阶规模 O(√(K L*)) 之间存在对数差距；本文致力于消除该对数因子，并同时获得两全其美保证。

Method: 基于带 Tsallis 熵正则项的 FTRL（Zimmert & Seldin, 2021）：学习率根据学习者的累积损失自适应调整；采样分布由一个标量不动点（scalar fixed point）确定；通过该构造以学习者自身损失为度量，统一控制估计成本与稳定性成本。

Result: (1) 得到极小极大最优的一阶悔界 O(√(K L*))，去掉了原结果中的 log T 因子；(2) 同一算法在具有唯一最优臂 i* 的 i.i.d. 损失下取得 O(Σ_{i≠i*} log T / Δ_i) 的悔界，其中 Δ_i 为臂 i 的次优间隙；(3) 算法高效且免参数。

Conclusion: 通过对 Tsallis 熵 FTRL 的自适应学习率与不动点采样分布设计，可在不使用任何先验参数的情况下同时实现极小极大最优的一阶悔界与实例相关的最优对数悔界，从而在单一算法框架内统一最坏情况与随机情况的保证，并闭合了此前存在的对数差距。

Abstract: We study first-order and best-of-both-worlds regret guarantees in multi-armed bandits. Pogodin and Lattimore (2019) proposed an algorithm that combines minimax-optimal worst-case regret with a first-order guarantee whose loss-dependent term is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star}\log T)$, where $T$ denotes the horizon, $L^\star$ denotes the smallest expected cumulative loss among fixed arms, and $K$ denotes the number of arms. However, a logarithmic gap remains between this loss-dependent term and the optimal first-order scale. In this paper, we remove this logarithmic factor by proposing an efficient and parameter-free algorithm that achieves the minimax optimal first-order regret guarantee $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star})$. Technically, our algorithm is built upon FTRL with a Tsallis entropy regularizer (Zimmert and Seldin,2021), with a learning rate adapted to the learner's cumulative loss and a sampling distribution determined by a scalar fixed point. This construction controls the combined estimation and stability cost in terms of the learner's loss. Moreover, we show that the same algorithm achieves a best-of-both-worlds guarantee, with $\mathcal{O}(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\frac{\log T}{Δ_i})$ regret for i.i.d. losses with a unique best arm $i^\star$, where $Δ_i$ denotes the suboptimality gap of arm $i$.

</details>


### [641] [CBE: A Complexity-adaptive Boundary-aware Ensemble Method for Imbalanced Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39466)
*Xun Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出复杂度自适应边界感知集成框架（CBE），将欠采样权重分布与数据复杂度关联、动态调整边界偏好，并在24个UCI/KEEL基准上取得更优F-measure与G-mean。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类别不平衡数据中，数据复杂度（类重叠、复杂决策边界）比不平衡率更能客观反映学习难度；而多数欠采样方法无法针对不同复杂度数据集差异化地采样边界样本。

Method: 提出CBE框架：构建融合多层级指标的整体复杂度度量，据此将不平衡数据集划分为三类；并将采样权重分布与数据复杂度相链接，动态调整欠采样对边界样本的偏好，结合集成学习。

Result: 在UCI与KEEL的24个基准数据集上，CBE在Easy与Median数据集上的F-measure和G-mean优于多种现有方法，且在困难数据集上性能不退化。

Conclusion: 以数据复杂度为驱动自适应调节边界欠采样策略的集成方法，可在不牺牲困难情形性能的前提下提升不平衡分类效果。

Abstract: In many real-world classification tasks, datasets exhibit class imbalance, which can degrade the generalization performance of conventional learning algorithms. Data complexity has recently been recognized as a more objective indicator of learning difficulty than the imbalance ratio alone, because class overlap and complex decision boundaries often impair classifiers more severely than imbalance itself. Samples near the decision boundary are inherently difficult to classify, which has motivated many researchers to focus on such instances to improve classifier performance. However, most under-sampling approaches fail to differentiate their sampling of boundary samples across datasets of varying complexity. To overcome this limitation, we propose a complexity-adaptive boundary-aware ensemble (CBE) framework that links the sampling weight distribution to data complexity and dynamically adjusts the boundary preference of under-sampling accordingly. We also introduce an overall complexity measure that combines metrics at multiple levels and use it to divide imbalanced datasets into three categories. Extensive experiments on 24 benchmark datasets from UCI and KEEL show that the proposed method outperforms many existing methods in terms of F-measure and G-mean on Easy and Median datasets, without degrading performance on hard cases.

</details>


### [642] [Surprise Alone Learns Lies: Evidence-Gated Continual Learning for LLMs from Streaming Claims](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39840)
*Abdelkader Metales,Miriam Grabenheinrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 惊奇驱动的持续学习在大模型上会把"模型认为反直觉的谎言"几乎全部吸收；论文系统评估了四种验收信号（验证器裁判、校准回归测试、模型先验、可信来源取证），发现各自只回答不同问题，组合系统在可取证场景下毒率最低，但造假来源可被攻破。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习方法越来越多地以"惊奇度"（surprise，即模型最不可预测的输入）决定学什么，但当数据流中含有谎言时该规则不安全：关于模型已知事实的植入谎言在模型信念下概率极低，天然高度惊奇，因而被几乎无条件吸收，其吸收率与同预算随机采样相当。论文旨在检验各种"验收信号"能否在保留真实新知识的同时过滤谎言。

Method: 使用 LoRA 适配的学生模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B、Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-3B），在由虚构人物陈述与真实 CounterFact 事实构成的真假混合数据流上学习。逐一评测四类验收信号：(1) 验证器裁判键（judge 逐条批准）；(2) 对无关知识做校准回归测试以放缓学习；(3) 用原模型自身先验标记与已知事实矛盾的陈述；(4) 将矛盾陈述路由到可信来源证据。并考察攻击者植入匹配来源的对抗情形。

Result: (1) 裁判键按验证器准确率程度去除谎言，但真实 LLM 裁判过于保守，会拒收无来源真陈述乃至有来源更新；(2) 校准回归测试只减慢学习速度，不过滤谎言；(3) 模型自身先验在无裁判时可区分"关于已知事实的谎言"与"真实新事实"（三模型 AUC 0.78–0.83），但对同类事实的合法更新无区分力（AUC 0.53）；可节省 43% 裁判调用，然而有模型访问权的攻击者可构造通过该先验的谎言；(4) 存在攻击者无法植入的可信来源时，取证路由能恢复合法更新，组合系统在被学习陈述中毒率最低；但若攻击者为 30% 的谎言植入匹配来源，系统劣于单用裁判。

Conclusion: 各验收信号回答的是不同问题，任何单一信号都无法独立判定陈述真伪；安全的知识获取需要按信号所答问题分工组合（如先验筛选＋裁判＋来源取证），并需正视来源可信性这一根本假设的脆弱性。

Abstract: Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitimate updates of the same kind of fact (AUC 0.53). It saves 43% of judge calls, but an attacker with access to the model can choose lies that pass it. (4) If trusted sources exist that an attacker cannot plant, routing contradicted claims to evidence recovers legitimate updates and the combined system has the lowest poison rate among learned claims; when an attacker plants matching sources for 30% of the lies, the system ends up worse than the judge alone. The acceptance signals answer different questions, and none of them decides on its own whether a claim is true.

</details>


### [643] [Topology Survives Shuffling: Robust Long-Context Memory Access Prediction for Graph Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39477)
*Dongyan Sun,Neelesh Gupta,Rajgopal Kannan,Viktor K. Prasanna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LoCoMAP——可独立控制观测历史与预测视野的长上下文表征学习框架，用于图分析访存预测；实验表明延长视野比延长历史收益更大，且长上下文预测器在布局扰动下更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图分析通过间接遍历产生不规则、依赖拓扑的访存流，限制预取。现有ML预测器将短历史与固定视野耦合，拟合训练迹的节点布局而非学习可迁移的图模式，导致泛化差。

Method: LoCoMAP框架将观测历史长度与预测视野解耦、独立控制。在CC、PR、SSSP三类负载与六类合成图族（含ER与Grid作随机/确定性对照）上评估18个图-负载组合，并设计两种干预：同族重生成（改变连通性）与节点打乱（破坏布局、保留连通性），检验不重训练的迁移性。

Result: 历史由8增至128访存，F1提升7.8%；视野由8增至512，F1提升88.3%。CC：重生成扰动轻于打乱，长上下文保留95.4%原始F1并在六族上优于短上下文；全打乱下ER、BA、Copying、SBM平均提升33.6%（SBM达2.06倍），但WS与Grid无增益，因质量近乎为零时增量移入预测器范围外的重尾。六类真实CC图上长上下文均更优。全打乱下PR保留57.6% F1、平均高于短上下文11.0%；SSSP长短期均仅保留约30%，因距离更新以新顺序访问顶点数据。

Conclusion: 长上下文预测器在相关图与布局变化下无需重训练即具鲁棒性，具备构建可泛化图预取器的潜力；其有效性存在边界，受重尾增量分布与访问顺序变化制约。

Abstract: Graph analytics generates irregular, topology-dependent memory-access streams via indirect traversals, limiting data prefetching. Accurate prediction enables timely prefetches that hide memory latency. However, ML predictors couple short histories with fixed horizons, fitting the training trace's node layout rather than learning transferable graph patterns. We propose LoCoMAP, a long-context representation-learning framework for memory-access prediction with independently controlled observation history and prediction horizon. We evaluate Connected Components (CC), PageRank (PR), and Single-Source Shortest Paths (SSSP) on six synthetic graph families, with Erdos-Renyi (ER) and Grid as random and deterministic controls. We test two interventions: same-family regeneration changes connectivity, while node shuffling disrupts layout but preserves connectivity. Across 18 graph-workload pairs, extending history from 8 to 128 accesses improves F1 by 7.8%, while extending prediction horizon from 8 to 512 improves F1 by 88.3%. For CC, regeneration is less disruptive than shuffling: without retraining, long context retains 95.4% of original F1 and outperforms short context in six families. Under full shuffle, long context improves CC F1 by 33.6% across ER, Barabasi-Albert, Copying Model, and Stochastic Block Model (SBM), with a 2.06x gain on SBM, but not on Watts-Strogatz or Grid, where near-zero delta mass shifts into heavy tails beyond the predictor's range. Long context outperforms short context on six real-world CC graphs. At full shuffle, long-context PR retains 57.6% of original F1 and averages 11.0% above short context. Both SSSP models retain about 30% of original F1 under full shuffle as distance updates access vertex data in a new order. Within these bounds, long-context predictors are robust across related graphs and layouts without retraining, enabling a generalizable graph prefetcher.

</details>


### [644] [Attention, Dynamic Wave and Hybrid Sequence Mixers in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39854)
*Dmytro Babarytskyi,Oleksandr Babarytskyi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出动态波（Dynamic Wave）循环层——基于输入依赖的指数衰减与余弦相位调制——并在TinyStories上以10.94M参数对比纯Transformer、纯Wave与Wave-Attention混合三种配置；混合架构困惑度最优（5.95 vs 6.93/7.26），但效率结论取决于实现与注意力后端而非架构本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM依赖多头注意力（MHA），长上下文受注意力二次开销限制，催生亚二次复杂度的循环替代方案；但现有文献报告的效率收益往往缺乏对注意力后端与实现细节的明确参照，需系统性厘清"架构收益"与"实现收益"的边界。

Method: 形式化动态波循环层（输入依赖指数阻尼+余弦相位调制）；在TinyStories上训练三个10.94M参数模型（纯Transformer、纯Wave、混合Wave-Attention），在最高4096 token上下文下测量困惑度、延迟、吞吐与峰值显存；通过将逐元素项提升出循环体外（无自定义kernel）进行算子级优化；并构建闭式显存模型复现测量结果、预测注意力开销超过词表投影的上下文长度阈值。

Result: 混合配置在完整留出集上困惑度5.95，优于Transformer的6.93与纯Wave的7.26。效率方面：相对未融合注意力基线，纯Wave在4096 token下峰值显存降低78.7%（1404.3 MB vs 6601.6 MB）；但相对融合SDPA内核则无任何优势（1404.3 MB vs 1403.6 MB），且训练模式下纯Wave比Transformer贵8.3%。循环外提升逐元素项使该层加速2.53倍，延迟差距由2.48倍缩小至1.12倍。混合栈继承的是较昂贵混合器的成本而非廉价混合器的优势，其峰值显存与纯Transformer相差在0.1%以内。闭式显存模型可复现上述测量并给出注意力超越词表投影的上下文长度。

Conclusion: 循环型注意力替代方案所报告的效率收益必须相对于具名的注意力后端与具名实现来陈述，否则易产生误导；混合化应主要基于质量（困惑度）理由而非效率理由来论证。架构层面的理论复杂度优势在工程实现（kernel融合、循环外提升）面前可能被完全抵消。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on Multi-Head Attention (MHA) for sequence modeling, but scaling to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of attention, motivating sub-quadratic recurrent alternatives. This paper formalizes a Dynamic Wave recurrent layer, based on input-dependent exponential damping and cosine phase modulation, and evaluates three 10.94M-parameter configurations (Pure Transformer, Pure Wave, and Hybrid Wave-Attention) on TinyStories under perplexity, latency, throughput and peak VRAM profiling up to 4096 tokens. The Hybrid configuration reaches the best perplexity, 5.95 on the full held-out split against 6.93 for the Transformer and 7.26 for Pure Wave. The efficiency picture, however, is governed by implementation rather than by architecture. Against an unfused attention baseline, Pure Wave uses 78.7% less peak VRAM at a 4096-token context (1404.3 MB vs. 6601.6 MB); against a fused scaled-dot-product attention kernel the same comparison yields no advantage at all (1404.3 MB vs. 1403.6 MB), and in training mode Pure Wave is 8.3% more expensive than the Transformer. Likewise, hoisting elementwise terms out of the recurrence loop speeds the layer up 2.53-fold with no custom kernel, reducing its latency gap to attention from 2.48-fold to 1.12-fold. A hybrid stack is found to inherit the cost of its more expensive mixer rather than the advantage of its cheaper one, its peak VRAM matching the Pure Transformer to within 0.1%. A closed-form memory model reproduces these measurements and predicts the context length beyond which attention overtakes the vocabulary projection. The findings indicate that reported efficiency gains for recurrent attention replacements must be stated relative to a named attention backend and a named implementation, and that hybridization is best justified on quality grounds.

</details>


### [645] [Interpretable by Design Tabular Prediction via In-Context Local Linear Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39506)
*Ran Eisenberg,Steven Berger,Ofir Lindenbaum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TICL^3：用表格基础模型指导的"共享线性模型+局部残差线性模型"实现可解释即设计的表格预测器，预测与解释同源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型在ICL下预测精度高，但难以解释单个特征对预测的贡献（如生物标志物/风险基因识别）；事后解释方法给出的重要性分数未必反映模型真实使用，易产生解释错误。

Method: TICL^3（Tabular In-Context Local Linear Learning）：先学习一个共享线性模型刻画数据集级特征效应；对每个查询，用基础模型表示检索相似训练样本，在邻域内对残差拟合第二个线性模型；共享模型捕捉全局效应、局部模型纠正相似样本误差，二者组合系数给出该查询的具体特征贡献。

Result: 在386个分类基准-数据集评估中，较TabICLv2低1.1个百分点，在266个评估中优于CatBoost；平均支持F1较MAPLE提升4.7点；在两项真实数据选定特征效用指标上均最优。

Conclusion: 通过将基础模型嵌入简单线性预测规则，TICL^3在保持接近SOTA精度的同时实现内在可解释性，特征贡献即模型实际使用的系数，避免事后解释的失真。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) lets tabular foundation models make predictions without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. These models achieve strong predictive accuracy, but interpreting how individual features contribute to the prediction remains difficult. In biology, for example, feature contributions can help identify biomarkers or risk genes. Post-hoc interpretability methods assign feature importance scores, but these scores do not indicate what the model actually uses and can lead to explanation errors. We introduce TICL$^3$ (Tabular In-Context Local Linear Learning), an interpretable-by-design predictor that uses a tabular foundation model to guide a simple linear prediction rule. TICL$^3$ first learns a shared linear model to capture dataset-level feature effects. Then, for each query, it retrieves similar training samples using representations from the foundation model and fits a second linear model to the residuals in that neighborhood. The shared model captures broad effects, while the local model corrects errors among similar samples. Their combined coefficients determine each feature contribution to the final query-specific linear score, so the same model makes and explains the prediction. Across 386 classification benchmark-dataset evaluations, TICL$^3$ trails TabICLv2 by 1.1 percentage points and outperforms CatBoost in 266 evaluations. It improves average support F1 over MAPLE by 4.7 points and achieves the best performance on both real-data selected-feature utility metrics.

</details>


### [646] [One Vector or Many? Clustered Optimal-Transport Steering under Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40055)
*Illia Makarov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究聚类最优传输激活操控（CHaRS 类方法）用于毒性缓解，证明其位移的簇规模加权平均恒等于 DiM，并检验量化下该方法的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活操控最常用的 DiM（类均值差向量）对每个隐状态加同一向量，忽略概念异质性；CHaRS 用最优传输把各类簇配对并对每个隐状态做簇位移混合，但尚不清楚这一"plan"相对 DiM 究竟带来什么增益，以及该增益能否在 INT8/NF4 量化后保留。

Method: 在 Gemma-2-2B 与 Granite-3.1-2B 上做毒性缓解实验。理论上证明一恒等式：以簇大小为权重的位移加权平均等于 DiM，故聚类映射仅在路由权重偏离簇大小时才区别于 DiM。对比 CHaRS 协议与逐层加 DiM 的 Mean-AcT（八项预设等价检验），并提出按单 token 拟合、路由偏向最近簇的变体；用 toxic-bert 及另两个毒性分类器评估，测困惑度与等毒性匹配下的流畅度，并在 INT8/NF4 下复测及跨精度迁移。

Result: CHaRS 与 Mean-AcT 在全部八项等价检验中统计等价；单 token 变体在强度 3 下比 DiM 少留 37–39%（Gemma）与 51–61%（Granite）毒性（DiM 本已去除 76–85%）；Granite 上两个额外分类器均确认增益，Gemma 仅一个。同强度下变体困惑度略高，等毒性下略更流畅。近常数映射同样少留约 30% 毒性。

Conclusion: CHaRS 协议本身并未超越 DiM，原因是其路由权重接近簇规模；增益来自逐 token 路由变体，但在 INT8/NF4 下仍优于 DiM，且全精度到 NF4 的迁移无需重拟合（多重检验校正后无显著毒性损失）。"区别对待 token"的具体作用仍待厘清，因近常数映射亦有效。

Abstract: Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time. Its most common form adds one vector, the difference of class means (DiM), to every hidden state. CHaRS (concept heterogeneity-aware representation steering) uses optimal transport instead: an entropic plan pairs the clusters of the two classes, and each hidden state moves along a mixture of the cluster displacements, weighted toward its nearest clusters. We study this family of clustered optimal-transport maps for toxicity mitigation in Gemma-2-2B and Granite-3.1-2B, and ask what the plan adds to DiM and whether that survives INT8 and NF4 quantization.
  We prove an identity: whatever the plan, the displacements averaged with the cluster sizes as weights equal DiM, so a clustered map can differ from DiM only for tokens whose routing weights depart from the cluster sizes. In the CHaRS protocol they stay close, and CHaRS is statistically equivalent to Mean-AcT, which adds DiM at every layer, in all eight pre-specified equivalence tests. A variant fitted on individual tokens, which routes each token mainly to its nearest clusters, leaves 37-39% less toxicity than DiM on Gemma and 51-61% less on Granite at steering strength 3 (toxic-bert), where DiM already removes 76-85% of it. Two other toxicity classifiers confirm the gain on Granite, but on Gemma only one does. At equal strength the variant has somewhat higher perplexity, but at matched toxicity it is slightly more fluent than DiM. Yet a nearly constant map from the same clusters also leaves about 30% less toxicity, so the role of treating tokens differently remains open.
  Under INT8 and NF4 the variant still leaves less toxicity than DiM, and transferring it from full precision to the NF4 model instead of refitting it adds no significant toxicity after correction for multiple tests.

</details>


### [647] [Last-Iterate Convergence for Constrained MDPs: From Dual Descent to Primal-Dual](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39524)
*Michael Lu,Max Qiushi Lin,Mo Chen,Sharan Vaswani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对无限时域折扣约束MDP的策略优化，作者提出无需覆盖假设的DD方法新分析，并通过熵正则化自然策略梯度与对偶正则化消除内层循环，得到高效PD算法，实现更强的last-iterate收敛保证，并推广至线性函数逼近。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PD方法理论保证依赖不实际的混合策略；DD方法虽输出单一"last iterate"策略但需内层迭代求解熵正则MDP，实用性受限；且现有分析依赖难以满足的强覆盖假设。

Method: （1）给出不依赖覆盖假设的DD方法新分析；（2）结合熵正则化自然策略梯度与对偶正则化消除内层循环，构造高效PD算法；（3）提出新的tracking分析；（4）构建可在DD与PD间插值的截断bilevel方法框架；（5）将分析推广至线性函数逼近。

Result: 相比现有方法获得改进的last-iterate收敛保证；理论框架可分析截断bilevel方法；在更弱假设下证明了比先前last-iterate方法更强的保证。

Conclusion: 所提高效PD算法兼具单一策略输出与实际可计算性，并在更少限制性假设下提供理论上更强的收敛性，为约束MDP策略优化提供统一分析框架。

Abstract: We study policy optimization for infinite-horizon, discounted constrained Markov decision processes. While primal-dual ($\texttt{PD}$) methods are widely used in practice, their theoretical guarantees typically hold for an impractical mixture policy. In contrast, dual descent ($\texttt{DD}$) methods output a single policy ("last iterate") with guarantees on its performance. However, such methods require iteratively solving entropy-regularized MDPs in an inner-loop, limiting their practical effectiveness. Moreover, existing analyses rely on strong coverage assumptions that are difficult to satisfy in practice. Consequently, we first provide a new analysis of $\texttt{DD}$ methods that does not require coverage assumptions. We then employ entropy-regularized natural policy gradient and dual regularization to eliminate the inner loop, resulting in an efficient $\texttt{PD}$ algorithm. We develop a novel tracking analysis which shows that, compared to existing methods, the proposed algorithm achieves improved last-iterate convergence guarantees. Furthermore, our theoretical framework allows us to analyze a truncated bilevel method that interpolates between $\texttt{DD}$ and $\texttt{PD}$ methods. Finally, we generalize our analysis to handle linear function approximation. Compared to prior last-iterate methods, we prove stronger guarantees under less restrictive assumptions.

</details>


### [648] [Explainable and Adaptive Machine Learning for Fraud Risk Detection in Bangladesh's Digital Banking Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39556)
*Md Najmus Swaqeeb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个可解释、自适应的机器学习框架（时间序列评估、防泄漏特征工程、概率校准、SHAP解释、自适应风险优先级），在PaySim上比较LR/RF/XGBoost/LightGBM，XGBoost表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字银行与移动金融快速扩张，欺诈检测面临严重类别不平衡与运营约束，需要兼顾检测性能、概率可靠性与可解释性的方法。

Method: 在合成PaySim数据集上采用按时间顺序的评估与防数据泄漏的特征工程，比较逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM；使用Platt校准改善概率输出，SHAP做特征归因，并设计自适应top-k风险优先级策略。

Result: XGBoost固定阈值性能最优：PR-AUC 0.5658、ROC-AUC 0.9068、F1 0.5369；Platt校准使Brier分数由0.1141降至0.0245；SHAP显示时间、收款账户、交易类型与金额为主要驱动特征；top-1%策略将误报由192降至117，但召回由0.4236降至0.2122。

Conclusion: 研究提供可复现的方法学框架而非实际部署性能证据（PaySim为合成数据），后续需在受治理的真实金融数据上验证；告警容量与召回之间存在明确权衡。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of digital banking and mobile financial services creates growing challenges for fraud detection, particularly under severe class imbalance and operational constraints. This study presents an explainable and adaptive machine-learning framework integrating chronological evaluation, leakage-conscious feature engineering, probability calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and adaptive risk prioritization. Experiments use the synthetic PaySim mobile-money benchmark and compare Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM. XGBoost achieved the strongest fixed-threshold performance, with PR-AUC of 0.5658, ROC-AUC of 0.9068, and F1-score of 0.5369. Platt calibration reduced the test Brier score from 0.1141 to 0.0245, improving probability reliability. SHAP analysis identified temporal, destination-account, transaction-type, and amount features as important model drivers. An adaptive top-1% policy reduced false positives from 192 to 117, but recall declined from 0.4236 to 0.2122, demonstrating a clear alert-capacity trade-off. The results provide a reproducible methodological framework rather than evidence of deployment performance in Bangladesh, since PaySim is synthetic. Validation using governed real-world financial data is therefore an important direction for future research.

</details>


### [649] [LatentWeave: Test-Time Latent Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39557)
*Fanci Meng,Kun Wang,Guibin Zhang,Xinlei Yu,Jiaming Zhang,Ming Li,Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出测试时框架LatentWeave，将多模态推理视作可控的隐轨迹，通过分段"隐编织"与WEAVE令牌推理锚点实现细粒度、步骤感知的隐空间干预，在固定主干参数下提升MLLM多模态推理表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时优化方法多在提示或输出层面操作，隐推理过程基本不受控，难以抑制自回归生成中的误差累积。

Method: 将多模态推理建模为可控隐轨迹：Latent Weaving对中间隐状态按段渐进精炼以纠正出现的偏差；并引入基于轻量WEAVE令牌的Reasoning Anchors，稳定推理结构并引导面向答案的生成。主模型参数保持冻结。

Result: 在多种多模态推理基准上相对所评估基线取得提升；消融与效率研究分别分析了隐优化、锚点训练及额外测试时计算量的贡献。

Conclusion: 隐空间层面的步骤感知干预是对提示/输出级测试时优化的有效补充，可在不修改主干参数的前提下改善多模态推理。

Abstract: Recent advances in test-time optimization have shown that the multimodal reasoning performance of large multimodal language models (MLLMs) can be improved during inference without modifying backbone model parameters. However, existing approaches primarily operate at the prompt or output level, leaving the latent reasoning process largely uncontrolled and insufficient to prevent error accumulation during autoregressive generation. To address this limitation, we propose LatentWeave, a test-time framework that treats multimodal reasoning as a controllable latent trajectory. LatentWeave performs structured Latent Weaving, progressively refining intermediate hidden states segment-wise to correct emerging deviations, and further introduces Reasoning Anchors via lightweight WEAVE tokens to stabilize reasoning structure and guide answer-oriented generation. These mechanisms are designed to enable fine-grained, step-aware intervention in the latent reasoning process while keeping the main MLLM backbone parameters fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks report improvements over the evaluated baselines; the contribution of latent optimization, anchor training, and additional test-time computation is analyzed separately in the ablation and efficiency studies. Our code is available at https://github.com/jins7/LatentWeave.

</details>


### [650] [Improving the Intrinsic Interpretability of Differentiable Decision Trees through Euclidean Feature-Concentration Regularisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39596)
*Qiqi Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EU-DDT：以节点相对绝对特征权重的归一化平方欧氏距离作为正则项，使可分决策树在保留软路由的同时实现特征集中，并用作PPO策略网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微决策树（DDT）支持端到端优化与显式决策路径，但稠密斜切（oblique）划分会掩盖单个输入特征的作用，节点级特征贡献不可解释。作者希望在不放弃概率软路由的前提下，让每个内部节点由少数特征主导。

Method: 在EU-DDT中，对每个内部节点的相对绝对特征权重计算其归一化平方欧氏距离（相对于均匀分布的偏离度）作为正则项，将权重推向稀疏/集中；保留概率软路由以维持可微性。实验：(1) 在Wine与Digits上以5个匹配随机种子与基线DDT对比；(2) 用EU-DDT参数化PPO的actor、MLP作critic，在CartPole-v1与MiniPacman上各跑2个种子，以节点集中度作为指标。

Result: 有效特征数均值：Wine 8.94→1.54，Digits 45.28→9.06；测试准确率均值：Wine 100.0%→93.9%，Digits 92.3%→94.6%，呈数据集相关的精度–集中度权衡。强化学习中两种子运行显示集中度定性一致上升且任务性能基本保持：CartPole-v1与MiniPacman最终评估成功率均达100%，平均节点集中度分别由0.1272升至0.7179、由0.0437升至0.7237。

Conclusion: EU正则化可有效降低节点级特征复杂度，并在RL策略参数化中保持任务性能；但RL证据仅基于2个种子，属初步结论，且精度代价依数据集而异。

Abstract: Differentiable decision trees (DDTs) support end-to-end optimisation and explicit decision paths, but dense oblique splits can obscure the role of individual input features. We propose the Euclidean-Concentrated Differentiable Decision Tree (EU-DDT), which regularises the relative absolute feature weights at each internal node using their normalised squared Euclidean distance from the uniform distribution. This encourages dominance by a small number of features while retaining probabilistic soft routing. Across five matched random seeds, EU-DDT reduces the mean effective number of features from 8.94 to 1.54 on Wine and from 45.28 to 9.06 on Digits. Mean test accuracy changes from 100.0% to 93.9% on Wine and from 92.3% to 94.6% on Digits, illustrating the dataset-dependent trade-off between concentration and predictive performance. We also use EU-DDT to parameterise a PPO actor with an MLP critic. Two random-seed runs per environment show a consistent qualitative increase in concentration while preserving effective task performance. In representative CartPole-v1 and MiniPacman runs, EU-DDT reaches 100% final evaluation success, while mean node concentration increases from 0.1272 to 0.7179 and from 0.0437 to 0.7237, respectively. These results support EU regularisation as a mechanism for reducing node-level feature complexity; the reinforcement-learning evidence remains preliminary because only two seeds are evaluated.

</details>


### [651] [Factorized Representations of Concurrent Temporal Variables in Pretrained Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40328)
*Xinhe Zhang,Arnau Marin-Llobet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 预训练语言模型对文档内两个独立演化的上下文定时器（语言切换与主题变更）在同一隐藏状态中呈线性可解码，并通过选择性可及性与近似可加的联合状态几何实现近似因子化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档中往往需要同时维护多个独立演化的上下文变量，已有工作刻画了单个时间或上下文量的结构化表示，但这些变量的联合组织方式仍不清楚。

Method: 构造相位独立控制语言切换与主题变更计时器的受控文档；在十个预训练检查点上做线性解码；通过移除与某一计时器相关的质心平面进行干预；分析联合状态质心间的可复现变异来源，并扫描3–51个计时器取值及Qwen3 0.6B–14B检查点。

Result: 两个计时器均可从同一隐藏状态线性解码；移除某一计时器的质心平面对其对应变量可及性影响显著，而对并发计时器影响很小，尽管两平面非正交且含交叉计时器信息；单独计时器贡献可解释联合质心间大部分可复现变异；这些特征在取值数量与模型规模上稳健。调度位置影响续写概率，但所测试的质心位移未产生一致的计时器特异性输出效应。

Conclusion: 结果表明模型基于选择性可及性与重叠子空间中近似可加的联合状态几何，实现了对多个独立上下文变量的近似因子化表示。

Abstract: Language models often need to maintain multiple contextual variables that evolve independently within a document. Prior work has identified structured representations of individual temporal or contextual quantities, but their joint organization remains less understood. We study this question using controlled documents with independently phased language-switch and topic-change timers. Across ten pretrained checkpoints, both timers are linearly decodable from the same hidden states. Removing a timer-associated centroid plane substantially reduces access to its associated variable while having little effect on the concurrent timer, although the planes are nonorthogonal and contain cross-timer information. Separate timer contributions also explain most reproducible variation among joint-state centroids. These signatures persist from 3 to 51 timer values and across Qwen3 checkpoints from 0.6B to 14B. Schedule position affects continuation probabilities, but the tested centroid displacement produces no consistent timer-specific output effect. Together, these results support approximate factorization based on selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry in overlapping subspaces.

</details>


### [652] [A New AFIB Detection Method with Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39665)
*Sara Gjorgjieva,Ana Angjelevska,Dimitar Trajanov,Marjan Gusev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于dBPM（相邻心率差值时间序列）特征工程与五类标签+异常值剔除训练策略的房颤检测方法，DNN在独立基准集上取得95.18%的F1分数，优于既有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 房颤（AFIB）早筛每年可挽救大量生命，现有算法在精度与鲁棒性上仍不足，需要更准确、可靠的检测方案。

Method: 在MITDB与LTAFDB两个PhysioNet数据库上，比较多种传统机器学习算法与神经网络。核心创新为：以相邻心率差值时间序列（dBPM）替代传统RR间期作为特征；将输入标注为五类，仅用新标注方法筛选出的“干净间期”训练，其余按异常值处理；最优模型为DNN。

Result: 最优DNN模型在与训练集不同的基准数据集上，二分类房颤检测F1达95.18%，性能优于已发表模型。

Conclusion: dBPM特征结合干净样本筛选策略可显著提升房颤检测的精度与鲁棒性，所提方法在跨数据集评估中表现优越。

Abstract: Early detection of atrial fibrillation (AFIB), characterized by irregular heart rhythms, can potentially save thousands of lives annually [20]. Numerous studies have attempted to address this challenge using various algorithms and methodologies. This paper introduces a novel and robust method that enhances the precision of AFIB detection. Neural Networks (NN) are widely recognized for their ability to identify complex electrocardiogram (ECG) patterns, facilitating the accurate detection of irregular heart rhythms. This study explores multiple conventional machine learning algorithms alongside neural network approaches to develop a robust AFIB detection system. To evaluate the effective- ness and robustness of the proposed method, the MIT BIH arrhythmia database (MITDB) and the Long-term Atrial Fibrillation Database (LTAFDB), both available on the Physionet site. Our approach presents a novel feature engineering technique, employing specific features such as a time series of the differences in successive heart rates (dBPM) rather than traditional inter-beat intervals. The model analyzes inputs labeled into five distinct classes, using only clean intervals identified through a new labeling method for training while treating others as outliers. This strategy ensures a more accurate and reliable AFIB detection process. The best-performing model, a Deep Neural Network (DNN), achieved an F1 score of 95.18% for binary atrial fibrillation classification on a benchmark dataset distinct from the training set. Models trained using our approach have demonstrated superior performance than previously published models.

</details>


### [653] [Heterogeneous Co-Evolution Learning for Tool-Efficient Search Agents with Zero Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39682)
*Qin-Wen Luo,Sheng Ren,Xiang Chen,Rui Liu,Jun Fang,Naiqiang Tan,Jun Wang,Hua Chai,Sheng-Jun Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ZEST-Search，一个零标注、工具高效的搜索智能体训练框架，通过异构协同进化（自适应出题者与解题者）解决固定任务集无法适配能力成长与结果型RL忽视搜索冗余两大问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度搜索智能体将推理与外部检索交错进行，但训练存在两个超越最终答案优化的挑战：(1) 智能体的能力边界主要由训练问题决定，固定的或带标注的任务集合无法随智能体提升而自适应；(2) 仅基于结果的强化学习把所有成功轨迹等同对待，即使某些正确答案依赖冗余搜索，导致答案准确率与工具效率之间内在张力。

Method: ZEST-Search：从无标注参考问题出发，通过"答案优先+证据路径引导"的生成流程在线构建经验证的搜索任务；异构出题者（proposer）围绕解题者（solver）演化的能力边界自适应构造任务，解题者用强化学习学习搜索增强推理。奖励设计上，对出题者采用中等难度奖励，对解题者采用任务局部、工具感知的奖励，鼓励信息量大的任务以及以更少冗余搜索得到正确答案。

Result: 在七个通用域与多跳问答基准上，ZEST-Search在不使用标注搜索训练数据和专家搜索轨迹的情况下，持续提升搜索智能体性能并实现更高工具效率。进一步分析表明，异构生成、自适应难度控制与工具感知优化使搜索智能体训练更有效。

Conclusion: 零标注、工具高效的异构协同进化框架可同时缓解任务集静态性与搜索冗余问题，在无监督数据条件下兼顾准确率与检索效率，是一种有效的搜索智能体训练范式。

Abstract: Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval. However, effective search-agent training requires addressing two challenges beyond final-answer optimization. First, the capability frontier of agents is largely determined by training questions, whereas fixed or labeled task collections cannot adapt as agents improve. Second, outcome-only reinforcement learning treats all successful trajectories equally, even when some correct answers rely on redundant searches, creating an inherent tension between answer accuracy and tool efficiency. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{ZEST-Search}, a zero-label and tool-efficient framework for search-agent training via heterogeneous co-evolution. Starting from unlabeled reference questions, \textsc{ZEST-Search} constructs validated search tasks online through an answer-first and evidence-path-guided generation process. A heterogeneous proposer adaptively constructs training tasks around the solver's evolving capability boundary, while the solver learns search-augmented reasoning through reinforcement learning. To jointly optimize task difficulty and search efficiency, \textsc{ZEST-Search} employs an intermediate-difficulty reward for the proposer and a task-local tool-aware reward for the solver, encouraging informative tasks and correct answers with fewer redundant searches. Experiments on seven general-domain and multi-hop question answering benchmarks demonstrate that \textsc{ZEST-Search} consistently improves search-agent performance while achieving higher tool efficiency without labeled search-training data or expert search trajectories. Further analyses show that heterogeneous generation, adaptive difficulty control, and tool-aware optimization enable more effective search-agent training.

</details>


### [654] [Smartphone Indoor Localization Enhanced by Hierarchical Multi-Sensor Context Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39691)
*Wenhui Feng,Muhan Weng,Jianyu Liu,Xiansheng Yang,Hao Zhang,Liang Wang,Yuan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出层级多传感器情境识别增强的手机室内定位框架，将环境/场景/活动概率转为场景事件段与动作情境段，分别驱动场景约束PDR校正与动作感知RoNIN补偿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手机室内定位需低成本、跨场景切换与手机使用方式变化的鲁棒性。PDR可免基础设施部署，但受航向漂移、结构转换和携带模式变化导致误差累积；现有方法把情境线索当作单一事件流或局部校正信号，难以对应不同类型的定位误差。

Method: 构建数据与模型联合驱动的层级多传感器情境识别模型，输出环境、场景、活动概率，并转换为场景事件段与动作情境段。场景事件段用于场景约束PDR校正（走廊航向约束、地标吸引、固定滞后回溯、垂直转换处理）；动作情境段驱动基于RoNIN的动作感知位置补偿，应对携带模式相关漂移。

Result: 在跨楼层与多动作轨迹上，以LiDAR-SLAM为参考，所提框架优于PDR及代表性学习式惯性里程计基线。

Conclusion: 层级语义可提供可靠的、面向定位的专用校正线索，验证了按误差类型分层利用情境信息的有效性。

Abstract: Smartphone indoor localization requires low-cost, robust positioning across scene transitions and phone-use variations. Pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) enables infrastructure-free deployment but accumulates errors from heading drift, structural transitions, and carrying-mode changes. Existing methods often treat contextual cues as a single event stream or local correction signal, limiting their ability to address distinct localization errors. This paper presents a framework enhanced by hierarchical multi-sensor context recognition. A jointly data- and model-driven recognition model predicts environment, scene, and activity probabilities, which are converted into scene-event and action-context segments. Scene-event segments guide scene-constrained PDR correction through corridor heading constraints, landmark attraction, fixed-lag backtracking, and vertical-transition handling. Action-context segments drive action-aware RoNIN-based position compensation for carrying-mode-dependent drift. Experiments on cross-floor and multi-action trajectories against LiDAR-SLAM references show that the proposed framework outperforms PDR and representative learned inertial odometry baselines, demonstrating that hierarchical semantics provide reliable, localization-specific correction cues.

</details>


### [655] [Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40483)
*Juan Belieni,Ana Carolina Erthal,Eliezer de Souza da Silva,Diego Mesquita*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP)，一种梯度投影方案，使每次遗忘更新限制在先前遗忘集激活子空间的正交补中，从而在序列化遗忘请求下保证一阶非干扰，兼顾遗忘效果与模型效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生命周期内遗忘请求持续发生，但绝大多数遗忘方法不适合迭代移除：连续遗忘时新旧更新相互干扰，新删除可能撤销先前的删除，或沿已被削弱的方向继续退化，导致遗忘效果与效用急剧下降。

Method: 在梯度更新前做正交投影：缓存先前各遗忘集对应的激活子空间，将每次更新限制在其正交补内；每层仅存储低秩基，无需保存历史梯度或旧遗忘集；作为插件可接入任何基于可微损失梯度步的遗忘方法，且不改变其目标函数，并可证明与先前删除保持一阶非干扰。

Result: 在 TOFU 与 RWKU 等标准 LLM 遗忘基准上，COP 在序列请求中保持效用且不削弱遗忘，避免了标准目标的性能崩塌，并比持续学习专用基线遗忘更有效。

Conclusion: 通过正交投影抑制连续更新间干扰，是一种轻量、通用、理论可证的持续遗忘增强方案。

Abstract: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. Experiments on standard LLM unlearning benchmarks (TOFU and RWKU) show that COP preserves utility across sequential requests without weakening forgetting, preventing the collapse of standard objectives and forgetting more effectively than continual-specific baselines.

</details>


### [656] [Implicit Bias of (Stochastic) Gradient Descent on Deep Linear Diagonal Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39717)
*Wiebke Bartolomaeus,Holger Rauhut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将深度线性对角网络的(S)GD迭代刻画为带扰动的随机镜像梯度下降，把隐式偏置与加权ℓ1极小化联系起来，并给出步长的充分条件及其对隐式偏置影响的量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过参数化模型损失存在多重极小元，训练方法与超参选择决定最终解，即隐式偏置现象。已有工作仅针对小初始化下深度线性对角网络的梯度流证明收敛到(近乎)稀疏解，缺乏对更贴近实际的(S)GD迭代在任意层数下的分析。

Method: 把(随机)梯度下降识别为受扰动的(随机)镜像梯度下降(perturbed (stochastic) mirror gradient descent)，在任意层数的深度线性对角网络上进行分析。

Result: 建立了收敛性并刻画了极限解，将其与加权ℓ1极小化相关联；给出关于步长的充分条件，并量化了步长对隐式偏置的影响。

Conclusion: 在任意层数下，将梯度流层面的稀疏隐式偏置结论推广到(S)GD迭代，揭示其本质是带扰动的镜像梯度下降，且步长显式影响隐式偏置。

Abstract: Modern machine learning models are often overparameterized, i.e., have more parameters than training data. This typically implies that the loss function admits multiple minimizers so that training methods (and their hyperparameter choices) have significant influence on the computed solution. We study this so-called implicit bias phenomenon in the context of training deep linear diagonal networks. Previous work has shown that the gradient flow for learning such networks converges to (almost) sparse solutions when initialized small. For an arbitrary number of layers, we extend this analysis to the practically more realistic (stochastic) gradient descent iterations. Our approach identifies (stochastic) gradient descent as a perturbed (stochastic) mirror gradient descent. This allows us to establish convergence and characterize the limiting solution, relating it to weighted $\ell_1$-minimization. Moreover, we provide sufficient conditions on the step sizes and quantify the influence of the step sizes on the implicit bias.

</details>


### [657] [Grounding Predictive Reliability through Masked Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39728)
*Shang Gao,Bernhard Sick,Franz Götz-Hahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MORSE，在掩码表示学习中用跨上下文归一化变异锚定预测均值不确定性，解决NIG证据回归中边际似然无法辨识不确定度分配的语义歧义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NIG证据回归将预测变异分解为数据尺度与预测均值两部分，但边际似然无法识别二者的分配，导致不确定性语义无法与可观测预测行为对应；现有估计器（证据、集成、dropout）缺乏可区分的语义参照。

Method: 在可见上下文受控变化下预测同一隐藏目标，用归一化跨上下文变异充任NIG中边际未识别的因子1/ν，得到"策略相对可观测性方差"；同时用高斯目标学习条件均值与数据尺度，将可观测性估计摊销为单次前向传播。

Result: 在基于解析贝叶斯条件均值构建上下文参照的高斯过程基准上，MORSE在全部九种设置中对数方差误差最低；最接近训练集变异参照的估计器在每个设置中扰动的是模型而非上下文，两种参照实现经验分离。异方差脉冲基准上跨上下文方差随数据增加趋近大样本参照；并在PTB-XL低标签迁移与IMPTC分布内轨迹预测上取得提升。

Conclusion: 以跨上下文变异为锚点为预测均值不确定性提供可观测语义，区分"对可见证据的依赖"与"重采样训练集引起的变异"，且估计开销低，可迁移至多种下游任务。

Abstract: An uncertainty estimate is meaningful only if its semantics can be tied to observable predictive behavior. Normal-Inverse-Gamma (NIG) evidential regression provides a structured decomposition of predictive variability into data-scale and predictive-mean components, but marginal likelihood does not identify their allocation. We address this semantic ambiguity in masked representation learning. MORSE (Masked Observability for Reliable Structured Encoding) predicts the same hidden target under controlled changes in visible context and uses normalized cross-context variation to ground predictive-mean uncertainty, while a Gaussian objective learns the conditional mean and data scale. The normalized variation plays the role of the NIG factor $1/ν$, which the marginal leaves unidentified; this yields a policy-relative observability variance that measures dependence on visible evidence, distinct from variation induced by resampling the training set. On a Gaussian-process benchmark with a contextual reference built from analytic Bayes conditional means, MORSE has the lowest log-variance error among compared evidential, ensemble, and dropout estimators in all nine tested settings, while the estimator closest to training-set variation perturbs the model rather than its context in every setting, so the two references separate the estimators empirically. MORSE amortizes observability estimation into one forward pass per observation state. On a heteroscedastic pulse benchmark, its predictor's cross-context variance approaches a large-sample reference as training data increase. MORSE also improves low-label transfer on PTB-XL and in-distribution trajectory prediction on IMPTC.

</details>


### [658] [Going deep, reaching further: What can Boltzmann machines efficiently represent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39731)
*Tobias Reinhart,Gemma De les Coves*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出通用逼近定理忽略"高效表示"与深度不敏感两大缺陷，且二者相互关联：更深或高阶相互作用的模型具有更大的"高效可达集"。据此给出最大高效可达性的完整刻画，证明DBM最大、RBM次最大、k-body RBM构成层级，并证明浅层模型的高效可达性按相互作用阶数构成无限层级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用逼近定理只说明表示能力的存在性，不关注表示效率，且对深度、阶数等启发式重要性质不敏感，无法解释深度模型在实践中优于浅层模型的观察。作者希望揭示这两个缺陷的内在联系，为"深度带来优势"提供理论基础。

Method: 以"高效可达集"（可被多项式规模模型高效表示的函数集合）作为刻画工具，分三条技术路线：(i) 借助近期关于通用自旋模型的刻画，给出最大高效可达集的完整特征；(ii) 利用自旋模型的计算复杂度界，为三种表示任务建立深/浅模型分离；(iii) 应用通信复杂度下界分析浅层模型，证明按相互作用阶数索引的无限层级。

Result: 证明DBM具有最大高效可达性，RBM为次最大，k-body RBM推广介于二者之间构成层级，尽管三者均为通用逼近器；给出最大高效可达机器模型的完整刻画；在三种表示任务上建立了深层与浅层模型的严格分离；证明浅层模型的高效可达性构成按相互作用阶数索引的无限层级。

Conclusion: 通用性相同并不意味着表示能力等价：模型的高效表示能力随深度与相互作用阶数的增加而严格增强，从而为深度与高阶交互的经验优势提供理论支撑，也表明仅凭通用逼近定理评估模型表达能力是不充分的。

Abstract: While universal approximation theorems theoretically underpin the representation capabilities of machine learning models, they have two shortcomings: They do not focus on efficient representations and they tend to be insensitive to depth and other heuristically important properties. In this work we show that these two shortcomings are intertwined. We prove that machine learning models which are deeper or have higher-order interactions can efficiently represent a larger set of functions, i.e. have larger efficient reach. It follows that deep Boltzmann machines (DBMs) have maximal efficient reach, restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) sub-maximal, and k-body generalizations of RBMs form a hierarchy between the two, even though all are universal. More generally, (i) we provide a full characterization of machine learning models with maximal efficient reach; (ii) we derive separations between deep and shallow models for three representation tasks; and (iii) we prove that the efficient reach of shallow models constitutes an infinite hierarchy indexed by the interaction order. The proofs draw on different methodologies, namely on (i) a recent characterization of universal spin models; (ii) computational complexity bounds for spin models; and (iii) communication complexity bounds applied to shallow models. This work shows that universal machine learning models can strongly differ in their efficient representation capabilities, and provides a theoretical foundation for heuristic observations.

</details>


### [659] [Activation Probes Are Reliable With a Handful of Positive Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39766)
*Riya Tyagi,Stefan Heimersheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在"极稀缺正例 vs 大量负例"的数据体制下，研究激活探针（activation probes）的有效训练策略，发现负例丰富时不对称训练更省正例、LLM 上采样可等效倍增正例、且模型越大正例效率越高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监测先进AI的罕见失准（misalignment）面临数据困境：对齐样本丰富而失准样本极少，需要回答如何在正例仅1–10个、负例上千的条件下高效训练探针。

Method: 在垃圾邮件与诚实性检测任务上测试激活探针，比较"多负例非平衡训练"与"平衡训练"在1–10个正例下的正例样本效率；引入LLM上采样扩充正例并考察其数量效应；跨模型规模检验样本效率的缩放趋势。

Result: 小正例数（1–10）下，多负例训练平均比平衡训练更省正例；LLM上采样带来约等效于"真实正例翻倍"的性能提升，但过度上采样会损害性能；存在正向缩放趋势，大模型探针的正例效率更高。

Conclusion: 应利用大量可得的负例来放大稀有但关键的失准样本信号，而非追求正负平衡。

Abstract: Efforts to monitor advanced AI for rare misalignments face a data challenge: abundant aligned examples but only a handful of misaligned ones. We test activation probes in this "few vs. thousands" regime on spam and honesty detection tasks. For our tasks, training with many negative examples is on average more positive-sample-efficient than balanced training for small numbers (1-10) of positive samples. We also find that LLM upsampling can provide a performance boost equivalent to roughly doubling the number of real positive samples, though excessive upsampling hurts performance. Finally, we show a positive scaling trend, where larger models are more positive-sample-efficient to probe. Our findings suggest we should leverage the large number of negative samples available to amplify the signal from rare but critical misalignment examples.

</details>


### [660] [Multi-output LSTM soft sensors for industrial anaerobic co-digestion using LSTM-beta-VAE generative data augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39768)
*Rohit Murali,Benaissa Dekhici,Tao Chen,Dongda Zhang,Michael Short*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LSTM-β-VAE生成式数据增强框架结合多输出LSTM软测量，实现厌氧消化稳定性指标的同步鲁棒预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厌氧消化（AD）需实时监测pH、挥发性有机酸/碱缓冲比及产气量等稳定性指标以防过程失效。机理模型（如ADM1）参数多、计算昂贵且难标定；现有数据驱动方法多为单输出、仅关注产率，且工业数据稀疏、偏向稳态，导致标准算法难以识别失稳转变。

Method: 构建LSTM-beta-VAE生成式数据增强框架，从一年全尺寸装置数据中合成物理合理的失稳转变序列以填补特征空间稀疏区；再以多输出LSTM（MO-LSTM）软测量在增强数据上同步回归多个目标。

Result: 基线评估显示随机森林、XGBoost及未增强LSTM因数据稀缺无法识别失稳转变；经增强训练后，MO-LSTM对所有目标实现稳健的同步估计。

Conclusion: 该方法缓解数据稀疏问题，为工业生物过程的机理-数据混合建模及早期预警软测量奠定基础。

Abstract: Anaerobic digestion (AD) requires close monitoring of key process variables, including pH, the ratio of volatile organic acids to alkaline buffer capacity and biogas production, to maintain biological stability and prevent process failure. While mechanistic frameworks such as the Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1 are highly parameterised, computationally expensive, and difficult to calibrate for real-time applications, data-driven Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks offer a potentially more adaptable alternative. However, current data-driven approaches in AD are predominantly limited to single-output architectures that focus solely on production yields, as opposed to simultaneous prediction of vital stability indicators. Furthermore, industrial AD datasets are typically sparse and skewed toward steady-state operations. Baseline evaluations demonstrated this scarcity prevents standard algorithms (Random Forest, XGBoost) and unaugmented LSTMs from recognising the transition to unstable operations, resulting in poor estimation of stability indicators. To overcome these challenges, this study proposes a novel generative data augmentation framework using an LSTM-beta-Variational Autoencoder coupled with a multi-output LSTM (MO-LSTM) soft sensor. By synthesising physically valid sequences of these transitions to unstable operations from one year of full-scale plant data, the method safely populates sparse regions of the feature space. Trained on this augmented dataset, the MO-LSTM achieved robust simultaneous estimation across all targets. This approach mitigates data sparsity, providing a basis for hybrid mechanistic-data-driven modelling and early-warning soft sensors in industrial bioprocesses.

</details>


### [661] [Quantum-Inspired Convolutional Networks for High-Resolution Pseudo-Label Generation from Multimodal Earth Observation Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39773)
*Abhishek Singh,Giovanni Cuozzo,Alexander Jacob,Claudia Notarnicola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种量子卷积编码器-解码器网络，以Sentinel-1 SAR与Sentinel-2多光谱影像为输入，在仅有低分辨率MODIS标签的弱监督条件下生成高分辨率伪标签，用于地表覆盖制图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率标注稀缺且获取成本高，多模态对地观测数据的地表覆盖精细制图仍具挑战；现有方法难以在弱监督条件下充分挖掘异构传感器数据的细尺度语义结构。

Method: 构建量子启发的卷积编码器-解码器框架，采用量子卷积块增强特征提取与跨传感器融合；训练分两阶段，先以重建分支进行自监督表示学习，再引入低分辨率MODIS标签监督，生成高分辨率伪标签。

Result: 在DFC2020数据集（Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2、低分辨率MODIS标签及高分辨率参考图）上开展实验；通过测试集分类指标评估伪标签，结果显示所提方法生成的空间连贯性与类别一致性优于经典基线。

Conclusion: 量子启发深度学习可有效改善低标注遥感场景下的标签生成，为高质量地表覆盖产品提供可扩展的技术路径。

Abstract: Accurate land-cover mapping from multimodal Earth observation (EO) data remains a challenge in regions where high-resolution annotations are scarce or costly to obtain. This work introduces a quantum convolutional encoder-decoder network for pseudo-label generation using Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, guided only by coarse MODIS-derived land-cover maps. The proposed framework uses quantum-inspired convolutional blocks to enhance feature extraction and cross-sensor fusion, enabling the model to infer a fine-scale semantic structure from heterogeneous inputs. Experiments were conducted on the DFC2020 dataset, which provides a quadruple of Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 multispectral, low-resolution MODIS labels and high-resolution reference land-cover maps. The proposed training framework first learns a robust representation of multimodal inputs through the reconstruction branch before any supervision from low-resolution labels is applied. This self-supervised stage enables the model to capture a fine-scale spectral-spatial structure, which is then used to generate high-resolution pseudo-labels. These pseudo-labels are subsequently evaluated through classification metrics on the test data, demonstrating that the proposed approach produces more spatially coherent and class-consistent compared to classical baselines. The results highlight the potential of quantum-inspired deep learning to improve label generation in low-annotation remote sensing scenarios, offering a scalable path towards high-quality land-cover products for EO applications.

</details>


### [662] [Surface Conditioning for Zero-Shot Multivariate Correction in a Marine Biogeochemistry Emulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39777)
*Gabriela Martínez Balbontín,Anastase Charantonis,Dominique Béréziat,Stefano Ciavatta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于海洋生物地球化学神经代理模型的轻量级偏差校正方法：利用自编码器的FiLM条件通路作为观测注入点，推理时以卫星叶绿素a替换模拟表层场，实现向整个水柱及其他变量传播的校正效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统过程模型的偏差校正依赖迭代数据同化与显式协方差建模，成本高、实现复杂，亟需轻量级替代方案。

Method: 构建生物地球化学神经仿真器；其解码器通过Feature-wise Linear Modulation（FiLM）以表层变量为条件（原用于引入物理边界强迫）；将FiLM输入扩展至表层叶绿素a，并在推理阶段用卫星观测替换模拟表层场，使校正经条件通路传播。

Result: 表层替换沿水柱向下传播，在所有深度上均改善与深度分辨观测的一致性；校正效应亦扩散至其他输出变量，且扩散模式与预期营养级关系相符。

Conclusion: FiLM条件通路可作为一种隐式观测注入机制，为过程模型偏差校正提供无需显式协方差建模的轻量替代方案，并具备物理—生态一致性的传播特性。

Abstract: Bias correction in process-based models usually means iterative data assimilation with explicit covariance modelling. We propose a lightweight alternative based on a neural emulator of marine biogeochemistry (BGC), showing that the conditioning pathway of its autoencoder can serve as an observation injection point. The decoder is conditioned on surface variables via Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), originally designed to incorporate physical boundary forcings. We extend these inputs to include surface chlorophyll-a and replace the simulated field with satellite observations at inference time. The surface substitution propagates through the water column, improving agreement with depth-resolved observations at all depths, and spreads to other output variables in a pattern consistent with expected trophic relationships.

</details>


### [663] [AI at a Turning Point: From ChatGPT through Neural Networks to Neuromorphic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39796)
*Volker Kempe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该专著以可读而数学严谨的方式系统阐述脉冲神经网络（SNN）的原理、编码、学习与硬件，并与Transformer式连接主义AI在原理、优雅性与计算代价上作对照，主张混合系统是可行路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连接主义AI能耗巨大（GW至TW·h量级），而人脑仅约20W；神经形态计算以低功耗与自组织机制构成挑战，但缺乏对其编码、学习与硬件设计的系统化、数学严谨的入门性梳理。

Method: 以ChatGPT文本生成模块为范例剖析Transformer原理与计算成本；系统讲解SNN的编码（群体编码、时间编码）、局部学习规则（STDP）、事件驱动计算、以时间承载信息、Neural Engineering Framework网络设计方法，并以人体神经系统机制为参照；同时综述从Loihi 2到商用边缘神经形态处理器的硬件。

Result: 形成一份贯通"原理—学习—网络设计—硬件"的SNN知识体系，并对两类AI在原理优雅性与能耗代价上给出可比分析；论证SNN并非替代现有AI，而可通过混合系统在各自优势场景部署。

Conclusion: SNN以局部学习、事件驱动与时间编码扩展而非取代连接主义AI；混合系统与传统及神经形态AI的互补互促是主要发展前景。

Abstract: The tension between the established technologies of connectionist AI and their neuromorphic challengers is attracting growing attention, above all because of the enormous energy demand of the former and the low power consumption of the latter. Developing and running large AI models consumes gigawatt- to terawatt-hours of energy, while the human brain operates on a continuous 20 watts. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) counter this energy demand with a frugal approach and bring elements of self-organization into the methodological repertoire of AI: local learning instead of global error backpropagation, event-driven computing, and time as a carrier of information. They do not replace today's AI but extend it; in hybrid systems each approach can be deployed where its strengths lie. This monograph explains the field in a generally accessible yet mathematically rigorous way. Using the text-generation module of ChatGPT as an example, the principle, elegance, and computational cost of transformer-based AI are presented and compared with the coding, learning, and network-design methods of SNNs. Throughout, relevant mechanisms of the human nervous system serve as model and reference point. Topics include spike-timing-dependent plasticity, population and temporal coding, the Neural Engineering Framework, neuromorphic hardware from Loihi 2 to commercial edge processors, and the prospects for classical and neuromorphic AI to complement and extend each other.

</details>


### [664] [Optimal Contextual Pricing in Non-Stationary Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39803)
*Yiding Feng,Alireza Rezaeimoghadam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究非平稳环境下带上下文的动态定价：价值对上下文线性、含时变隐特征且总变差预算为V，仅观测二元购买反馈。对同质上下文提出二分搜索+下包络定价+周期性/不一致触发的确定性算法，达O((√(TV)+1)logT)；对异质上下文提出多尺度浅定价算法，在多个变化尺度上维护松弛可行集与包围椭球，达O((d²+d^{3/2}√(TV))log²T)，与下界Ω(√(TV)+loglogT)在log因子内匹配，实现近乎最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文动态定价研究多假设环境平稳，而实际买家价值随不可观测特征变化而漂移；同时反馈仅为二元购买信号，信息受限。作者希望在已知总变差预算V的非平稳设定下，刻画动态遗憾并确定确定性算法的可达到的近乎最优速率，尤其处理异质上下文下特征变化带来的几何困难。

Method: 1) 同质上下文：确定性算法，组合二分搜索式探索、下包络（lower-envelope）定价，以及周期性重启与不一致触发重启，以适应特征漂移。2) 异质上下文：识别出“小特征变化使松弛可行集狭窄但远离当前特征向量”的几何困难，提出多尺度浅定价（multiscale shallow-pricing）算法，在多个变化尺度上维护松弛可行集与包围椭球；较大尺度提供可靠的定位证书，最小活跃尺度决定利用价格。

Result: 同质上下文下动态遗憾为O((√(TV)+1)logT)。d维异质上下文下动态遗憾为O((d²+d^{3/2}√(TV))log²T)。对固定d，两者均与下界Ω(√(TV)+loglogT)在T的对数因子内匹配，表明对每个V∈[0,T]（含平稳情形）在确定性算法类中近乎最优。

Conclusion: 在非平稳、仅二元反馈、总变差预算受限的上下文动态定价中，基于重启/多尺度可行集维护的确定性算法可达到随√(TV)增长的动态遗憾，并在对数因子内逼近下界，说明平稳与非平稳情形可在统一框架下实现近乎最优的确定性定价策略。

Abstract: We study contextual dynamic pricing in a non-stationary environment. In each round, a seller observes a buyer's context, posts a price, and receives only binary purchase feedback. The buyer's value is linear in the context and an unobserved feature vector that may change over time, subject to a known total variation budget $V$. We measure dynamic regret against the first-best benchmark that extracts each buyer's full value.
  For identical contexts, we develop a deterministic algorithm that combines binary-search exploration, lower-envelope pricing, and periodic and inconsistency-triggered restarts. It achieves regret $O((\sqrt{TV}+1)\log T)$. With heterogeneous contexts, a new geometric difficulty arises: small feature changes can leave a relaxed feasible set narrow but far from the current feature vector. We address this difficulty through a multiscale shallow-pricing algorithm that maintains relaxed feasible sets and enclosing ellipsoids at several variation scales. Larger scales provide reliable localization certificates, while the smallest active scale determines the exploitation price. The algorithm achieves dynamic regret $O((d^2+d^{3/2}\sqrt{TV})\log^2 T)$, where $d$ is the context dimension. For fixed $d$, both guarantees match the lower bound $Ω(\sqrt{TV}+\log\log T)$ up to logarithmic factors in $T$, establishing near-optimality among deterministic algorithms for every $V\in[0,T]$, including the stationary case.

</details>


### [665] [Possibility-based Inference: A Deterministic Framework for Robust and Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39821)
*Seyedfakhredin Musavishavazi,Maryam Alipour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于可能性的对比预测等级（possibility-based contrastive grade of prediction），作为潜在后验方法的替代方案，用于参数估计与模型选择，以更灵活地表示不确定与冲突信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键系统部署中需要可靠的不确定性量化，而贝叶斯推断存在数据精度与性能-精度权衡问题，且高专用化深度学习架构易产生过度自信但不可信的预测。

Method: 受模糊集理论影响、以贝叶斯统计为基础，构建可能性表示框架；以可能性对比预测等级替代传统隐后验的概率表示，用于参数估计（近似）与模型选择，形成系统化的数据挖掘方法。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据；声称该框架能更灵活刻画不确定与潜在冲突信息，并提供系统化建模路径，缓解过度自信、不合理解预测的问题。

Conclusion: 在概率框架之外引入可能性表示可作为贝叶斯推断的有效补充，提升安全关键场景下不确定性量化的可靠性；但需注意摘要缺乏定量验证与与基线方法的实证对比。

Abstract: Decision-making under uncertainty remains a key issue in Machine Learning (ML), particularly in the deployment of safety-critical systems, where reliable quantification of system behavior is essential for evaluating behavioral impacts and strengthening confidence in ML models. This contribution, influenced by fuzzy set theory and grounded in Bayesian statistics, addresses challenges related to data precision and the performance-accuracy trade-off in Bayesian inference (BI). To this end, we introduce a possibility-based contrastive grade of prediction as an alternative quantification method to existing latent posterior-based approaches for parameter estimation (approximation) and model selection. Unlike conventional Bayesian inference, which represents uncertainty within the probabilistic framework, the proposed model adopts a possibility-based representation that allows uncertain and potentially conflicting information to be characterized more flexibly. Rather than focusing on isolated aspects of a problem, the resulting mathematical framework provides a systematic approach to data mining while mitigating overly confident, yet implausible predictions generated by highly specialized deep learning architectures.

</details>


### [666] [SHPRR: An Algorithm for Pure Exploration under Constrained Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39837)
*Georgina Nouli,Flore Sentenac,Maximilian Schiffer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将纯探索中的最优臂识别（BAI）置于"相对可信基线的后悔成本预算"约束下，揭示序贯减半（Sequential Halving, SH）探索的后悔成本随阶段递减的结构性规律，并据此提出SHPRR算法，将后悔预算前置分配以提升识别最优臂的概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统BAI以采样次数衡量实验成本，但许多实际运营场景中已存在一个可信的基线策略，关键在于探索相对基线的代价（即后悔）。通用资源约束下的纯探索研究未刻画后悔的特殊结构——采样更优的臂相对基线代价更低，因此需要一个专门针对后悔预算的BAI框架。

Method: 在固定采样视界与后悔预算两种设定下研究BAI。理论上证明序贯减半各阶段的探索后悔成本随阶段推进而递减，从而导出更优的最优臂识别概率保证；据此设计Sequential Halving with Proportional Regret Rationing（SHPRR），按比例将后悔预算前置，在剩余臂较多时投入更多探索。

Result: 理论上获得改进的最优臂识别概率保证；合成数据与真实数据实验表明，SHPRR在最优臂识别性能上优于均匀后悔预算分配及现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 后悔成本的结构性递减为预算分配提供了理论依据，预算前置式的比例分配能有效提升后悔预算约束下的BAI效率，验证了从"样本成本"到"相对基线后悔成本"视角转换的价值。

Abstract: Best Arm Identification (BAI) conventionally measures the cost of experimentation by the number of samples collected. In many operational settings, however, the cost of exploration relative to a trusted baseline already in place is equally important. We study BAI under both a fixed sampling horizon and a regret budget. Unlike generic resources considered in constrained pure exploration, regret has a distinctive structure: sampling better arms is less costly relative to the baseline. We theoretically show that the regret cost of exploration decreases across the phases of Sequential Halving, a widely used pure-exploration algorithm. This observation yields improved guarantees on the probability of identifying the best arm and motivates a more effective allocation of the regret budget. We propose Sequential Halving with Proportional Regret Rationing (SHPRR), which front-loads the regret budget to allow more exploration when many arms remain. Experiments on synthetic and real-world instances show that SHPRR improves best-arm identification performance over uniform regret allocation and existing baselines.

</details>


### [667] [LLM-Integrated Bayesian State Space Models for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20952)
*Sungjun Cho,Changho Shin,Suenggwan Jo,Xinya Yan,Shourjo Aditya Chaudhuri,Frederic Sala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LBS：将大语言模型与贝叶斯状态空间模型结合的概率框架，实现数值与文本联合的多模态时序预测，支持灵活回看/预测窗口与不确定性量化，在TextTimeCorpus上较SOTA提升13.20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界预测需融合结构化时间序列与非结构化文本，但现有方法受限于固定输入/输出窗口，且无法建模或量化不确定性。

Method: 提出LBS框架，含两部分：(1) SSM骨干从潜状态捕获时序动态，数值与文本观测均由该潜状态生成；(2) 适配预训练LLM，编码文本输入以做后验状态估计，并解码与潜轨迹一致的文本预测。

Result: TextTimeCorpus基准上较此前SOTA提升13.20%，并为每次预测提供可读的文本摘要。

Conclusion: 首次统一LLM与SSM进行数值与文本联合预测，为多模态时序推理提供新基础；SSM的归纳偏置带来灵活窗口、原理性不确定性量化与更优时序泛化。

Abstract: Forecasting in the real world requires integrating structured time-series data with unstructured textual information, but existing methods are architecturally limited by fixed input/output horizons and are unable to model or quantify uncertainty. We address this challenge by introducing LLM-integrated Bayesian State space models (LBS), a novel probabilistic framework for multimodal temporal forecasting. At a high level, LBS consists of two components: (1) a state space model (SSM) backbone that captures the temporal dynamics of latent states from which both numerical and textual observations are generated and (2) a pretrained large language model (LLM) that is adapted to encode textual inputs for posterior state estimation and decode textual forecasts consistent with the latent trajectory. This design enables flexible lookback and forecast windows, principled uncertainty quantification, and improved temporal generalization thanks to the well-suited inductive bias of SSMs toward modeling dynamical systems. Experiments on the TextTimeCorpus benchmark demonstrate that LBS improves the previous state-of-the-art by 13.20% while providing human-readable summaries of each forecast. Our work is the first to unify LLMs and SSMs for joint numerical and textual prediction, offering a novel foundation for multimodal temporal reasoning.

</details>


### [668] [Exploring the Potential of Symbolic Regression in Precision Livestock Farming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39839)
*Elisabeth Mayrhuber,Maciej Oczak,Michael Iwersen,David Brunner,Viktoria Dorfer,Stephan Winkler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究利用母猪加速度传感器数据，采用无监督活动度变化检测筑巢行为，并用符号回归预测距分娩剩余时间，在可解释性与精度上均优于SVR与ANN等黑箱模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确预测母猪分娩时间对农场管理至关重要：既能避免仔猪被压死，又能避免过早限位栏关养以保障母猪福利。传统机器学习模型存在"黑箱"问题，缺乏可解释性，难以支撑农场决策。

Method: 研究分两阶段：①筑巢行为检测，仅基于母猪活动水平变化，不使用机器学习；②剩余分娩时间预测，采用符号回归这一"开箱"建模技术生成可解释数学公式，并与支持向量回归（SVR）、人工神经网络（ANN）等黑箱模型在可解释性和性能上进行对比。数据来源于母猪分娩前后的加速度传感器。

Result: 筑巢行为检测在180头母猪中有166头可行，其中149头在分娩前48小时内成功检测。符号回归预测分娩时间的平均绝对误差为9.28小时，在性能与可解释性两方面均优于SVR和ANN等黑箱模型。

Conclusion: 可解释人工智能（尤其是符号回归）能在精准畜牧中同时提供可解释结果与有竞争力的性能，为分娩预测与农场管理决策提供透明依据。

Abstract: The ability to predict farrowing time in pigs is crucial for optimal farm management and ensuring piglet survival. This study investigates the potential of explainable artificial intelligence for precision livestock farming, focusing on acceleration sensor data from sows around the time of farrowing. Accurately predicting farrowing allows farmers to balance both, piglet safety by avoiding piglet crushing events and the mother sow's welfare, by avoiding early crating. Traditional machine learning models often lack interpretability (``closed-box'' problem). Explainable artificial intelligence offers a solution by revealing the decision-making processes within the models. This work is split into two stages. First the detection of nest building behaviour and second the prediction of the remaining time to farrowing. The nest building detection was possible for 166 out of 180 sows and successful within 48 hours before farrowing for 149 sows. The nest building detection is purely based on the change of a sow's activity level and uses no machine learning techniques. Further, this study utilizes symbolic regression, an open-box modelling technique that generates interpretable mathematical formulas, to predict the remaining time until the onset of farrowing. The results are compared with closed-box models, like support vector regression and artificial neural networks, for both explainability and performance. Notably, symbolic regression achieved a mean absolute error of 9.28 hours for the time-to-farrowing prediction, outperforming the closed-box models in terms of performance and interpretability. This research demonstrates that explainable artificial intelligence, specifically symbolic regression, can offer both interpretable results and competitive performance in precision livestock farming.

</details>


### [669] [DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39852)
*Lie Li,Wen Li,Junxiao Shen,Jindong Gu,Guosheng Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DWISE：面向扩散大模型（dLLM）服务的去噪工作量感知调度引擎，按剩余工作量（预填充与去噪共享的块级单位）调度请求，并用提示级轻量预测器加首轮隐状态单次校正来估计未知去噪负载，在SGLang上实现平均5.4倍（最高14.9倍）端到端时延降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有dLLM服务框架沿用AR模型的调度策略（FCFS准入与前缀优先），与dLLM的并行去噪特性不匹配：FCFS忽视dLLM请求解码成本的强异质性与到达时不可知性，造成严重队头阻塞；前缀优先会使仅运行提示的轮次令批次大量空闲，显著降低效率。

Method: 提出DWISE调度引擎：（1）以预填充与去噪共享的块级单位度量剩余工作量，使两阶段可同轮混跑并按剩余工作量排序；（2）针对未知去噪负载，准入阶段用基于提示的轻量预测器，随后利用首个去噪轮次的隐状态做一次精化（该隐状态含提示中缺失的模型特定信息，且无需额外模型执行）；（3）在SGLang中实现。

Result: 在SGLang中实现，覆盖三个dLLM家族的五个模型，在突发型负载下评测：相比SGLang基线，平均端到端时延降低5.4倍，最高达14.9倍，同时保持任务准确率。

Conclusion: AR导向的调度策略不适配dLLM；以去噪工作量为核心的统一块级调度与轻量两阶段负载预测，可在不损精度的前提下大幅提升dLLM服务效率。代码将公开。

Abstract: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

</details>


### [670] [Turing LLM Post-Training: Calibrated Distillation and Efficient Dynamic-MoE Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39876)
*Yue He,Jiahui Hu,Shaman Tang,Hua Zhou,Qiman Wu,Menglin Li,Yizhao Wang,Yuheng Zhang,Da Zhu,Zhou Wang,Anhua Liu,Hanlin Chen,Mingyuan Wang,Rui Xin,Yuhua Wei,Shuang Su,Siqi Liu,Kai Yang,Weichao Huang,Hang Zhang,Honggou Yang,Xianming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出校准式多教师on-policy蒸馏（C-MOPD）与高效执行路径，用于动态路由MoE模型的后训练专家整合；在Turing-20B-A2B上集成得分0.9988、保留每域≥90.16%专家增益，PPU配置下整合步时从398.7s降至139.3s（2.86×）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态路由MoE的后训练需整合多个独立优化的专家，同时保持整合过程高效，现有方法在专家能力保留与整合开销间难以兼顾。

Method: C-MOPD：在局部Top-K支撑上匹配所选教师，采用教师级损失归一化与裁剪；执行路径采用post-capacity bounded-width dispatch、final-route replay及异步rollout-训练重叠。

Result: 四域归一化集成得分0.9988，每域保留≥90.16%专家增益；K=32时完整校准目标0.9962，无校准0.9724，无裁剪0.9834；8K响应上限下四个数学/代码基准均值85.92（Qwen3-8B 80.33、SFT 74.21），12项更广指标中10项优于SFT；PPU配置步时398.7→139.3s，2.86×加速。

Conclusion: 结果体现完整训练与执行框架的整体效果而非单一组件，证明可实现强专家整合与更高效整合，但归因需谨慎。

Abstract: We study post-training for dynamically routed mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, focusing on integrating independently optimized specialists while keeping consolidation efficient. Our approach combines calibrated multi-teacher on-policy distillation (C-MOPD), which matches each selected teacher on a local Top-$K$ support with teacher-wise loss normalization and clipping, with an execution path that uses post-capacity bounded-width dispatch, final-route replay, and asynchronous rollout--training overlap. On Turing-20B-A2B, the selected model achieves a four-domain normalized integration score of 0.9988 and retains at least 90.16\% of the measured specialist gain in every domain. At matched $K=32$, the full calibration objective scores 0.9962, compared with 0.9724 without calibration and 0.9834 without clipping. At a matched 8K response cap, the model exceeds both shared SFT and Qwen3-8B on all four reasoning-enabled mathematics and code benchmarks (unweighted mean: 85.92, versus 80.33 for Qwen3-8B and 74.21 for SFT), and improves over SFT on ten of twelve broader evaluation metrics. In a PPU-based profile, the combined execution configuration reduces consolidation step time from 398.7 to 139.3 seconds, an observed 2.86$\times$ speedup over serial execution. These results demonstrate strong specialist integration alongside more efficient consolidation, while reflecting the complete training and execution framework rather than any single component.

</details>


### [671] [TACFormer: Transformer-Based Generative Model for Target-Conditioned De Novo PROTAC Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39891)
*Yossra Gharbi,Rocío Mercado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TACFormer是一个基于Transformer的生成模型，以ESM-2编码的靶蛋白（POI）序列为条件，实现靶点感知的全分子PROTAC从头设计，生成新颖多样的PROTAC并呈现靶点依赖的化学空间偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PROTAC生成方法多将设计简化为linker生成问题，warhead与E3配体预先固定，限制了化学空间探索，且POI信息仅以预定义warhead隐式体现，未将蛋白层面信息作为显式条件信号。

Method: 采用GPT风格分子解码器，以预训练ESM-2对POI序列的表征作为条件输入，实现端到端的靶点感知全分子生成，而非仅生成linker。

Result: 生成的PROTAC高度新颖且化学多样；在不同靶点条件下，生成分子的化学空间呈一致的POI依赖偏移，特异性条件下生成的分子优先富集于留出数据集中相应POI关联的化学邻域，同时可外推至新化学型。

Conclusion: 通过将生物学上下文原生整合进生成过程，TACFormer推动PROTAC设计走向更以生物学为导向的降解剂化学空间探索。

Abstract: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) represents a fundamental shift in drug discovery, moving beyond traditional target inhibition toward the event-driven removal of disease-causing proteins. A prominent strategy for TPD is the use of proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs), heterobifunctional molecules that selectively route a protein of interest (POI) to the ubiquitin-proteasome system for degradation. While PROTAC design still relies heavily on trial-and-error synthesis and experimental testing, deep generative models offer a promising means to explore PROTAC chemical space in silico and generate novel molecules. However, many existing generative methods formulate PROTAC design primarily as a linker-generation problem, with POI-binding (warhead) and E3-ligase-binding components fixed in advance. This restricts exploration of the full PROTAC chemical space and often leaves the POI implicit through the predefined warhead, rather than using protein-level information as an explicit conditioning signal during generation. To address these limitations, we propose TACFormer: a transformer-based generative model for target-aware de novo PROTAC design. The model conditions a GPT-style molecular decoder on pretrained ESM-2 representations of POI sequences, allowing POI-level information to steer full-molecule generation. Our results show that TACFormer generates highly novel and chemically diverse PROTACs while showing consistent POI-dependent shifts in generated chemical space. In particular, molecules generated under specific target conditions preferentially populate chemical neighborhoods associated with POIs in the held-out dataset, while extrapolating to novel chemotypes. By natively integrating biological context into the generative process, TACFormer moves PROTAC design toward a more biology-informed exploration of degrader chemical space.

</details>


### [672] [Data-driven Random-feature Approximation of Koopman Generators of Nonlinear Continuous-time Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39897)
*Ana Čukarska,Maximilian Gollwitzer,Viola Muning Li,Vladyslav Fediukov,Zahra Monfared,Felix Dietrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种数据驱动的随机特征方法，为gEDMD等Galerkin近似构造简约且有效的函数字典以逼近Koopman生成元，实现连续时间动力系统的高效学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Koopman形式化通过作用于函数空间的线性算子表示动力系统，但数值逼近Koopman算子/生成元时，如何选取有效的有限维"字典"（函数空间表示）是实际难点。现有数据无关方法效率与精度受限。

Method: 针对连续时间系统，聚焦Koopman生成元而非Koopman算子；构建数据驱动的随机特征表示，用于gEDMD等Galerkin近似，避免迭代优化。

Result: 实验表明方法在预测与系统分析任务上精度高且快于迭代优化；理论上证明了向量场及所得轨迹的收敛性，给出gEDMD近似生成半群的一般收敛判据，并构造反例说明gEDMD一般不能保持指数有界性。

Conclusion: 该工作推进了从数据高效学习连续时间动力学的前沿，朝基于Koopman框架的可解释、数学稳健建模迈进。

Abstract: Learning continuous-time dynamical systems from data is an active area of research.
