Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"对抗性选择域的域泛化"问题：学习器在任意未见目标域上的表现需逼近与观测源域证据一致的"最差"假设。在假设类存在对所有 k 个源域误差均小的"通用"预测器的条件下，刻画了样本复杂度（至多对数因子）：当把竞争目标从"100%源域表现良好"放松为"99%源域表现良好"时，样本复杂度从 Ω(dk) 显著降至 O(d)。将该洞察用于元分布设定可改进已知上界；并证明目标域少量标注样本无法改善源域最坏情况样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据丰富机构训练的预测模型在部署到新人群时常失效。作者希望利用数据丰富医院的通用知识，为数据稀缺的农村人群构建临床诊断与决策算法，因此需要一种对目标域分布不作假设、且对抗性选择域的域泛化理论框架。

Method: 形式化"对抗性选择域的域泛化"目标：要求在任意未见目标域上近似达到与源域证据一致的最差假设的性能；仅假设假设类中存在对全部 k 个源域误差均小的通用预测器。以 VC 维 d 为复杂度度量，刻画样本复杂度并分析对学习目标的小幅松弛（99% 而非 100% 源域）带来的影响，同时推广到源域按"分布的分布"采样的元分布设定，并研究目标域标注数据访问的作用。

Result: 样本复杂度由 Ω(dk) 显著降低为 O(d)（在 99% 松弛下，至多相差对数因子）；在元分布设定下得到对已知样本复杂度上界的相应改进；发现目标域的小规模标注样本不能改善源域最坏情况下的样本复杂度。

Conclusion: 对学习目标的轻微松弛可带来样本复杂度的量级级下降，说明"几乎所有源域表现良好"的通用预测器已足以支撑对未见目标域的鲁棒泛化；而目标域少量标注数据在最坏情况下无助于降低源域样本需求，提示数据稀缺场景应着力于源域覆盖与松弛型保证。

Abstract: Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations. Motivated by the goal of building clinical diagnosis and decision-making algorithms for data-scarce rural populations using the general knowledge learned from data-rich hospitals, we formulate the fundamental question of \emph{domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains}, which asks a learner to perform on any unseen target domain nearly as well as the worst hypothesis consistent with the evidence from the observed source domains.
  Assuming only that the hypothesis class contains a "universal" predictor with small error on all $k$ source domains, we characterize the sample complexity of this objective up to logarithmic factors. Letting $d$ denote the VC dimension of the hypothesis class, we find, somewhat surprisingly, that the sample complexity reduces significantly from $Ω(dk)$ to $O(d)$ under a small relaxation of the learning goal in which, roughly speaking, we allow the learned model to compete with hypotheses that perform well on 99% instead of 100% of the source domains. By applying this insight to the meta-distributional setting, in which source domains are selected according to a distribution on distributions, we obtain a corresponding improvement over known sample complexity upper bounds. We also study the effect of data access to the target domain and show that a small labeled sample from the target domain does not improve the worst-case sample complexity on the source domains.

</details>


### [709] [Nonlinear Dynamical Systems as Scalable and Efficient Physical Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40471)
*Tyler King,Magnus Saebo,Jeremie Laydevant,Haoting Zhen,Maxwell G. Anderson,Tatsuhiro Onodera,Peter L. McMahon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过在物理非线性动力系统中引入现代ML训练实践（模型压缩、Mixer式架构、预训练+知识蒸馏），仿真中MNIST达99.2%、CIFAR-10达86.4%（92.2%），并估算推理能效可较数字电子网络提升数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理神经网络（被训练执行ML推理的物理系统）因潜在高能效被视为加速器候选，但既往研究报告的推理精度显著低于传统数字神经网络，限制了其实际价值。本文旨在缩小这一精度差距，同时保留能效优势。

Method: 仿真研究：将现代ML训练实践应用于基于非线性动力系统的候选物理神经网络，包括模型压缩；并设计受MLP-Mixer启发的参数高效架构，以单个动力系统作为核心构建模块；进一步采用预训练与知识蒸馏；最后对推理能效与速度做粗略（back-of-the-envelope）估算。

Result: MNIST手写数字识别精度最高达99.2%；CIFAR-10图像分类最高86.4%（经预训练与知识蒸馏达92.2%），而同一系统不使用Mixer架构时仅64%；Mixer方法在可训练参数比基线少5倍以上的情况下取得该精度；能效与速度估算显示相较数字电子神经网络可能存在数个数量级提升。

Conclusion: 现代ML训练实践与架构设计可显著提升物理神经网络的推理精度，使其接近甚至达到数字网络水平；参数高效架构在减少参数的同时提升性能；结合物理动力系统的高能效特性，物理神经网络有望在推理能效上实现数量级优势。

Abstract: The rapid growth in the size of state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) models has led to increasing compute demands, spurring the development of energy-efficient hardware accelerators. Physical systems trained to perform ML inference, known as physical neural networks, have been proposed as accelerators in part because of their potential to be highly energy efficient. However, the ML inference accuracies reported in most investigations of physical neural networks have been substantially below the state of the art for conventional digital neural networks. In this work, we show in simulation studies that by applying modern ML training practices, including model compression, various candidate physical neural networks based on nonlinear dynamical systems can achieve accuracies as high as 99.2% on MNIST handwritten-digit recognition. We also show for one dynamical system that using it as the core building block of a parameter-efficient ML architecture inspired by MLP-Mixers enables accuracies of up to 86.4% on CIFAR-10 image classification (92.2% with pretraining and knowledge distillation), compared with 64% for the same system without the mixer architecture. The mixer approach achieved its accuracy while using $>5\times$ fewer trainable parameters than the baseline. Finally, we present back-of-the-envelope estimates for inference energy efficiency and speed when using an example physical dynamical system, suggesting that orders of magnitude improvements may be possible over digital-electronic neural networks.

</details>


### [710] [The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40485)
*Lngel Kyo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示幂律协方差下归一化一阶优化器在低秩矩阵感知中的失效源于数值精度墙，并给出临界指数预测公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Burer–Monteiro 地形无虚假局部极小，但除以范数的归一化优化器在临界指数 s* 之上停滞，原因未被解释。

Method: 分析真值处最小非规范期望 Hessian 特征值的渐近尺度 V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}，与优化器有效分母地板 ε_O 比较，推导噪声淹没稀有方向梯度的判据，并构造含度量相关检测滞后 δ_O 的边界公式，用 Adam 在四个配置上标定 δ 后冻结。

Result: 公式在 16 格留出网格（V∈{64,…,512}×D∈{4,…,32}）上以 0.45 的误差预测 Adam 启动点，可区分固定 VD 对，并区分分母精度墙与条件数墙、符号量化墙。

Conclusion: 归一化优化器的高 s 失效主要是数值精度墙而非优化地形问题；公式在 D=2 失效（有限 D 谱交叉），且 ε₀=10^{-8} 以下饱和于动力学地板。

Abstract: In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $Σ= \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$ leaves the Burer--Monteiro landscape free of spurious local minima, yet division-normalised first-order optimizers stall above a critical exponent $s^\ast$. We trace this failure to a numerical precision wall. At the ground truth, the smallest non-gauge expected Hessian eigenvalue scales at leading order as $V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}$. When this curvature drops below the effective denominator floor $ε_O$ of optimizer $O$, normalisation noise overwhelms rare-direction gradients, yielding the leading-order boundary $s^\ast_O(V, D) = [\log(1/ε_O) - \log V]/\log(VD) + δ_O$, where $δ_O$ is a metric-dependent detection lag. With $δ_{\mathrm{Adam}}$ calibrated on four configurations and frozen, this formula predicts Adam's onset within $0.45$ across all 16 cells of a held-out grid ($V \in \{64,128,256,512\} \times D \in \{4,8,16,32\}$), separates fixed-$VD$ pairs, and distinguishes denominator-precision walls from conditioning and sign-quantisation walls. The approximation fails at $D = 2$, reflects a finite-$D$ spectral crossover, and saturates below $\varepsilon_0 = 10^{-8}$ at a dynamical floor.

</details>


### [711] [Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40499)
*Kirill Korolev,Artur Goldman,Timofei Gritsaev,Tigran Ramazyan,Nikita Morozov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于反射扩散的约束域重要采样方法，在有界凸域上构建满足域约束的扩散提议分布学习框架，实现无偏的高维积分估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准拟蒙特卡洛方法不针对被积函数调整采样点，而有效的重要性采样需要能刻画被积函数集中性的提议分布；现有学习式扩散采样器在 R^d 上表述，无法满足 x∈D 的域约束。

Method: 用构造上始终停留于 D 的反射动力学构建提议分布：反射扩散将目标分布逐步变换为 D 上的均匀分布，训练神经网络得分模型反向该过程；利用反射扩散的测度变换公式得到无额外边界项的训练目标及 Z 的无偏重要性采样估计；对被积函数非光滑情形，基于反射前的 Gaussian 提议密度推导 REINFORCE 训练梯度估计，无需计算反射转移密度或对 r 求导。

Result: 在大量合成目标与真实问题上验证，方法表现强劲，且随问题维度与蒙特卡洛点数呈现良好扩展性。

Conclusion: 反射扩散为约束域上的高维积分提供了可行且可扩展的自适应重要采样框架，兼具无偏估计与对非光滑被积函数的鲁棒训练能力。

Abstract: We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains. Given a non-negative integrand $r$, the goal is to estimate $Z=\int_{D}r(x)\,\mathrm dx$ on $D\subset\mathbb R^d$. Standard Quasi-Monte Carlo does not adapt its evaluation points to the integrand, while effective importance sampling requires a proposal that captures its concentration. Learned diffusion samplers can supply such a proposal, but existing methods are formulated on $\mathbb R^d$ and do not respect the domain constraint $x\in D$. We instead build the proposal from reflected dynamics that stay in $D$ by construction. A reflected diffusion progressively transforms the target distribution toward the uniform distribution on $D$, and a neural score model is trained to reverse this process. A change-of-measure formula for reflected diffusions yields a training objective without additional boundary terms and an unbiased importance-sampling estimator of $Z$. For non-smooth integrands, where reparameterization gradients may be undefined or uninformative, we derive a REINFORCE estimator of the training gradient using Gaussian proposal densities before reflection, without evaluating reflected transition densities or differentiating $r$. We evaluate on numerous synthetic targets and real-world problems, demonstrating strong performance of the proposed method, as well as favorable scaling with the dimension of the problem and the number of points used for the Monte Carlo estimate.

</details>


### [712] [Machine Learning-Based Detection of Mobile Money Scan Messages in Ghana: A Comparative Evaluation of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Randon Forest Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40544)
*Ibrahim Salifu,Muhaisin Tiyumba Nantogmah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个有监督机器学习流程，用于分类加纳移动货币（MoMo）诈骗与合法短信，在220条标注语料上比较朴素贝叶斯、线性SVM与随机森林，经典可解释分类器达到高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoMo是加纳主流零售支付渠道，交易规模与活跃账户激增，同时SMS/USSD社会工程诈骗（冒充运营商、代理、亲属或监管者骗取PIN、身份信息或资金）显著上升，需要低成本、可部署的短信诈骗过滤方案。

Method: 构建含220条短信、覆盖18个诈骗与合法子类别的标注语料；先对金额、电话号码、USSD代码做领域特定归一化，再进行unigram+bigram的TF-IDF向量化；采用分层五折交叉验证与20%留出测试集，训练并评估Multinomial Naive Bayes、线性SVM、随机Forest，指标包括accuracy、precision、recall、F1、MCC与AUC-ROC。

Result: 留出集上朴素贝叶斯与线性SVM的accuracy、F1、AUC均为1.00；交叉验证平均准确率分别为96.6%(±3.3)、94.9%(±4.6)、92.0%(±4.2)。判别性n-gram显示诈骗语含催促性祈使（"send""claim""please send"）与PIN索取（"PIN""pincode"），合法信息含确认与警示用语（"balance""successful""do not share"）。

Conclusion: 可解释经典分类器在结构化MoMo诈骗文本上精度高，适合低资源、端侧（运营商或手机端）过滤；但需注意小规模模板化语料带来的性能天花板效应，未来应构建更大规模、自然、多语言的语料。

Abstract: Mobile money (MoMo) is Ghana's preferred retail payment channel, recording GHC518.4 billion in transactions in December 2025 and over 26.7 million active accounts (Graphic Online, 2026). This growth has coincided with increased social-engineering fraud over Short Message Service (SMS) and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), where fraudsters impersonate network operators, agents, relatives, or regulators to obtain personal identification numbers (PINs), identity data, or funds. We present a supervised machine-learning pipeline for classifying scam and legitimate Ghanaian MoMo SMS messages using a labelled corpus of 220 messages across 18 scam and legitimate subcategories. Domain-specific normalisation of currency amounts, phone numbers, and USSD codes preceded TF-IDF vectorisation of unigrams and bigrams. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation and a 20% held-out test set, we trained and evaluated Multinomial Naive Bayes, linear support vector machine (SVM), and Random Forest classifiers using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). Held-out accuracy, F1, and AUC were 1.00 for Naive Bayes and linear SVM; cross-validated accuracy averaged 96.6% (+/-3.3), 94.9% (+/-4.6), and 92.0% (+/-4.2). Discriminative n-grams reflected imperative urgency ("send," "claim," "please send") and PIN solicitation ("PIN," "pincode"); legitimate messages featured confirmatory and cautionary language ("balance," "successful," "do not share"). Findings are contextualised in Sub-Saharan African SMS fraud detection, small template-based corpus ceiling effects, and a pathway toward larger naturalistic multilingual corpora. Interpretable classical classifiers achieve high accuracy on structured MoMo scam text and suit carrier- or handset-level filtering in low-resource, on-device settings.

</details>


### [713] [Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40564)
*Yuda Song,Alvin Zhang,Fahim Tajwar,Daman Arora,Jeff Schneider,Daniel Khashabi,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,J. Andrew Bagnell,Aarti Singh,Andrea Zanette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出"统一训练"（unified training）：将预训练、中训练、SFT与RL各阶段统一为对模型生成目标分布的极大似然拟合，从而把分阶段训练特例化为"在何时、用何种数据、以何种配比训练"的问题，并在单一训练器中混合静态数据与RL生成数据进行实证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础模型训练按预训练—中训练—SFT—RL分阶段进行，数据与算法均随之切换，形成人为的算法割裂；作者希望证明这种分离并非本质必要，建立统一的似然训练范式以弥合数学原理、训练基础设施与能力发展三者的联系。

Method: 通过将合适的RL目标推导为对模型自生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，使各阶段归入统一的似然训练算法；在该视角下，训练生命周期转化为数据选择、配比与时序调度问题，传统分阶段训练成为其特例；并实现统一训练系统，在单一训练器内混合静态数据与在线RL生成。

Result: 在受控实验与真实实验中，统一训练改善了精度—算力权衡（accuracy-compute tradeoff）与任务覆盖度，同时在保持更广泛通用能力的前提下，为持续学习提供了更强的初始化起点。

Conclusion: 算法层面的阶段分离并非基础模型训练的根本属性；统一训练为"基础模型训练科学"奠定基础，将数学原理、训练基础设施与模型能力发展相衔接。

Abstract: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. We instantiate this framework in a unified training system that mixes static data and RL generations within a single trainer. Across controlled and real-world experiments, unified training improves the accuracy-compute tradeoff and task coverage while preserving broader capabilities, and provides a stronger starting point for continual learning. This work lays the groundwork for a unified science of foundation-model training, connecting mathematical principles, training infrastructure, and the development of model capabilities.

</details>


### [714] [An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40618)
*Samson Gourevitch,Yazid Janati,Eric Moulines,Eric P. Xing,Alain Durmus,Giacomo Zanella*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出指数残差流（ERF），为离散扩散模型构造了类似连续扩散概率流ODE的确定性演化，可复现原扩散过程的边缘分布，并支持一致性蒸馏加速采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散模型中存在概率流ODE，能以确定性方式复现各时刻边缘分布，是加速采样与一致性蒸馏的基础；但离散扩散模型缺乏类似的确定性对应物，本文探究该形式是否存在并给出肯定答案。

Method: 为每个token与位置的离散状态引入一个连续残差变量，残差按分段定义的ODE确定性演化，其向量场依赖当前离散状态以及给定扩散模型的前向、后向速率矩阵；当某残差归零时离散状态发生跳转。作者证明该构造保持原扩散的边缘分布，并给出实用的离散化采样器实现，针对掩码扩散与均匀扩散进行专门化。

Result: 理论上证明ERF保持原扩散模型的边缘分布；实验上ERF的确定性轨迹支持一致性蒸馏，在包括代码生成与文本生成等多项基准上相较先前方法取得经验性提升。

Conclusion: ERF为离散扩散提供了类概率流ODE的确定性框架，统一了加速采样与一致性蒸馏的基础，并在多类生成任务上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation. In this paper we address the question whether an analogous formulation exists for discrete diffusion models and answer it affirmatively by introducing exponential residual flows (ERFs). Our framework augments the discrete state with a continuous residual variable for each token and position. These residuals evolve deterministically according to piecewise-defined ODEs whose vector fields depend on the current discrete state and the forward and backward rate matrices of the prescribed diffusion model. The discrete state changes whenever a residual reaches zero. We prove that this construction preserves the marginals of the original diffusion. We derive a practical discretization of our sampler and specialize it to masked and uniform diffusion. The deterministic trajectories of ERFs support consistency distillation and yield empirical improvements over previous approaches across a variety of benchmarks including code and text generation tasks.

</details>


### [715] [world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40637)
*Tobias Schmidt,Rodrigo Gonzalez Laiz,Krisztián Szuppinger,Steffen Schneider*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 world2vec，一种仅用观测与动作（无需奖励信息）学习机制性世界模型的方法，学到对真实系统长时程忠实复现的隐动力学，参数比 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2、LeWM 至少少一个数量级，在像素连续控制中达 SOTA，并在 71 个吸引子基准上实现准确系统辨识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型虽能取得较强控制性能，却未必忠实刻画环境动力学，从而限制了其用于机制可解释性与科学发现的潜力；作者希望世界模型既可控又可作为忠实机理模型。

Method: world2vec：直接从观测与动作（不使用奖励信息）学习潜在动力学，目标是在长预测时程上忠实复现真实系统；模型规模显著精简（参数比 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2、LeWM 少至少一个数量级）。

Result: 在基于像素的连续控制环境中取得 SOTA 控制性能；在 71 个吸引子构成的基准上实现准确的系统辨识，表明该方法能支撑科学发现。

Conclusion: 忠实于动力学的机制性世界模型可以在更小参数下同时实现强控制与可辨识的系统建模，说明世界模型可作为科学发现的工具。

Abstract: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM. This enables state of the art performance in controlling continuous environments from pixels and accurate system identification across a benchmark of 71 attractors, demonstrating how world models are amenable to scientific discovery.

</details>


### [716] [Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40649)
*Nicolas Dufour,Elouan Gardès,Amil Dravid,Patrick Pérez,Loic Landrieu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 复现Neural Thickets效果，但证明收益源于输出多样性+验证集选择+投票（PSV框架），而非权重空间几何结构；只需扰动logits即可匹配全权扰动的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战Neural Thickets假说：质疑预训练模型位于权重空间中任务专家密集邻域、随机高斯的扰动可"挖掘"专家的几何解释是否为必要解释。

Method: (1) 消融实验：仅扰动单一decoder block；或完全冻结模型，仅在输出logits上加随机bias。(2) 提出Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV)通用框架：生成扰动预测器→在小验证集上筛选高性能成员→聚合预测。(3) 一阶分析说明小权重扰动主要通过诱导的logit偏移起作用。(4) 将分析扩展至视觉领域（含对地观测）的域偏移场景。

Result: 单block扰动即可恢复大部分增益；冻结模型+随机logit bias在多数推理任务上匹配或超越全权扰动。视觉域偏移下Logit PSV显著提升性能，全权扰动无额外收益。

Conclusion: Neural Thickets的增益可由输出多样性、选择与投票解释，并与采样、self-consistency、验证器引导选择等推理时方法相通；Logit PSV提供一种简单、免训练的全冻结替代方案。

Abstract: The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions.
  This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.

</details>


### [717] [Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40654)
*Moshe Shenfeld,Eliad Tsfadia,Katrina Ligett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 propose-filter-release (PFR) 框架：先用友好度 (friendliness) 分数私密地过滤掉不契合数据的记录，再将仅需满足 friendly-DP 的发布机制升级为标准差分隐私，且无需噪声按单条记录最坏影响缩放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有差分隐私机制通常将噪声缩放到单条记录的最坏情况影响，导致少数异常记录主导噪声规模，即使其余数据本可允许很小的噪声。若能先移除这些记录即可恢复小噪声尺度，但移除过程本身必须满足隐私保护。

Method: PFR 分三步：propose（提出候选过滤）、filter（私密筛选，仅依赖衡量记录与数据契合程度的凹 friendliness 分数）、release（用 friendly-DP 机制发布，即仅当被改动记录契合剩余数据时才保证隐私）。对给定分数与发布机制，在关于记录数的公开条件下即可保证标准差分隐私，构成与 propose-test-release 类似的通用隐私原语，FriendlyCore 可视为其一种实现。

Result: 在标量统计、主子空间估计、用户直方图的 KL 散度、图的有效电阻以及处理规则选择等多个任务上实例化 PFR，展示其通用性。

Conclusion: PFR 提供了一个通用的、可组合的隐私原语：只需提供凹友好度分数和 friendly-DP 发布机制，即可获得标准差分隐私保证，并能避免异常记录主导噪声的问题。

Abstract: An estimator can be accurate and stable on typical data, yet sensitive to a few possible records. Differentially private mechanisms commonly scale their noise to the worst-case influence of a single record, which lets these records dictate the noise even when the remaining data would allow far less. Removing them first would restore the smaller scale, but the removal must itself be private.
  We introduce \emph{propose-filter-release} (PFR), which, by privately filtering its input, turns a mechanism that protects the addition or removal of a typical record, one that fits the remaining data, into one that is differentially private in the standard sense, on every input. Using our novel filtering step, PFR requires only a concave friendliness score, which measures how well a record fits a dataset, and a release mechanism that is friendly-DP, that is, private when the changed record fits the remaining data. For every such score and release mechanism, it guarantees differential privacy under public conditions on the number of records, so it is a general privacy primitive, comparable to propose-test-release, and FriendlyCore can be viewed as one of its implementations.
  We illustrate the generality of PFR by instantiating it for scalar statistics, principal subspace estimation, the KL divergence of user histograms, the effective resistances of a graph, and treatment-rule selection.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [718] [Search-Guided Reasoning Trace Curation for Verilog Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37706)
*Matthew DeLorenzo,Kevin Tieu,Prithwish Jana,Piyush Jha,Dileep Kalathil,Vijay Ganesh,Jeyavijayan Rajendran*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出MCTS-SFT框架，用验证器引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索为Verilog生成模型筛选结构化推理轨迹；其中Plan-MCTS在紧凑硬件设计计划空间上搜索并保留计划作为监督目标，显著提升功能正确率与pass@10，同时缩短生成长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Verilog生成模型的训练管线多蒸馏自然语言推理链，其中间设计决策结构弱，且仅依据最终RTL正确性进行筛选，导致监督信号与中间决策脱节、数据低效且token开销大。

Method: 将轨迹构造建模为中间推理状态上的搜索问题，用MCTS把完整Verilog仿真的功能反馈回传到早期设计决策；提出Plan-MCTS，在显式表示接口、时序、状态、行为与更新规则的紧凑设计计划上进行搜索；并研究plan-preserving监督，将搜索得到的目标计划保留在下游SFT目标中。

Result: Plan-MCTS功能轨迹产出率最高，正确轨迹84.2%，对比一次性结构化规划81.9%、无引导树搜索82.0%；在相同轨迹与Verilog输出下，保留搜索计划使pass@10从52.56%升至57.7%；6000条轨迹研究中，MCTS筛选监督较全响应CoT蒸馏在VerilogEval-v2上pass@10最高提升3.7点，生成长度约减少50%。

Conclusion: 结构化硬件规划、验证器引导搜索与显式中间状态监督三者互补，可构建更有效且更token高效的Verilog生成训练数据；中间决策的表示形式实质影响下游学习效果。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved Verilog generation. However, most training pipelines distill natural-language reasoning traces whose intermediate design decisions are weakly structured and are primarily selected according to the correctness of the final generated RTL. We present MCTS-SFT, a verifier-guided framework for curating reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of Verilog generation models. MCTS-SFT formulates trace construction as search over intermediate reasoning states and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to propagate functional feedback from complete Verilog rollouts to earlier design decisions. Within this framework, we introduce Plan-MCTS, which searches over compact hardware-design plans that explicitly represent interfaces, timing, state, behavior, and update rules. We further study plan-preserving supervision, in which the searched structured state is retained as part of the downstream SFT target. Our experiments find that Plan-MCTS achieves the highest functional trace yield, with 84.2% correct traces compared with 81.9% for one-shot structured planning and 82.0% for unguided tree exploration. For identical Plan-MCTS trajectories and Verilog outputs, retaining the explicit searched plan during SFT raises pass@10 from 52.56% to 57.7%, demonstrating that the representation of intermediate design decisions materially affects downstream learning. In a separate 6,000-trace study, MCTS-curated supervision improves pass@10 over full-response chain-of-thought distillation by up to 3.7 points while reducing downstream generation length by approximately 50% on VerilogEval-v2. These results demonstrate that structured hardware planning, verifier-guided search, and explicit intermediate-state supervision provide complementary mechanisms for constructing more effective and token-efficient training data for Verilog generation.

</details>


### [719] [zkDuel: Characterizing SumCheck Prover Kernels across GPU Programming Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37710)
*Samarth Narang,Alhad Daftardar,Brandon Reagen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: zkDuel基准在H100/A100上对比SumCheck的Triton与CUDA实现，发现随域宽度增大两者性能差距由3.5x收敛至1.4x；用tl.reduce替换原始块归约后Triton中位kernel时间与CUDA差距缩至8%以内，表明Python嵌入式DSL在密码学宽度下可接近CUDA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SumCheck是零知识证明的核心prover原语，其表并行结构天然适合GPU，但随着有限域位宽增大（32→256位）运算强度急剧上升，可能改变编程模型的成本权衡。作者因此研究这种shift如何影响"用Triton而非CUDA编写SumCheck"的代价，并填补缺乏跨域宽度、跨后端的系统性基准空白。

Method: 构建zkDuel基准：提供25个源自zkPHIRE的约束及诊断多项式的Triton与CUDA配对实现，覆盖32/64/128/256位素数域，采用独立CPU参考实现校验与跨后端checksum门控；在NVIDIA H100与A100上进行800组配置测评，并结合profiling定位性能瓶颈，实施两项优化（以tl.reduce替换原始块归约、专用点插值）。

Result: H100上800组配置中758组checksum匹配完成。CUDA相对Triton的中位优势从32位时的3.5x降至256位时的1.4x，且Triton在19个大表配置上更快；A100上同样收敛（4.4x→1.6x）。Profiling显示小域差距主要来自host launch开销与Triton原始块归约中的冗余模加，其相对成本随多limb Montgomery运算增加而衰减。替换为tl.reduce后，两块GPU上Triton中位kernel时间均进入CUDA的8%以内；专用点插值使256位求值kernel提升1.55–1.75x。

Conclusion: 在密码学宽度下，Python嵌入式DSL（Triton）能够接近CUDA性能，缩小了编程易用性与性能之间的权衡；但最大规模完全展开的约束仍暴露编译器可扩展性瓶颈，是后续改进方向。

Abstract: SumCheck is a central prover primitive in zero-knowledge proofs, exposing table-parallel work that maps naturally to GPUs but becomes increasingly arithmetic-intensive as finite fields widen. We study how this shift affects the cost of programming SumCheck in Triton rather than CUDA. Our benchmark, zkDuel, provides matched implementations of 25 zkPHIRE-derived constraints alongside diagnostic polynomials, covering 32-, 64-, 128-, and 256-bit prime fields, with independent CPU-reference validation and cross-backend checksum gating. Of 800 configurations attempted on an NVIDIA H100, 758 complete with matching checksums. CUDA's median advantage over Triton falls from 3.5x at 32 bits to 1.4x at 256 bits, and Triton is faster on 19 large-table configurations; the same convergence appears on an A100, where the gap falls from 4.4x to 1.6x. Profiling shows that the small-field gap largely reflects host launch overhead and redundant modular additions in Triton's original block reduction, whose relative costs diminish as multi-limb Montgomery work grows. Replacing that reduction with tl.reduce brings Triton's median kernel time within 8% of CUDA on both GPUs, while specialized point interpolation improves 256-bit evaluation kernels by 1.55-1.75x. At cryptographic widths, these results show that a Python-embedded DSL can approach CUDA performance, although the largest fully unrolled constraints still expose compiler-scalability limits.

</details>


### [720] [The Code Behind the Layout: AI Agents for Analog Layout Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38426)
*Minxing Chu,Anhang Li,Martins Atilla,Ruichen Qi,Mehdi Saligane*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 在SKY130上对gLayout的对照实验表明，让LLM直接绘制版图的主要障碍是时间与token成本，而生成器框架的核心价值在于可复用性：经校验的原语使每次模型编辑易于检查，参数化使单次编辑可在整个布局族上评估；因此让模型在所属族生成器源码上开发并以最可能失败的族成员测试编辑、再用族测试结果监督本地模型蒸馏，是最高效的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟版图设计仍以手工为主、难以自动化。gLayout等生成器框架将版图表达为程序，但编写生成器仍需专家投入。前沿LLM已能从设计意图直接绘制版图几何，由此引出实际问题：若模型能自行绘制版图，生成器框架还有何贡献？把模型接入生成器框架是否优于从零直接绘制？

Method: 在SKY130工艺上基于gLayout开展受控实验，对比"模型直接绘制版图"与"模型在生成器框架上编写/修改生成器代码"两条路线，分析时间与token开销、编辑可验证性及可复用性，并进一步用族测试结果作为监督信号训练本地模型。

Result: 直接绘制版图的主要瓶颈是时间与token成本；生成器框架的主要优势是复用性——经校验的原语使每次编辑的检查范围小，参数化使单次编辑可在整个布局族上评估。族测试结果可作为监督训练本地模型，以远低的推理成本学到跨族成立的编辑。

Conclusion: 模型最有效的用法是：从设计意图所属族的生成器源码出发进行开发，并在最可能失败的族成员上测试每次编辑，从而让一次经校验的改动改进该生成器产出的所有版图；同时可用族测试监督本地模型，以更低推理成本获得可跨族泛化的编辑能力。

Abstract: Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate. Generator frameworks such as gLayout express layouts as programs, producing layouts from parameterized, design-rule-aware generators; however, writing such generators still takes expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) could now write generator code, and frontier models can even draw layout geometry from design intent. This raises a practical question: if a model can draw the layout itself, what does a generator framework still contribute, and is applying these models to a generator framework better than having them draw a layout from scratch? Through controlled experiments on gLayout in SKY130, we find that the main obstacle to drawing a layout directly is its time and token cost, and that the main advantage of a model building on a generator framework is reusability. Its verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check, and its parameters allow a single edit to be evaluated across an entire family of layouts. Accordingly, a model is most effective when it develops the layout from the generator source of the family that the design intent belongs to, and tests each edit on the family members most likely to fail, so that one verified change improves every layout the generator produces. The results of these family tests can then serve as supervision for a local model, which learns edits that hold across the family at a fraction of the inference cost.

</details>


### [721] [GI-RTL-Fuzz: Grammar-Informed RTL Generation with LLMs for End-to-End Differential Simulator Fuzzing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38489)
*Ziyue Zheng,Zhi Qu,Yangdi Lyu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: GI-RTL-Fuzz：一种语法引导、由LLM生成RTL测试用例的模糊测试框架，利用BNF文法覆盖信息指导生成并配合差分测试，发现主流Verilog仿真器的大量未知不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL仿真器是现代IC设计流程的基础工具，但作为复杂软件常含严重缺陷，会影响仿真正确性；需系统性压力测试手段。

Method: 提出GI-RTL-Fuzz框架：用LLM生成高质量RTL测试用例，并以Backus-Naur Form（BNF）文法覆盖信息引导LLM生成过程，以探索复杂、少被测试的语言特性；再通过在不同RTL仿真器间进行差分测试检测不一致。

Result: 在主流Verilog仿真器的lint流程与仿真结果中发现大量此前未知的不一致（bug）。

Conclusion: 将文法覆盖反馈与LLM生成、差分测试结合，可有效对RTL仿真器进行压力测试并暴露深层缺陷。

Abstract: Register-Transfer Level (RTL) simulators are fundamental to modern IC design workflows, yet like any complex software, they frequently contain critical bugs that compromise simulation accuracy. To systematically stress-test these tools, we introduce GI-RTL-Fuzz, a grammar-informed fuzzing framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate high-quality RTL test cases. Our key innovation is guiding the LLM's generation process using Backus-Naur Form (BNF) grammar coverage information, enabling the exploration of complex and rarely-tested language features. By performing differential testing against different RTL simulators, our framework uncovered a significant number of previously unknown inconsistencies in both the linting process and simulation results of major Verilog simulators.

</details>


### [722] [Exploring and optimizing the Vivado Flow on large FPGA designs: A Practical Analysis of Strategies and Their Impact on Timing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38575)
*Kachkachi Nor Eddine*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文针对Vivado设计中时序收敛配置难以选择的问题，通过两个测试设计对比不同时序指令与策略在时序、面积和运行时间上的表现，以确定最高效的实现流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FPGA设计（尤其高性能应用）中实现时序收敛至关重要，Vivado虽提供多种优化策略，但针对具体项目选取最佳配置仍具挑战性。

Method: 考察Vivado的各类时序指令（timing directives）与策略（strategies），以两个测试用例——NQR谱仪SoC-FPGA与高能物理粒子探测器数字读出ASIC原型——为平台，对比不同策略与配置在时序、面积和运行时间上的效果。

Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明通过两个案例对不同策略与配置进行了比较，用以识别最高效流程。

Conclusion: 通过跨设计案例的系统对比，可筛选出在时序、面积与运行时间综合权衡下最高效的Vivado实现流程，为时序收敛配置选择提供实践依据。

Abstract: Achieving timing closure in FPGA designs is crucial, especially for high-performance applications. The Vivado Design Suite offers several strategies for optimization, but finding the best configuration for a given project remains challenging. This paper explores the various Vivado's timing directives and strategies to improve performance across timing, area, and runtime. Through two test-case designs, an NQR spectrometer SoC-FPGA and a digital readout ASIC prototype for high energy physics particle detector's, different strategies and configurations are compared to identify the most efficient flow.

</details>


### [723] [IMPACT: Constraint-Aware Search for Imperfectly Factorized Accelerator Mappings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39040)
*Konstantinos Stavrakakis,Ilgaz Er,Theofilos Spyrou,Dimitrios Stavrakakis,Stephan Wong,Georgi Gaydadjiev,Said Hamdioui*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: IMPACT：将遗传算法与约束感知修复算子结合，在完整映射空间搜索DNN加速器张量算子映射，在灵活型与存内计算(CIM)加速器上均超越现有映射器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN加速器效率取决于张量运算到硬件的映射（分块、排序、并行化），该空间组合爆炸。现有映射器要么只搜索部分空间而漏掉最优映射，要么全空间随机采样但多数映射违反硬件约束，导致搜索效率低。

Method: 提出IMPACT映射器：搜索完整映射空间，采用遗传算法配合约束感知修复算子，将每个不可行映射转化为可行映射而非直接丢弃，从而在有约束条件下高效探索全空间。

Result: 在灵活型加速器上，IMPACT在全部DeepBench负载的EDP、延迟和能耗上优于现有最优映射器；在约束严格的CIM加速器上，跨五个网络相比最强先前映射器EDP降低66%、延迟降低47%、能耗降低18%，并与手工专家映射相当。

Conclusion: IMPACT能在灵活与高度受限的加速器上自动找到高效映射，并将开源发布。

Abstract: The efficiency of Deep Neural Network (DNN) accelerators depends on how each tensor operation is mapped onto the hardware. A mapping specifies how the computation is tiled across the memory hierarchy, ordered, and parallelized across the processing elements. These choices form a combinatorially large search space, where efficient mappings are hard to find. Most violate hardware constraints, and most remaining mappings underutilize the hardware. Existing mappers either search only part of this space to keep the search tractable, excluding the most efficient mappings, or sample the full space randomly, so most mappings they evaluate are infeasible. We present IMPACT, a mapper that searches the full space. IMPACT pairs a genetic algorithm with a constraint-aware repair operator that converts each infeasible mapping into a feasible one instead of discarding it. On a flexible accelerator, IMPACT outperforms state-of-the-art mappers in EDP, latency, and energy on every DeepBench workload. On a compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerator, whose constraints leave few mappings feasible, it reduces EDP by 66%, latency by 47%, and energy by 18% over the strongest prior mapper across five networks, and rivals hand-crafted expert mappings. Across flexible and highly constrained accelerators, IMPACT finds efficient mappings automatically. IMPACT will be released as open source.

</details>


### [724] [Energy-Efficient FPGA Implementation of an End-to-End Cosine-Domain CNN Using High-Level Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39268)
*Sana Fatima,Ab Al-Hadi Ab Rahman,Ibrahim Yousef Alshareef,Farhad Khodadadi,Nuzhat Khan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该文提出端到端余弦域CNN（CD-CNN）架构，基于HLS在FPGA上实现，用实值DCT域特征提取替代复数谱运算，在MNIST与ASCII数据集上以更低资源实现更高吞吐与能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规CNN计算开销大，难以部署于低功耗边缘AI设备；全谱傅里叶域CNN（FD-CNN）涉及复数运算与频谱层间逆变换，代价较高。

Method: 提出端到端CD-CNN：以实值DCT域表示完成中间特征提取，规避复数算术和频谱层间的中间逆变换；采用高层综合（HLS）在Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA上实现，并在相同网络与实现约束下与全谱FD-CNN对比。

Result: MNIST与94类ASCII数据集实验显示归一化资源利用率降低、推理吞吐提升；能效达112.91 frames/J（MNIST）和101.27 frames/J（ASCII），分别为全谱FD-CNN的1.51倍与2.76倍；相比此前GPU版全谱CD-CNN能效提升12.96倍。

Conclusion: 实值DCT域谱处理在能效上具备优势，适用于低功耗边缘AI部署。

Abstract: The computational cost of conventional Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) limits their deployment in low-power devices for high-speed edge AI applications. This paper presents an end-to-end cosine-domain CNN (CD-CNN) architecture for energy-efficient FPGA inference using high-level synthesis (HLS). The proposed architecture performs intermediate feature extraction using real-valued DCT-domain representations, avoiding complex-valued arithmetic and intermediate inverse transforms between spectral layers. The design is implemented on a Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA and evaluated against a fully spectral Fourier-domain CNN (FD-CNN) under consistent network and implementation constraints. Experiments on the MNIST and 94-class ASCII datasets show that the CD-CNN reduces normalized resource utilization and improves inference throughput on both datasets. Its energy efficiency reaches 112.91 frames/J for MNIST and 101.27 frames/J for ASCII, corresponding to improvements of $1.51\times$ and $2.76\times$, respectively, over the fully spectral FD-CNN architecture. Furthermore, compared to the previous GPU-based fully spectral CD-CNN implementation, the proposed end-to-end FPGA implementation improves energy efficiency by $12.96\times$. These results demonstrate the potential of real-valued spectral processing in the DCT domain for energy-efficient edge AI deployment.

</details>


### [725] [Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39380)
*Yi Ding,Li Shang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 论文提出 Formulaic 流程：由语言模型智能体撰写优化问题的数学表述，交由求解器在表述内优化，并通过验证与测量检验假设与结果；智能体从计算图逐步细化到芯片，墙松弛通过为约束软件的硬件上限定价来搜索芯片设计。在 GB10 上智能体生成的模板运行 Qwen3-8B 层比 SGLang 快 1.075 倍；Ventus 仿真中联合设计将最坏情形周期降至基准的 0.428（纯软件为 0.934）；五步 GEMM 细化链中复用证明使检查提速 2.51 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 基础设施按层设计虽便于管理，却在优化开始前就固定了可考虑的选择范围，使需要芯片与软件协同变化的收益被排除在表述之外；智能体的提案本身无法证明设计正确或最优，故需重新划分智能体、求解器与验证的角色。

Method: 将工作分解：智能体撰写表述，数学求解器在表述内优化，验证与测量检验假设与结果。智能体从计算图向芯片逐步细化问题，每步为模板（一族程序及其正确性条件）；墙松弛通过为约束软件的硬件上限定价来搜索芯片。

Result: GB10 上智能体模板运行完整 Qwen3-8B 层比 SGLang 快 1.075×；Ventus 仿真中联合设计将 Qwen2.5-0.5B 最坏情形周期降至参考的 0.428，纯软件为 0.934；五步 GEMM 细化链中重用证明使检查快 2.51×。

Conclusion: 本文为初步探索，以多个独立研究而非单一端到端运行呈现，表明"智能体表述—求解器优化—验证测量"的分工可在跨层协同设计中获得收益。

Abstract: AI infrastructure, the chips and software that train and serve AI models, is designed in layers. Layers make the system manageable, but they also fix which choices an optimizer can consider. Gains that need the chip and its software to change together are excluded before optimization begins: the formulation leaves them out. Language-model agents make it possible to revisit these boundaries, but an agent's proposal cannot show by itself that a design is correct or optimal. We present Formulaic, a flow that divides the work. The agent writes the formulation, a mathematical solver optimizes within it, and verification and measurement check its assumptions and results. The agent refines the problem step by step, from the computation graph toward the chip. Each step is a template: a family of programs with the conditions under which they are correct. Wall relaxation searches the chip by pricing the hardware limits that bind the software. This paper takes a first step, through separate studies rather than one end-to-end run. On NVIDIA GB10, templates the agent wrote run complete Qwen3-8B layers $1.075\times$ faster than SGLang. In a simulated Ventus GPU study, joint design cuts the worst-scenario cycles of Qwen2.5-0.5B to 0.428 of the reference, against 0.934 for software alone. On a five-step GEMM refinement chain, reusing proofs makes checking $2.51\times$ faster.

</details>


### [726] [OPERA: OPamp Design by an Expert-Taught Reasoning Agent, from Specifications to Layout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39395)
*Vishal Saxena,Soumyajit Mandal*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出OPERA：一个通用的LLM智能体，在开源工具链下完成CMOS运放从规格到后仿签核的全流程设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟电路从规格到签核版图通常需要大量人工迭代；已有LLM智能体仅通过优化器循环调整器件尺寸，且止步于原理图阶段，未覆盖版图与寄生提取。

Method: 由设计者向智能体传授gm/ID方法学（将规格映射为跨导与最小电流、按器件角色从查表选gm/ID、用方程定尺寸，仅保留少量旋钮搜索，设计可解释）；随后智能体学习gLayout框架与版图实践，编写可复用的版图生成器，在设计者设定的门控节点上闭合版图与提取环路。

Result: 在SKY130工艺下设计了共享constant-gm偏置及六种运放（5T、折叠共源共栅、套筒OTA；Miller、折叠共源共栅、套筒两级），目标为fun≥50 MHz、PM≥60°、SR=25 V/μs（1 pF负载）、最低直流增益30–60 dB。六个版图均DRC干净、LVS匹配，提取网表在全部15个PVT角满足所有指标（fun≥53.7 MHz、PM≥62.1°、SR≥27.9 V/μs）。

Conclusion: 通用LLM智能体结合专家传授的方法学与工具，可端到端完成模拟运放的版图级签核设计；基准网表已在AMPICBench开源发布。

Abstract: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. In SKY130, the agent designed a shared constant-gm bias and six opamps (5T, folded-cascode and telescopic OTAs; Miller, folded-cascode and telescopic two-stage) for fun >= 50 MHz, PM >= 60 degrees, SR 25 V/μs into 1 pF and a minimum dc gain of 30 to 60 dB. All six layouts are DRC-clean and LVS-matched, and their extracted netlists meet every target at all 15 PVT corners ( fun >= 53.7 MHz, PM >= 62.1 degrees, SR >= 27.9 V/μs). The benchmark netlists are released at https://github.com/AMPICLab/AMPICBench.

</details>


### [727] [Energy-Efficient Memristor Accelerator for Depression Detection with a CNN-LSTM Hybrid Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39420)
*Jiaqi Liu,Yun Yu,Fenglin Xi,Shenjian Zhang,Shenghao Liao,Wenze Zheng,Mingxuan Hu,Yangbin Chen,Xinhong Chen,Chun Zhao*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种统一的 ReRAM 存内计算加速器，用于抑郁症早期筛查中的 CNN-LSTM-Attention 推理；相比 CPU/GPU 基线分别实现 32.1× 与 9.3× 的延迟降低，能耗降低约 160× 与 140×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抑郁症早期筛查需高效分析音频与语音数据，但传统 CPU/GPU 平台运行 CNN-LSTM 推理时延迟高、能耗大，亟需专用低功耗加速方案。

Method: 设计基于 crossbar 的统一 ReRAM 存内计算架构，将卷积、循环、注意力与 MLP 阶段集成于同一框架，减少空间与时序分支间的中间数据搬移；卷积采用 im2col 向量化映射，LSTM 门计算通过拼接输入-状态向量重构后映射到 ReRAM crossbar；并给出模块级工作负载分解、参数敏感性分析及与代表性 ReRAM/PIM 加速器的同负载对比。

Result: 延迟较 CPU 和 GPU 基线分别降低 32.1× 与 9.3×，能耗分别降低约 160× 与 140×；通过简化权重扰动测试，在未训练流水线与合成频谱输入下刻画了 ASLF 的敏感性。

Conclusion: 该统一 ReRAM-PIM 架构在延迟与能效上显著优于 CPU/GPU，验证了存内计算用于语音抑郁筛查推理的潜力；但任务级预测精度与鲁棒性仍有待评估。

Abstract: Early screening of depression requires efficient analysis of audio and speech data, while conventional CPU and GPU platforms incur high latency and energy consumption for CNN-LSTM inference. To address this challenge, we propose a unified resistive RAM (ReRAM) processing-in-memory accelerator for a CNN-LSTM attention workload. The architecture integrates convolutional, recurrent, attention, and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) stages within a crossbar-based framework, reducing intermediate data movement between spatial and temporal branches. CNN operations are mapped through im2col-based vectorization, while LSTM gate computations are reformulated using concatenated input-state vectors and mapped onto ReRAM crossbars. We further provide module-level workload breakdown, parameter sensitivity analysis, and matched-workload context against representative ReRAM/PIM accelerators. Experimental results show 32.1 times and 9.3 times latency reduction over CPU and GPU baselines, respectively, with about 160 times and 140 times energy reduction. Simplified weight-perturbation tests characterize ASLF sensitivity in an untrained pipeline with synthetic spectrogram-shaped inputs. Task-level prediction accuracy and robustness remain to be evaluated.

</details>


### [728] [APPlace: Co-Optimizing Device Locations and Access Points for Routing-Aware Analog Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39515)
*Bingyang Liu,Xiaohan Gao,Souradip Poddar,David Z. Pan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: APPlace：一种布线感知的模拟布局框架，在全局布局阶段联合优化器件位置与接入点(AP)选择，随后用保持全局布局结构的合法化阶段完成布局。四个真实模拟基准上，在相当面积下取得更优的整体后布局性能；消融显示去除AP协同优化会使OTA的CMRR最多下降13 dB、比较器延迟增加23%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟/混合信号布局自动化困难，因为布局引入的寄生与失配严重影响电路性能。布局阶段中摆放尤为关键：它约束布线解空间与可达的后布局性能。现有解析布局方法基于中心点线长代理优化器件坐标，并把接入点(AP)选择留给布线。但模拟电路中布线引脚是一段延展的端子金属而非固定点，其最佳AP取决于相连器件的摆放位置，因此仅按坐标优化会针对路由器实际不会使用的连接点进行优化。

Method: 提出APPlace布线感知的模拟布局框架：(1) 在全局布局中同时协同优化器件位置与AP选择，使摆放与真实连接点一致；(2) 随后进行合法化阶段，在消除重叠的同时保留全局布局建立的结构。

Result: 在四个真实世界模拟基准上与代表性基线相比，APPlace在相当布局面积下获得更好的整体后布局性能。消融实验表明，移除AP协同优化导致OTA基准中CMRR最多损失13 dB，比较器延迟增加23%。

Conclusion: 将AP选择提前到全局布局并与器件位置联合优化，可避免基于中心点代理的失配优化，显著改善模拟电路的后布局性能与鲁棒性，说明布线感知的布局建模对模拟布局自动化是必要的。

Abstract: Analog layout automation remains challenging in Analog/Mixed-Signal circuit design, because parasitics and mismatches introduced during layout strongly affect circuit performance. Placement is especially critical among the layout stages, as it constrains the routing solution space and the achievable post-layout performance. Existing analytical placement methods optimize device coordinates under center-based wirelength proxies and leave access point (AP) selection to routing. In analog circuits, however, a routing pin is an extended piece of terminal metal rather than a fixed point, and the best AP on it depends on where the other connected devices are placed, so a coordinate-only placement optimizes for connection points that the router will not use. We present APPlace, a routing-aware analog placement framework that co-optimizes device locations and AP selections during global placement, followed by a legalization stage that preserves the structure established by global placement. Experimental results on four real-world analog benchmarks show that APPlace achieves better overall post-layout performance than representative baselines at comparable layout area. Ablation studies further show that removing AP co-optimization causes up to a 13 dB CMRR loss among the OTA benchmarks and a 23% increase in comparator delay.

</details>


### [729] [LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39570)
*Leo Itoh,Junichiro Kadomoto*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种由LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选设计并利用板上实测性能指导设计决策的开发环境，成功将单周期RV32I核演进为三发射乱序RV32IM核，达5.61 CoreMark/MHz@130MHz，FPGA评估比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时RTL仿真需数小时，短程诊断运行又可能遗漏执行后期才出现的性能退化；这种评估成本延迟了基于LLM智能体的CPU开发中的设计决策。

Method: 构建开发环境：LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选，并基于板上性能测量结果反馈指导设计选择，在人工监督下将单周期RV32I核逐步改造为三发射乱序RV32IM核。

Result: 最终设计在Artix-7 FPGA上130MHz达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz；对同一候选运行8000次CoreMark迭代，含实现在内FPGA评估比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍；板上测量还揭示了短程诊断中表现更好候选的长时性能退化。

Conclusion: FPGA实测可作为低成本、高保真的评估信号替代长时仿真，其发现的性能退化引导了候选筛选并促成RTL层面的根因分析与修复。

Abstract: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cause analysis and a fix.

</details>


### [730] [MRUD: Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit Number Systems for High-Performance Arithmetic Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39638)
*Samaneh Rahimi,Ali Azarpeyvand*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该文提出首个面向高基数算术的广义最大冗余无符号数字（MRUD）数制，将UDR从基2扩展到基2^h并保持无进位加法，配合完整的编码、运算与软硬件设计，在多类乘法器与MAC上显著优于MRSD与传统架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRSD等带符号冗余数制虽可实现无进位加法，但因正负位并存导致乘法开销大；UDR在基2已显示潜力，但其在高基数下的扩展尚未被探索。作者希望获得一种兼具无进位加法、可同时支持有符号/无符号运算且乘法代价更低的高基数冗余表示。

Method: 构建广义MRUD框架：定义数字编码与数字扩展，给出加、减、乘运算及符号取反算法，设计前向/反向转换算法，补充上溢/下溢检测，并实现有符号与无符号MRUD的硬件架构；在FreePDK 45nm库下，针对RRR、BBR、BBB三种乘法器模式及MAC单元进行评测。

Result: 相比MRSD，MRUD延迟降低至多30%、面积减小26%、功耗降低87%；BBR模式下32×32操作数相对最优传统架构延迟降低至多43%；MAC单元中仅在末端做一次反向转换，吞吐率比DesignWare高至多64%，比Wallace高150%以上。

Conclusion: MRUD使高基数冗余算术可行且支持有符号与无符号双表示，显著提升乘法器与MAC性能，是传统带符号冗余数制的高效替代方案。

Abstract: Signed digit redundant number systems such as Maximally Redundant Signed Digit (MRSD) enable carry-free addition but introduce significant overhead in multiplication due to the presence of both positive and negative bits. While Unsigned Digit Redundant (UDR) systems have shown promise in radix-2, their extension to higher radices remains unexplored. This work presents the first generalized Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit (MRUD) number systems for high-radix arithmetic, extending UDR representations from radix-2 to radix-$2^h$ while preserving carry-free addition. The proposed framework includes digit encoding, digit extension, arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, and multiplication), sign inversion, forward/reverse conversion algorithms, overflow/underflow detection, and hardware architectures for both signed and unsigned MRUD representations. Unlike MRSD, which is inherently limited to signed arithmetic, MRUD supports both signed and unsigned representations, similar to conventional binary systems. Evaluations across three multiplier modes---RRR (Redundant inputs, Redundant output), BBR (Binary inputs, Redundant output), and BBB (Binary inputs, Binary output)---as well as Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, using the FreePDK 45nm library, demonstrate that MRUD achieves up to 30\% lower delay, 26\% smaller area, and 87\% lower power than MRSD. In BBR mode, MRUD achieves up to 43\% delay reduction over the best conventional architecture for 32$\times$32 operands, while in Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, performing reverse conversion only once at the end yields up to 64\% higher throughput than DesignWare and over 150\% higher than Wallace. These results demonstrate that MRUD enables high-radix redundant arithmetic with significantly improved multiplier and MAC performance, making it an efficient alternative to conventional signed digit redundant number systems.

</details>


### [731] [Caerus: Prefetching by Thinking Globally and Acting Locally](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39797)
*Jacky Wong,Jacob Alexandrou,Yinting Huang,Luke Panayi,Lev Mukhanov,Sam Ainsworth,Paul Kelly*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Caerus是一种偏移量预取器，通过PC局部过滤多个互不重叠的全局偏移量，兼顾全局模式覆盖与局部准确性，在SPECspeed 2017上取得8.3%几何平均加速，优于Berti 2.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏移预取器存在覆盖性与准确性难以兼顾的问题：BOP选择单一全局偏移量、缺乏上下文敏感（PC感知）的准确性跟踪，导致DRAM流量显著增加且性能有时不佳；Berti虽准确率高，但采用PC局部方式提取偏移量，难以捕获全局内存访问模式，在诸多场景下反而不如BOP等简单全局偏移预取器。

Method: Caerus从全局内存访问轨迹中提取多个非重叠偏移量，并按"仅用未被已学偏移量覆盖的访问"来训练每个后续偏移量，以最大化组合覆盖率；同时对每个提取的偏移量基于能否覆盖任意PC的未来访问进行逐PC准确性跟踪，从而在捕获复杂增量模式的同时保持高准确性。

Result: 在SPECspeed 2017上，Caerus获得8.3%的几何平均加速，比Berti高2.0%，并且硬件开销与DRAM流量开销均较低。

Conclusion: Caerus通过组合"全局多偏移量提取+逐PC准确性过滤"的设计，融合了BOP类全局预取器的覆盖优势与Berti类PC局部预取器的准确性优势，为复杂偏移模式下实现高覆盖率、高准确性且低开销的数据预取提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Modern processors rely heavily on data prefetching to bridge the growing performance gap between computation and memory accesses. In offset prefetching, prefetches are issued at an address delta relative to the most recently observed access, selecting deltas that have exhibited high coverage in the recent access-stream history. The Best-Offset Prefetcher (BOP) exemplifies this approach by selecting a single uniformly-issued global offset that delivers timely prefetches. However, its lack of context-sensitive accuracy tracking results in significantly increased DRAM traffic and sometimes disappointing performance. Conversely, Berti, the state-of-the-art offset prefetcher, achieves impressive prefetching performance and accuracy. However, its Program-Counter (PC)-local approach to extracting offsets limits its ability to capture global memory patterns, meaning there are many scenarios where simpler global offset prefetchers, such as BOP, outperform it.
  Observing the limitations of contemporary offset prefetchers, we present Caerus: an offset prefetcher that employs PC-local filtering on multiple non-overlapping globally derived offsets. Caerus extracts multiple offsets from the global memory trace and maximizes their combined coverage by training each offset only on accesses not already covered by previously learned offsets. The accuracy of each extracted offset is tracked per-PC based on whether it can cover future accesses for any PC. This allows Caerus to address complex delta patterns while maintaining high accuracy. In SPECspeed 2017, Caerus gains a geomean speedup of 8.3%, outperforming Berti by 2.0% while achieving low hardware and DRAM-traffic overhead.

</details>


### [732] [LAMP: LLM-Driven Analog Placement through Adaptive Tool Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39882)
*Zecheng Xu,Guanhua Chen,Yumao Wu,Keren Zhu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出以LLM作为“版图工程师”的模拟电路布局框架，通过可组合的布局组件与多模态检查点让LLM自行构建并修正布局流程，在SMIC 180nm两个电路上减小了布局面积并改善多数后布局性能指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟布局需在面积、匹配、可布线性与电性能之间做电路相关权衡，而预定义目标与固定布局流程难以平衡这些权衡，故引入LLM的推理与决策能力实现自适应流程构建。

Method: 将布局能力封装为可组合组件（约束管理、布局与合法化、可布线性与电性能的轻量评估）；LLM基于初始与演进设计的多模态检查点选择并组合组件以构建和修订布局流程；通过重开模块或切分重分组器件自适应调整布局层次，使局部布局响应全局需求；并引入经验技能库提供可复用设计知识以指导决策。

Result: 在SMIC 180nm两个电路上的评测表明，该框架减小了布局面积，并改善了大多数所测得后布局性能指标。

Conclusion: 以LLM驱动的可组合组件与自适应层次调整可替代固定布局流程，实现电路相关的多目标权衡，具备在模拟布局中兼顾面积与后布局性能的潜力。

Abstract: Analog placement requires circuit-specific trade-offs among area, matching, routability, and electrical performance. Balancing these trade-offs through predefined objectives and fixed placement flows remains difficult. In this paper, we propose an analog placement framework in which a large language model (LLM) acts as a layout engineer through composable placement components. These components support constraint management, placement and legalization, and lightweight evaluation of routability and electrical performance. Using multimodal checkpoints of the initial and evolving design, the LLM selects and combines components to construct and revise its own placement flow. It also adapts the placement hierarchy by reopening modules or partitioning and regrouping devices, allowing local layouts to respond to global design needs. An experience skill provides reusable design knowledge to guide these decisions. Evaluation on two SMIC 180 nm circuits shows that the framework reduces placement area and improves most measured post-layout performance metrics.

</details>


### [733] [NORmal: Architecting 3D Ferroelectric NOR Flash as Main Memory -- From Co-Fabricated BEOL Arrays to 200B-Class Multi-Agent LLMs in a Smartphone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40000)
*Zhuoran Li,Chen Gu,Zhuohang Bian,Haochen Yu,Yibo Zhao,Xuxiao Yang,Zhaori Cong,Jinshan Yue,Qing Luo,Di Geng,Ling Li,Youwei Zhuo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: NORmal 是首个面向 3D 铁电 NOR 闪存（FeNOR）的主存架构，将 BEOL 3D FeNOR 阵列通过 DRAM 仿真桥作为字节寻址、确定性时序的 rank 接入未经改动的 LPDDR6 总线，从而在手机上支撑 200B 级模型的智能体团队与持久化规划上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手机智能体以"大型规划器 + 并行 worker"的长会话团队形式运行，需 200B 级模型和远超手机 DRAM 容量的上下文。现有分层方案把闪存当存储：UFS 无法满足逐 token 的权重流式读取（带宽/延迟均不足）；移动 HBF 需重新设计 SoC 且无法承受持续的 KV 写入。核心洞察是：非易失存储器只有在访问延迟落入 DRAM 时序窗口时，才能作为普通 rank 接入未改动的 LPDDR6 总线，而现有 NAND 层级均不满足。

Method: 1) 流片并实验表征 BEOL 3D FeNOR 阵列，共集成高密度 3-bit MLC 与快速、高耐久、可就地写入的 SLC，感应时间低于 7.5 ns；2) 通过阵列下方 DRAM 仿真桥、错峰 bank 读取与零周期权重 swizzling、posted SLC 写，将该 rank 变为字节可寻址、时序确定的 load/store rank；3) 在 rank 与 DRAM 之间按可变性与生命周期（而非热度）放置智能体状态，使 200B 模型与持久规划器上下文原地驻留，并按智能体阶段动态划分 subchannel。

Result: 在生产级智能体 trace 的服务级仿真中：比 UFS offloading 快 8.9×–28.0×；与无限 DRAM 理想方案差距在 0.4% 以内；在超过 256K token 的会话上比 HBF 快 2.8×–6.3×；每 token 内存能耗降低 8.1×–17.8×。

Conclusion: 通过将低延迟 FeNOR 阵列"伪装"为 LPDDR6 普通 rank，NORmal 证明非易失存储器可作为主存层级直接扩展片上内存，在无需修改 SoC/接口的前提下，以接近无限 DRAM 的性能和显著更低的能耗支撑设备端大规模智能体团队。

Abstract: Smartphone agents increasingly work as teams, in which a large planner directs parallel workers across long sessions. Running such a team on the device requires 200B-class models and contexts that exceed phone DRAM many times over, yet existing tiers treat flash as storage: UFS starves per-token weight streaming, and mobile High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) needs a redesigned SoC and cannot absorb continuous KV writes. We show that a non-volatile memory can join an unmodified LPDDR6 bus as a plain rank only if its access latency fits the DRAM timing window, a condition no NAND tier meets. We present NORmal, to our knowledge the first main-memory architecture for 3D ferroelectric NOR flash. We have fabricated and experimentally characterized back-end-of-line (BEOL) 3D FeNOR arrays that co-integrate dense 3-bit MLC and fast, high-endurance in-place-writable SLC with sub-7.5 ns sensing. NORmal turns these co-fabricated arrays into a byte-addressable, deterministic-timing load/store rank on an unmodified LPDDR6 interface through an under-array DRAM-emulation bridge, staggered bank reads with zero-cycle weight swizzling, and posted SLC writes. Across this rank and DRAM, NORmal places agent state by mutability and lifetime rather than by hotness, serving 200B-class models and persistent planner contexts in place while dynamically partitioning subchannels across agent phases. In serving-level simulation on production agent traces, NORmal is 8.9$\times$--28.0$\times$ faster than UFS offloading, within 0.4% of an unlimited-DRAM ideal, and 2.8$\times$--6.3$\times$ faster than HBF on sessions beyond 256K tokens, with 8.1$\times$--17.8$\times$ less memory energy per token.

</details>


<div id='physics.optics'></div>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [734] [A photonic-integrated optomechanical mid-infrared detector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37771)
*Guillermo Arregui,Amirali Arabmoheghi,Alessio Zicoschi,Xinru Ji,Scott E. Kenning,Marco Golino,Shivaprasad U. Hulyal,Yi Xia,Sunil A. Bhave,Tobias J. Kippenberg*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作将高Q张紧氮化硅"蹦床"式纳米机械谐振器与氮化硅光子集成回路单片集成，通过色散耦合下方微腔实现全片上读出，室温、微瓦光功率下对3–12 μm宽带热辐射达到3.4 pW/√Hz噪声等效功率（参考吸收功率时距基本热涨落极限仅1.5倍），并在商用FTIR中实现聚合物薄膜指纹分辨。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跟踪机械谐振器共振频率是原子力显微、质量传感与测温的基础；张紧谐振器可把热膨胀高效转化为频移并抑制耗散，是纳米机械热探测器的理想载体。但其基本灵敏度极限此前依赖自由空间或光纤耦合干涉仪读出，难以小型化部署与阵列化扩展，成为瓶颈。

Method: 单片集成：将张紧应力氮化硅trampoline谐振器与下方氮化硅光子集成微环谐振腔色散耦合，并以阻抗匹配的铂吸收层吸收入射辐射；全片上光学读出，无需自由空间或光纤干涉仪。

Result: 室温、微瓦级光功率下，对3–12 μm宽带热辐射的噪声等效功率为3.4 pW/√Hz（参考入射功率）；参考吸收功率时，距基本热涨落极限约1.5倍以内；在商用FTIR中于2–20 μm分辨聚合物薄膜振动指纹，精度与内置热释电探测器相当而入射功率低约一个数量级。

Conclusion: 该集成光机架构突破了高灵敏度纳米机械热探测的读出瓶颈，为可复用光机焦平面阵列与紧凑、可扩展的片上热探测提供了路径。

Abstract: Tracking the resonance frequency of a mechanical oscillator is the basis of atomic force microscopy, mass sensing and thermometry. Nanomechanical thermal detectors exploit this principle to sense absorbed radiation, most effectively with tensile-stressed resonators, whose tension converts thermal expansion into a large frequency shift and dilutes dissipation. Approaching their fundamental sensitivity limit, however, has required free-space or fibre-coupled interferometers, hindering compact deployment and scaling to arrays. Here we remove this bottleneck by monolithically integrating a high-Q nanomechanical resonator with a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit. A tensile-stressed silicon nitride trampoline with an impedance-matched platinum absorber is dispersively coupled to a photonic integrated microresonator beneath it. At room temperature and with microwatt-level optical power, the detector reaches a noise-equivalent power of 3.4 pW/$\sqrt{\rm Hz}$ for broadband thermal radiation (3-12 $μ$m), referred to incident power. Referred to absorbed power, this is within a factor of 1.5 of its fundamental thermal fluctuation limit. Using our detector in a state-of-the-art commercial Fourier-transform infrared spectrometer, we resolve the vibrational fingerprint of a polymer film across 2-20 $μ$m and reach the precision of the built-in pyroelectric detector with about an order of magnitude lower incident power. This architecture opens a route to multiplexed optomechanical focal-plane arrays.

</details>


### [735] [An Eigenmode Expansion Framework for Bi-Directional Multimode Nonlinear Mixing Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37846)
*Salvador Poveda-Hospital,Vincent Girouard,Yves-Alain Peter*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 将参量非线性过程（含经典及量子自发过程）纳入本征模展开框架，实现变化光子系统中非线性产生的统一仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本征模展开法借助散射矩阵已能高效模拟分层介质中的电场，但尚缺乏在该框架内描述参量非线性产生的能力，难以统一处理复杂光子系统中的经典与量子非线性过程。

Method: 在本征模展开框架下，用散射矩阵表述参量非线性过程，建立可随系统结构变化追踪非线性的仿真方法。

Result: 该仿真方法统一涵盖经典非线性过程及其量子对应过程，包括自发参量下转换与自发四波混频。

Conclusion: 散射矩阵本征模展开可自然推广至参量非线性范畴，为多种光子系统中的非线性产生（含量子光源）提供统一建模仿真手段。

Abstract: An approach to simulating complex photonic systems is the eigenmode expansion method, in which scattering matrices are used to model and track the electric field in layered media. In this work, we formulate parametric nonlinear processes within the eigenmode expansion framework, enabling the simulation of nonlinear generation in varying photonic systems. This new simulation method includes both classical nonlinear processes and their quantum counterparts, including spontaneous parametric down-conversion and spontaneous four-wave mixing.

</details>


### [736] [Automated identification of quasi-BIC modes in disordered resonator chains using spatial field envelopes and resonance descriptors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37967)
*Vadim A. Porvatov,Kliment V. Semushev,Ravshanjon Kh. Nazarov,Nikolai A. Vlasov,Alexander I. Solomonov,Zarina F. Kondratenko,Ekaterina E. Maslova*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出自动化流程（CNN-循环网络+两个梯度提升树集成）在无序系统中识别准BIC目标模式，299个留出样本上准确率82.6%，并成功迁移至GST条形超表面（98–100%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构无序使BIC退化为准BIC，并与频谱邻近的本征模混合，导致每个无序实现中目标模式的位置需重新识别；传统启发式规则（最高频率、最高Q）在强无序下失效（σ=0.05时最高Q规则仅45%命中目标）。

Method: 以50个陶瓷圆盘链为测试平台；利用目标模场的空间包络与共振参数作为特征，构建由卷积-循环神经网络与两个梯度提升决策树模型组成的集成分类器；在50个标注实现上做微调适配，推广至Ge₂Sb₂Te₅条形超表面。

Result: 299个留出实现中集成模型识别目标率82.6%，优于最高频率规则（60.9%）与最高Q规则（49.5%）；σ≥0.09时达69.5%（最佳基线57.6%）。所选模式平均Q随σ的标度指数k=-0.80±0.05，与人工标注的-0.86±0.04一致。GST超表面适配后标注案例识别率98–100%，包括Q无法区分模式的损耗相。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的多模态集成方法可稳健追踪无序系统中的准BIC模式，克服单一共振参数判据的局限，并具备跨平台迁移能力。

Abstract: Structural disorder turns bound states in the continuum (BICs) into quasi-BIC resonances and mixes them with spectrally close eigenmodes, so the target mode must be identified anew in every disorder realization. We develop an automated procedure for this task and test it on a chain of 50 ceramic disks, where disorder reorders the standing-wave eigenmodes at the edge of the BIC band: at disorder amplitude $σ=0.05$, the highest-quality-factor ($Q$) mode is the target in only 45\% of realizations, and above $σ\approx0.06$ the highest-frequency mode is no longer the target. The target is identified from the spatial envelope of its field and its resonance parameters by an ensemble of a convolutional--recurrent neural network and two gradient-boosted decision-tree models. On 299 held-out realizations, the ensemble selects the target in 82.6\% of cases, against 60.9\% and 49.5\% for the highest-frequency and highest-$Q$ rules, and in 69.5\% of cases for $σ\ge0.09$, where the best of these rules reaches 57.6\%. The mean $Q$ of the selected modes follows that of the manually labeled modes ($\langle Q\rangle\proptoσ^{k}$, $k=-0.80\pm0.05$ versus $-0.86\pm0.04$). After adaptation on 50 labeled realizations, the workflow identifies the quasi-BIC of a Ge$_2$Sb$_2$Te$_5$ bar metasurface in 98--100\% of labeled cases, including a lossy phase where $Q$ does not distinguish the mode.

</details>


### [737] [Drift-induced nonreciprocity in image-polariton-mediated dipole emission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38348)
*Christian Nicolaisen Hansen,Eduardo J. C. Dias,Christos Tserkezis,Joel D. Cox*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过电流偏置（载流子漂移）在石墨烯/hBN异质结中实现无磁非互易等离激元传输，并证明"镜像极化激元"结构可在保持Fizeau频移的同时将模式限制提升至约两倍，近场偶极-偶极耦合左右不对称度达~40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统非互易光学器件依赖外磁场（磁光效应），难以在纳米尺度集成且难以电调。电流偏置提供无磁、可电控的替代路径；此前漂移诱导非互易性多研究裸石墨烯，缺乏对与hBN声子极化激元耦合、以及镜像极化激元（金属衬底）几何的系统刻画，也缺乏对近场方向性发射与偶极-偶极非互易相互作用的定量评估。

Method: 理论上研究含hBN的石墨烯异质结中漂移诱导的非互易性（红外波段石墨烯等离激元与hBN声子极化激元耦合）。用随机相位近似（RPA）与玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）表征漂移偏置石墨烯的非局域光学响应；对比"石墨烯/hBN"与"石墨烯–薄hBN间隔层–金衬底"的镜像极化激元结构；计算极化激元色散的方向性频移、近场发射方向性，并以交叉光学态密度（CDOS）量化偶极-偶极相互作用的非互易性。

Result: 载流子漂移使极化激元色散产生显著方向性频移；与hBN声子极化激元耦合强烈改变非互易响应。在镜像极化激元结构中，石墨烯极化激元限制增强至约2倍，同时保持可比的Fizeau频移。非互易色散导致方向性近场发射，并使偶极-偶极相互作用出现左右不对称，CDOS不对称度最高约40%。

Conclusion: 漂移偏置石墨烯中的镜像极化激元是一种紧凑、电可调的平台，可在纳米尺度实现量子发射体之间的方向性耦合，为无磁非互易纳米光子学与手性/方向性量子光学界面提供方案。

Abstract: Electrical current bias offers a magnet-free route to nonreciprocal light propagation at the nanoscale. Here, we theoretically explore drift-induced nonreciprocity in graphene heterostructures containing hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), where graphene plasmons interact with hBN phonon polaritons in the infrared. Both the random-phase approximation and the Boltzmann transport equation are used to characterize the nonlocal optical response of drift-biased graphene. We compare graphene on hBN with an image-polaritonic structure comprising graphene, a thin hBN spacer, and a gold substrate. Carrier drift produces pronounced directional shifts of the polariton dispersion, while coupling to hBN phonon polaritons strongly modifies the nonreciprocal response. In the image-polaritonic structure, the graphene polaritons become up to twice as confined while retaining a comparable Fizeau shift. The nonreciprocal polariton dispersion produces directional near-field emission and nonreciprocal dipole-dipole interactions, the latter quantified through the cross density of optical states, reaching a left-right dissymmetry of up to ~40%. Our results identify image polaritons in drift-biased graphene as a compact, electrically tunable platform for directional coupling between quantum emitters at the nanoscale.

</details>


### [738] [Nonreciprocal coupling enables tunable exceptional-point response in non-Hermitian circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39157)
*Xiaoyin Sha,Chao Ma,Yuqi Jiang,Zhiqin Jiang,Junan Lai,Xiaoke Gao,Tianyu Dong*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于回转器(nonreciprocal gyrator)介导耦合的非互易非厄米电路系统，可在保持EP条件与平方根响应的前提下，通过调节前/后向耦合的非对称性连续调控EP响应前因子，从而增强对电阻扰动的频率分裂灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EP对弱扰动的响应具有平方根特性，但响应幅度由构型依赖的前因子决定，且该前因子通常很小。传统互易耦合在平衡增益/损耗下只给出唯一的EP构型，缺乏调节前因子的自由度。作者希望在不破坏EP分支点标度特性的前提下，引入额外自由度来增强EP传感响应。

Method: 构建由回转器介导耦合的非互易非厄米电路系统。与互易耦合不同，非互易耦合允许前向与后向耦合强度独立变化而保持其乘积不变，从而维持EP条件，形成一族连续的EP构型（EP库）。通过调节耦合非对称性连续控制频率分裂幅度，并结合理论推导、电路仿真与反射谱实验测量进行验证。

Result: 非互易耦合提供了对频率分裂幅度的连续调控能力，且不改变对绝对扰动强度的平方根依赖特性；通过适当调节耦合非对称性，可增强给定绝对电阻扰动所引起的谱分裂。理论预测、电路仿真与实验反射谱测量三者一致地证实了该可调响应。

Conclusion: 非互易耦合为工程化与增强EP诱导的微扰响应提供了新途径，可在不改变其分支点标度特性的情况下提升传感灵敏度，拓展了非厄米传感的设计自由度。

Abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) exhibit characteristic square-root spectral responses to weak perturbations, with response magnitudes governed by configuration-dependent prefactors that are often relatively small. Modulating these prefactor while preserving the exceptional characteristics offers an additional degrees of freedom for engineering non-Hermitian sensing responses. Here, we report a nonreciprocal non-Hermitian circuit system with gyrator-meditated coupling that supports a continuous family of EP configurations. Unlike reciprocal coupling, which typically yields a unique EP configuration for balanced gain and loss, nonreciprocal coupling allows the directional forward and backward coupling strengths to be varied while maintaining their product and thus preserving the EP condition and yielding a library of EPs. This additional freedom enables continuous control of the frequency-splitting magnitude without modifying the square-root characteristic dependence on absolute perturbation strength. We show that the spectral splitting induced by a given absolute resistance perturbation can be enhanced by appropriately adjusting the coupling asymmetry. Theoretical predictions, circuit simulations, and experimental reflection-spectrum measurements consistently confirms this tunable response. Our results establish nonreciprocal coupling as an alternative approach for engineering and enhancing EP-induced perturbative responses without changing their characteristic branch-point scaling.

</details>


### [739] [Confocal ellipsoidal displaced Gregorian structure for stand-off millimeter-wave imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38403)
*Mohammad Hossein Koohi Ghamsari,Mehdi Ahmadi-Boroujeni*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种共聚焦椭球偏置格雷戈里（CEDG）双反射镜构型，通过改进副镜降低光遮挡并实现目标扫描，适用于毫米波/太赫兹远距成像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反射式结构相比折射式在毫米波与太赫兹远距成像中频率相关损耗与像差更小，但标准格雷戈里构型存在中心光遮挡大、扫描能力不足的问题，需要一种兼顾低遮挡与扫描性能的紧凑光学构型。

Method: 构建由标准椭圆主镜（将射线聚焦至焦平面）与改进副镜（降低遮挡、提升成像性能）组成的CEDG双镜结构；给出逐步构造流程、解析研究与闭式设计方程；采用光线追迹与全波仿真评估遮挡、分辨率、景深，并通过副镜倾斜与馈源位移考察扫描FoV与远距调谐能力。

Result: 光线追迹显示CEDG光遮挡较标准格雷戈里结构减小；全波仿真得到分辨率1.5 cm、景深49.7 cm，与理论预测吻合良好；通过副镜倾斜与馈点位移在3 m距离处实现最大40 cm视场；并验证馈源横向位移可调谐远距。

Conclusion: CEDG构型紧凑、低成本，兼具低遮挡、良好分辨率与景深及扫描能力，具备用于实际毫米波与太赫兹远距成像系统的潜力。

Abstract: Reflective-based structures are favorable candidates as the optical section of millimeter-wave and terahertz (THz) stand-off imaging systems due to decreasing frequency-dependent losses and aberrations compared to refractive-based counterparts. In this paper, we propose a simple confocal ellipsoidal displaced Gregorian (CEDG) dual-mirror configuration for stand-off imaging systems that exhibits superior performance in terms of mitigating optical blockage and enabling object scanning. The proposed structure is composed of a standard elliptical main mirror, which focuses the emanated rays on the focal plane, and a modified secondary mirror (SM) that reduces the optical blockage effect and improves the imaging performance of the structure. A detailed step-by-step procedure is proposed for constructing the structure, followed by an analytical study and deriving closed-form design equations. By performing ray tracing simulations, it is observed that the optical blockage of the proposed CEDG structure is reduced compared with the standard Gregorian. Also, the resolution and the depth-of-focus (DoF) are obtained at 1.5 cm and 49.7 cm in full-wave simulations, respectively, demonstrating good agreement with the theoretical predictions. Moreover, the scanning performance of the CEDG structure is investigated by utilizing the tilting of the SM and feed point displacement, presenting a maximum field-of-view (FoV) of 40 cm at a distance of 3 m, which is acceptable for modern practical stand-off imaging systems. Finally, the capability of the proposed structure for tuning the stand-off distance by lateral displacement of the feeding source is verified. As a result, the proposed compact, low-cost configuration shows potential for practical mm-wave and THz stand-off imaging systems.

</details>


### [740] [Scattering-force-driven light-sheet fluorescence microscopy for scan-free three-dimensional imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39956)
*Sen Geng,Zhuoren Wan,Zhaoyang Wen,Dongxu Zhu,Yuan Chen,Wending Huang,Zijian Wang,Ming Yan,Heping Zeng*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出散射力驱动的光学操控成像方法，用连续定向输运替代逐步扫描，实现0.1 μm轴向采样与250 Hz成像速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统光镊逐步扫描成像中，光束缚过程中的位置涨落引入空间采样误差，损害成像质量与采集速度。

Method: 利用低数值孔径聚焦光束产生的轴向散射力，推动微粒穿过光片；同步记录微粒位置与荧光信号，在粒子运动与断层图像之间建立直接空间对应关系。

Result: 降低位置涨落对三维成像的影响，轴向采样间隔达0.1 μm，成像速率250 Hz；可成像具有多样结构特征的样品，并将所需光功率降低70%。

Conclusion: 结合稳健空间采样、高速采集与低光损伤，为微粒与生物样本的快速三维成像、动态观测及微尺度空间分析提供可行途径。

Abstract: Optical manipulation offers a powerful non-contact approach to precise positioning, directional transport and three-dimensional (3D) imaging of microscale objects. However, positional fluctuations during optical confinement introduce spatial sampling errors that compromise imaging quality and acquisition speed. Here, we demonstrate a scattering-force-driven optical manipulation imaging method that replaces the stepwise scanning of conventional optical trapping with continuous directional transport of microparticles. An axial scattering force generated by a low-numerical-aperture focused beam propels microparticles through a light sheet, while their positions and fluorescence signals are simultaneously recorded to establish direct spatial correspondence between particle motion and tomographic images. Experiments demonstrate that this approach reduces the effects of positional fluctuations on 3D imaging, achieving an axial sampling interval of 0.1 μm and an imaging rate of 250 Hz. The method also enables effective imaging of samples with diverse structural features while reducing optical power requirements by 70%. By combining robust spatial sampling, high-speed acquisition and reduced photodamage, this approach offers a promising route to rapid 3D imaging, dynamic observation and microscale spatial analysis of microparticles and biological specimens.

</details>


### [741] [Engineering Canalized Near-Field Radiative Heat Transfer between Fixed Nanoparticles with Twisted $α$-MoO$_3$ Trilayers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38583)
*Yang Hu,Pablo Alonso-González*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在纳米颗粒轴与底层晶体取向固定的约束下，研究扭转α-MoO₃三层结构内部扭转角对近场辐射热传递的调控作用；优化三层结构的最大辐射功率为双层结构的2.84倍，平均功率为1.51倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扭转范德华晶体中的沟道化声子极化激元可调控纳米尺度热流，但需明确在实验室坐标系几何固定时，内部扭转角这一额外构型自由度能带来多大增益。

Method: 基于已建立的扭转α-MoO₃三层平台，固定颗粒轴与底层晶向、保持总厚度相等，扫描内部两个扭转角；结合动量空间格林张量诊断与实空间能量密度图分析机制。

Result: 优化三层结构最大辐射功率为双层的2.84倍，采样内部扭转构型下的平均功率为1.51倍；第二内部扭转坐标扩大了强传递构型集合，并存在局部角度容差；增强源于更强的朝向接收端散射与更优的通道对准；选定构型在多种颗粒共振与长距离下仍保持增强耦合。

Conclusion: 在固定实验室坐标几何下，内部扭转角提供了额外的构型自由度，可显著提升近场辐射热传递，为纳米尺度热流工程化调控提供途径。

Abstract: Canalized phonon polaritons in twisted van der Waals crystals offer a route to control nanoscale thermal energy flow. Building on the established twisted $α$-MoO$_3$ trilayer platform, we examine how internal twist angles modify near-field radiative heat transfer (NFRHT) between a prescribed nanoparticle pair while both the nanoparticle axis and the bottom-layer crystallographic orientation remain fixed. Under this constraint and at equal total $α$-MoO$_3$ thickness, the optimized trilayer reaches 2.84 times the bilayer maximum radiative power, while its mean power over the sampled internal twist configurations is 1.51 times the bilayer value. The second internal twist coordinate also enlarges the set of configurations supporting strong transfer, with local angular tolerance when either internal angle is varied separately. Momentum-space Green-tensor diagnostics and real-space energy-density maps associate the enhancement with stronger receiver-directed scattering and improved channel alignment. Selected trilayer configurations retain enhanced coupling across the sampled family of nanoparticle resonances and at long distances. These results quantify the additional internal configurational freedom available for engineering radiative heat transfer under a fixed laboratory-frame geometry.

</details>


### [742] [Temporal equivalent of the Sommerfeld half-plane problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40171)
*Asma Fallah,Shixiong Yin,Andrea Alù,Nader Engheta*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文研究Sommerfeld半平面衍射问题的时间类比：半无限Drude色散介质（初始等离子频率高于入射波频率）在t=0时刻等离子频率骤降为零变为空气，垂直入射的入射波在时间界面处激发双向传播的驻波与倏逝场，并额外产生由"直流"电流密度激发的电磁波。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Sommerfeld问题是空间半平面（PEC薄板）对单色波的衍射，是电磁散射理论的基石；作者希望建立其"时间类比"——用时间界面（介质色散参数随时间突变）替代空间边界，以理解色散介质中时间跃变处的电磁波行为，并服务于时间/时空超材料应用。

Method: 理论解析：考虑半无限Drude介质紧邻空气，垂直入射频率低于等离子频率的单色波；在t时刻将等离子频率迅速降为零（介质"瞬时"变为空气）。与PEC板不同，跃变前场可倏逝穿透Drude介质。时间界面充当Sommerfeld问题中尖锐空间边界的类比，但分隔的是两个时间区间而非两个空间半平面。通过求解含色散与时间跃变初值条件的麦克斯韦方程，分析跃变后场的演化。

Result: 跃变迫使Drude介质前方空气中的驻波及介质内部倏逝场沿两个方向传播，同时保持其空间场结构不变；此外，与时间界面相关联的"直流"电流密度激发额外的电场波与磁场波。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了色散介质中时间跃变处电磁波的行为，为时间超材料与时空超材料的设计提供了物理洞见，并确立了空间Sommerfeld衍射问题的时间类比框架。

Abstract: Sommerfeld's half-plane problem, describing diffraction of a monochromatic wave by a semi-infinite perfectly electric conducting (PEC) infinitesimally thin plate, is one of the cornerstones of classical electromagnetic scattering theory. Here we study its temporal analogue: a semi-infinite medium with the Drude dispersion, adjacent to air, whose plasma frequency is rapidly reduced to zero, thus turning it into air, while a monochromatic wave with frequency below the plasma frequency illuminates it under normal incidence. Unlike the PEC plate, the Drude medium supports evanescent penetration of the field prior to its temporal transition; the temporal interface here acts as the analogue of the sharp spatial boundary in the Sommerfeld problem, but now separates two time intervals rather than two spatial half-planes. We show that this transition forces the standing wave in air in front of the Drude medium and the evanescent fields inside it to propagate in both directions, while preserving their spatial field structure. In addition, we observe the excitation of additional electric and magnetic field waves generated by a "DC" current density associated with the time interface. Our findings offer insight into the electromagnetic wave behavior at temporal transitions in dispersive media and may find applications in time- and space-time metamaterials

</details>


### [743] [Maxwell's equations are universal for sparse linear algebra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38913)
*Yannick Augenstein*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文证明任意多项式条件数的稀疏线性系统都可编译为一个有界介电常数、无损各向同性材料填充的三维介质腔，其时谐场响应即编码方程解；结构体积、写入与读出代价均为 Õ(m^{3/2})，系数仅需 O(log m) 比特，且任何近似满足麦克斯韦方程的场都能解码为近似解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学与波动模拟计算被重新视为加速线性代数的途径，超材料与光子电路已能求逆矩阵、求解积分方程，但在计入编码、精度、条件数与读出开销后，这类无源结构究竟能表示哪些问题、代价几何仍不清楚。作者旨在给出一个可表示性刻画与复杂度上下界。

Method: 构造性归约：把多项式条件数的稀疏线性系统编码进三维介质腔（无损、各向同性、有界介电常数）的时谐响应中，对连续麦克斯韦方程给出严格证明，并针对有限差分求解器所用的 Yee 离散化给出计算机辅助验证版本；同时分析编码/读出复杂度与数值精度（系数 O(log m) 比特）。

Result: 对 m 个非零系数，结构体积与写入、读出解的代价均按 Õ(m^{3/2}) 缩放；每个系数仅需 O(log m) 比特精度；鲁棒性表现为任何近似满足麦克斯韦方程的场都对应原系统的近似解。

Conclusion: 反向解读该构造可得：电磁仿真在扣除上述开销后与一般稀疏线性代数同等困难，即足够快的通用麦克斯韦求解器将蕴含更快的稀疏线性求解器，从而刻画了被动波动计算的能力边界。

Abstract: Optical and wave-based analog computing has re-emerged as a route to accelerating linear algebra, with metamaterials and photonic circuits shown to invert matrices and solve integral equations. However, it has remained unclear which problems such passive structures can represent, and at what cost, once encoding, precision, conditioning and readout are accounted for. Here, we show that every polynomially conditioned sparse linear system can be compiled into a three-dimensional dielectric -- a cavity filled with lossless, isotropic material of bounded permittivity -- whose time-harmonic response encodes its solution. For $m$ nonzero coefficients, the volume of the structure and the cost of writing it down and reading out the answer scale as $\tilde O(m^{3/2})$, coefficients require only $O(\log m)$ bits, and every field that approximately satisfies Maxwell's equations decodes to an approximate solution. We prove the construction for the continuum equations and give a computer-assisted version for the Yee discretization underlying finite-difference solvers.
